BWP-S — complete current scientific reader

This reader preserves every scientific field in the supplied current disclosure reader, including adverse evidence, guards, limitations and retained historical layers. The earlier pending-disclosure header is a historical publication state. Read the scientific account with these records.

Named scientific-worker context identifiers and private custody locators were already replaced in the supplied disclosure reader. Those specific replacements remain. No scientific finding is withheld merely because its source was privately held.

    Activation and alternative rule

    A manual authorised intervention can supply actual action/outcome evidence. Use a comparison appropriate to the claim, with case mix and changed capture assessed where material. A causal assertion needs an identification argument; no engine installation or new universal experiment gate follows.

    Selection semantics

    Actual function choices under the stated guard; this is not a compulsory list, global sequence, new acceptance requirement or theorem of joint sufficiency.

    R2 scientific integration

    Claim-matched human completion/effect evidence supplies EPM066 renewed evaluation when the actual intervention changed exposure or outcomes. Declaration and receipt fractions may differ; causal identification and comparison design remain separate.

    R3 scientific integration

    A manual timeline distinguishes elapsed outcome from work effort; an actual communicated case choice identifies changed selection. A bounded comparison, null result, narrower claim or non-use is valid. No workflow engine, mandatory feedback service or artificial causal conclusion is required.

    R4 scientific integration

    Manual case choices and meaningful timelines can support a scoped pilot without workflow automation. Adoption facts, time outcomes, credible comparisons and costs remain separate; human support or non-intervention can be preferable.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R5 scientific integration

    An actual infrastructure choice can specify a human-support or shared-record pilot and its comparator. This defines a study, not adoption or benefit; burdens, selection, outcomes and independent settings remain to be established.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R6 scientific integration

    A proposed intervention comparison may define the analytical case while adoption, group independence and causal benefit remain unknown. Region-level assignment does not automatically make each region a case.

    R6 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 scientific integration

    An exact unavailable dependency, invalid population or missing event meaning can justify narrowing or non-use. More native inputs do not force analysis when an ordinary query, direct check or no action answers the actual purpose.

    R3 scientific integration

    An already adequate manual account, missing endpoint, absent legitimate consumer or exact unavailable evaluation dependency can justify a simpler inquiry or non-use. Non-use does not erase existing obligations or an adverse result.

    R4 scientific integration

    When evidence is unused, wrong-scope, unobservable at acceptable burden or unable to affect the decision, non-use or a narrower question is valid. Retire only after accounting for live obligations and truthful remaining limits.

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R6 scientific integration

    Where the existing identifier already preserves the question, use it. Unused outputs or a pure row-count task do not activate the new arrows. Non-use and a narrower question remain legitimate.

    R6 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R7 s003 scientific integration

    When the current view already meets the recipient question, keep it. Removing redundant account channels, using direct adequate evidence, or declining an irrelevant case analysis can preserve the protected function.

Guarded alternatives can coexist in different parts of work. A configuration is not a mandatory global mode or ordered maturity stage.

    Opaque external outcomes may remain unknown; a log does not supply missing cooperation.

    Name

    Purpose, consequential consumer and non-use

    Shared concern

    An output has a legitimate decision consumer rather than becoming self-justifying activity.

    Distinction

    BPM establishes purposes and decision capacity; workflow monitoring addresses coordinated work; mining supplies bounded findings, not action authority.

    Trigger

    A proposed result or mechanism is justified by its contribution to a consequential decision.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Mechanism

      Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.

      Bearer

      Process purposes, beneficiaries and strategic outcome commitments

      Authority

      Responsible managers can commit resources; beneficiaries and affected workers contribute outcome evidence. Analysts cannot decide whose interests prevail merely by drawing the boundary.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-004

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-004

      Mechanism

      Select interventions according to outcome importance, observed problems, dependencies and feasible change, not the convenience of what is already modelled. Include no intervention and deferred investigation as legitimate portfolio decisions.

      Bearer

      Intervention portfolio and chosen scale of change

      Authority

      Sponsors allocate scarce effort; affected process owners challenge feasibility and displacement assumptions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-004#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-004#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-032

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-032

      Mechanism

      Translate strategic commitments into explicit process outcomes, selection priorities and constraints. Examine conflicts between the sponsor’s strategy, affected-party interests and actual operational capacity rather than assuming alignment is inherently beneficial.

      Bearer

      Process purposes, beneficiaries and strategic outcome commitments

      Authority

      Strategy sponsors decide commitments; owners and performers test feasibility; affected parties inform consequences.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-032#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-032#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-044

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-044

      Mechanism

      Connect each consequential indicator to a decision, a responsible consumer and a feasible action or inquiry. A dashboard can inform action but its production is not itself adaptation or improvement.

      Bearer

      Monitoring outputs linked, or not linked, to a capable decision consumer

      Authority

      Monitoring analysts provide evidence; authorised owners or professionals decide interventions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-044#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-044#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-061

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-061

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. A report with no capable consumer or consequential decision is not a functioning feedback mechanism.

      Bearer

      Monitoring outputs linked, or not linked, to a capable decision consumer

      Authority

      Monitoring analysts provide evidence; authorised owners or professionals decide interventions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-061#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-061#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep three linked but non-equivalent claims explicit: evidence supports a distinction about work; an identified actor is authorised and able to intervene; observed consequences support an outcome judgement. Require the missing link to be established before promoting one claim into another.

      Bearer

      Evidence-to-authorised-action-to-observed-consequence relations for managed work

      Authority

      Evidence producers do not acquire execution powers by analysis; authorised actors do not acquire factual correctness by holding office.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-004

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-004

      Mechanism

      Select the least costly representation and enactment mechanism adequate to the actual coordination risk and its consumer; revisit it when risk or demand changes.

      Bearer

      Selected workflow representation/enactment infrastructure and total fitness/cost

      Authority

      Technical elegance or a licence purchase does not authorise redesign of other people’s responsibilities.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-004#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-004#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-057

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-057

      Mechanism

      Connect each monitored quantity to a decision-maker and a possible action, while preserving scope, uncertainty and incentives.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Monitoring does not authorise intervention beyond the responsible actor’s powers.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-057#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-057#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      A measured efficiency gain does not authorise shifting unacceptable burdens to others.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-053

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-053

      Mechanism

      Identify who needs the result, what decision it can change and what observation would establish the consequence. Separate analytical delivery, organisational agreement, implemented action and measured outcome; stop or retire an analysis without an adequate consumer.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates evidence and uncertainty; operational actors act within their mandate; outcome measurement must not be replaced by analyst self-report. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate predictive utility at actual decision times, accounting for lead time, false alarms, intervention capacity and opportunity cost. Choose thresholds or policies against an explicit decision objective rather than accuracy alone.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Operational authority specifies available actions and resource limits; the analyst evaluates decision support within those bounds. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-073

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-073

      Mechanism

      Do not export dashboard possession as an obligation. Evaluate whether a representation supports the actual traceable inference and consumer interaction; keep the tool only if it earns that role.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      Consumer evaluates function; vendor or project branding does not establish analytical authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-073#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-075

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-075

      Mechanism

      Permit non-use, narrowed use and retirement when the data cannot support the question, the result cannot affect a legitimate decision, or the harm/cost exceeds its plausible value. State what evidence or changed condition would justify reconsideration.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      The accountable consumer and data authority decide whether to proceed; analysts must be able to report an evidence gap without manufacturing a model. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-075#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-075#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    An output has a legitimate decision consumer rather than becoming self-justifying activity. BPM establishes purposes and decision capacity; workflow monitoring addresses coordinated work; mining supplies bounded findings, not action authority.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

  • Id

    BWP-K002

    Name

    Consequence boundary and displaced burden

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-002

    • EBPM:EBPM-017

    • EBPM:EBPM-050

    • EBPM:EBPM-066

    • EBPM:EBPM-069

    • EWM:EWM-030

    • EWM:EWM-063

    • EWM:EWM-071

    • EWM:EWM-075

    • EPM:EPM-051

    • EPM:EPM-053

    • EPM:EPM-065

    • EPM:EPM-077

    • EPM:EPM-083

    Shared concern

    A locally favourable measurement or completion need not establish a favourable received outcome.

    Distinction

    Organisational purpose, work acceptance and analytical population/effects remain different subjects.

    Trigger

    A local result is promoted into an outcome or improvement claim.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-002

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-002

      Mechanism

      Trace consequential work, waiting and risk beyond the unit receiving the improvement credit. Compare the whole affected path and require an explicit account of costs displaced onto partners, customers or unlogged workers.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      A local owner may change its own work but cannot bind a partner unilaterally. Cross-boundary obligations require agreement with the actors bearing them.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-002#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-002#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Mechanism

      Use measures that represent the intended received outcome and material costs, with case mix and affected groups visible. Keep time, effort, quality, flexibility, resilience and fairness distinct where they can move in opposing directions; select justified constraints and priorities rather than pretending all are maximised.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      Accountable decision makers choose priorities with affected-party input; analysts expose measurement limitations rather than choosing values by convenience.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-017#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-017#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-050

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-050

      Mechanism

      Include material environmental and societal consequences in process purpose, boundaries and redesign comparisons. Identify who or what bears these effects and distinguish measured outcomes from reporting capability, commitments or maturity ratings.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      Sponsors and owners decide within legitimate constraints; affected parties and domain experts contribute consequences that internal metrics may omit.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-050#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-050#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-066

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-066

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. A single local metric can conceal burden displacement, unfairness, reduced resilience or worse received outcomes.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      Accountable decision makers choose priorities with affected-party input; analysts expose measurement limitations rather than choosing values by convenience.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-066#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-066#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Mechanism

      Accept an improvement claim only over its declared consequence boundary and protected outcomes. A local gain remains qualified when material receiving-side burdens are unknown; do not aggregate away a harmed group or silently change the boundary to rescue the claim.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      The party claiming benefit cannot unilaterally accept another party’s material burden as harmless.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-069#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-069#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-030

      Mechanism

      Define what evidence is sufficient for the claimed result and distinguish performer declaration, recipient acceptance and independently established effect.

      Bearer

      Performer declarations, commitments, recipient acceptance and established effects

      Authority

      Acceptance is an authorised judgement within a stated scope, not a metaphysical guarantee or substitute for consent.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      A measured efficiency gain does not authorise shifting unacceptable burdens to others.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-071

      Mechanism

      No universal improvement guarantee is established; use EWM-063’s contextual evaluation, retain measured gains and include failed implementations without treating organisational cancellation as proof of engine malfunction.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      Efficiency rhetoric does not settle whose costs count or legitimise every organisational change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-075

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-003

      Mechanism

      Before asserting closure, reconcile the local terminal state with the disposition of work and material external obligations: fulfilled, legitimately waived, transferred or explicitly unresolved under an accepted closure policy.

      Bearer

      Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

      Authority

      Local terminal status is not unilateral permission to waive another participant’s commitment.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-075#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-075#/criticism

      Disposition

      DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-051

      Mechanism

      Compare like with like where possible, disclose subgroup and case-mix differences, and examine how selection, censoring and task allocation affect the result. When comparability fails, narrow the claim instead of normalising away inconvenient differences.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Analyst identifies comparability limits; affected participants and accountable decision makers assess the meaning and acceptable use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-053

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-053

      Mechanism

      Identify who needs the result, what decision it can change and what observation would establish the consequence. Separate analytical delivery, organisational agreement, implemented action and measured outcome; stop or retire an analysis without an adequate consumer.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates evidence and uncertainty; operational actors act within their mandate; outcome measurement must not be replaced by analyst self-report. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-065

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-065

      Mechanism

      Restrict recommendations to actions that the recipient can perform within actual authority, timing and resource constraints; expose uncertainty and alternatives, allow rejection, and observe the action actually taken rather than equating advice with execution.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Operational actors retain the authority specified by the setting; analysts or models cannot grant themselves new powers through recommendations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-077

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-077

      Mechanism

      Limit people-related inference to supported units and legitimate purposes; expose data/metric limitations, assess differential representation and consequences, and provide a meaningful route to challenge or correct material attributions. Treat fairness as a separately specified concern, not a property inferred from conformance.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Affected participants can supply corrections and objections; institutional decision makers remain accountable for use and consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-077#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-077#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-083

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-083

      Mechanism

      Reject universal return. Assess benefits, acquisition and cleaning effort, interpretation, tooling, privacy, organisational response and opportunity cost for the actual purpose; retain negative, null and no-action outcomes.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      The accountable sponsor evaluates value; a vendor case or analyst report cannot establish universal economic authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-083#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-083#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A locally favourable measurement or completion need not establish a favourable received outcome. Organisational purpose, work acceptance and analytical population/effects remain different subjects.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

  • Id

    BWP-K003

    Name

    Process, instance, case and object identity

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-003

    • EBPM:EBPM-009

    • EBPM:EBPM-049

    • EWM:EWM-001

    • EWM:EWM-022

    • EWM:EWM-023

    • EWM:EWM-055

    • EPM:EPM-001

    • EPM:EPM-003

    • EPM:EPM-012

    • EPM:EPM-013

    • EPM:EPM-014

    Shared concern

    Correlations must preserve the unit and multiplicity of the claim.

    Distinction

    BPM work boundaries need not equal a workflow instance or an analytical case; one event may involve several objects.

    Trigger

    Records or responsibilities are joined across representations or scopes.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-003

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-003

      Mechanism

      State what initiates the work, what object or case is being advanced and what counts as completion, cancellation or continuing responsibility. Do not force a single stable case identifier or a terminal event onto open-ended knowledge work without justification.

      Bearer

      Process cases, triggering needs and continuing/completion responsibilities

      Authority

      Operational owners and recipients define business completion; a system administrator defines only the system’s representational boundary.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-003#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-003#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-009

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-009

      Mechanism

      Establish event meaning, case/object attribution, timestamp semantics, extraction scope and known omissions before using event evidence. Keep data-processing transformations traceable and expose activities that the instrumentation cannot observe.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians explain instrumentation; analysts own inference limits; process owners decide whether evidence is adequate for action.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-009#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-009#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Mechanism

      Reconcile the meanings of cases, events, messages and completion across interfaces while limiting disclosure to a justified purpose. Technical schema compatibility is not enough when organisations interpret the same field differently.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians control authorised disclosure; process parties jointly resolve business meaning within their commitments.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-001

      Mechanism

      Bind each transition to its definition version, case, work item and, where relevant, message attempt and external business object; do not substitute one identifier for all of them.

      Bearer

      Bindings among definition versions, instances, work items, messages and external business objects

      Authority

      Identity locates an object; it grants no person or service permission to act on it.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-022

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-022

      Mechanism

      Validate correlation keys and their scopes before accepting a message or callback as a transition for a case; distinguish deduplication from correct association.

      Bearer

      Bindings among definition versions, instances, work items, messages and external business objects

      Authority

      Correct routing neither authenticates the sender nor establishes its authority to request a change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-022#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-022#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-023

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-023

      Mechanism

      Use available case data or interacting business-object states to determine permissible work when a single activity route would hide essential relationships.

      Bearer

      Interacting business-object states and data-centric lifecycle coordination

      Authority

      Object existence does not imply authority to modify its state.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-023#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-023#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-055

      Mechanism

      Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-001

      Mechanism

      For each event class, establish what happened or was recorded, by whom or what, at which lifecycle phase, and with what relation to an actual work episode. Test a small number of material examples against source-system behaviour and domain testimony; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than inventing execution semantics.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-003

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-003

      Mechanism

      State extraction predicates, join cardinalities, event-to-source mappings and inclusion/exclusion rules. Check material counts and sample reconciliations against the operational sources; preserve a route back to excluded or unresolved records.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Data engineer and analyst agree on transformation meaning with the domain consumer; technical ownership of SQL does not authorise redefining the work. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-003#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-003#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-012

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-012

      Mechanism

      Select a case notion according to the question and unit of responsibility; test relevant alternative correlations. When one case cannot retain required object interactions, keep a relational/object-centric representation instead of forcing a convenient identifier.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Analyst and domain consumer choose the unit; the database’s primary key is not an automatic answer to the business question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-012#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-012#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-013

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-013

      Mechanism

      Represent stable object identities and types, event–object participation and needed object–object relations; record qualifiers and temporal attribute changes when relevant. Preserve multiplicity instead of copying a shared event into fictional independent occurrences.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Data custodians establish identity conventions; analysts communicate relation meaning to the process consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-013#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-013#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-014

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-014

      Mechanism

      Inspect shared-event multiplicities, object-to-case cardinalities and artificial directly-follows edges before interpreting a flattened log. Compare the relevant counts or timing in the original relation structure and the flattened view.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Analyst explains distortion to the consumer before a repeated record is interpreted as repeated work. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-014#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-014#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Correlations must preserve the unit and multiplicity of the claim. BPM work boundaries need not equal a workflow instance or an analytical case; one event may involve several objects.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    Current scientific account

    The current directional owner separately examines actual work/identity/history/effect operands and task-produced requirements. A reliable identity or record supplies a partial premise; clocks, capture, reference authority and the consumer-specific conclusion remain to establish.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K004

    Name

    Representation selected for its use

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-010

    • EBPM:EBPM-011

    • EBPM:EBPM-012

    • EBPM:EBPM-013

    • EBPM:EBPM-063

    • EWM:EWM-012

    • EWM:EWM-018

    • EWM:EWM-041

    • EWM:EWM-061

    • EWM:EWM-066

    • EPM:EPM-016

    • EPM:EPM-017

    • EPM:EPM-026

    • EPM:EPM-042

    Shared concern

    Representation adequacy is relative to a consumer and protected distinction, not appearance or size.

    Distinction

    BPM meaning/comprehension, engine behaviour and analytical abstraction require different validation oracles.

    Trigger

    A representation is substituted, simplified or offered as evidence for a new use.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-010

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-010

      Mechanism

      Choose the representation and abstraction by the decision it must support and the people who must use it. Preserve the distinctions needed for that task; a narrative, table, decision model, process graph or case representation can be adequate without being interchangeable.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      The intended users help judge fitness; a notation specialist cannot infer business authority from technical sophistication.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-010#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-010#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Mechanism

      Check notation well-formedness separately from fidelity to the intended domain and understandability for the intended user. Use the corresponding test for each claim; one kind of validity cannot stand in for the others.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Tool validators assess encoded rules; domain experts assess meaning; users demonstrate comprehension. None alone certifies the other dimensions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-012

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-012

      Mechanism

      Reduce unnecessary representational complexity while preserving decision-relevant behaviour and relationships. Test the simplified form with its users; use modularisation or multiple coordinated views when a single small diagram would conceal essential interactions.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Modellers propose changes; users and domain experts check that useful meaning has not been lost.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-012#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-012#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_BUREAUCRATISED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-013

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-013

      Mechanism

      Use terms that distinguish what action or decision occurs and what object is affected, in the intended users’ language. Resolve ambiguous domain terms before standardising a label grammar; test important labels through concrete cases.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Domain participants determine meaning; model maintainers ensure consistent use without overriding legitimate local terminology.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-013#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-013#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-063

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. The 7PMG recommendation is not a universal discontinuity in comprehension or correctness; user, task, semantics and decomposition costs matter.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Modellers propose changes; users and domain experts check that useful meaning has not been lost.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      SUPERSEDED_BY_STRONGER_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-012

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-012

      Mechanism

      Select a modelling form that preserves the needed behaviours and supports an affordable verification/explanation method.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Notation choice creates no operational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-012#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-012#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-018

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-018

      Mechanism

      Check the employed constructs and combinations against actual engine/version behaviour, including regressions, extensions and replay constraints.

      Bearer

      Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

      Authority

      Product branding is not an authority to assert untested semantics.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-018#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-018#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-041

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-041

      Mechanism

      Declare the portability layer—diagram, interchange syntax, executable subset, data bindings or runtime interaction—and test the layer actually relied upon.

      Bearer

      Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

      Authority

      A standard name is not evidence of conformance at every layer or permission to move data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-041#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-041#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-061

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-061

      Mechanism

      Inspect the used abstraction’s execution, data, extension and exit boundaries before relying on visual simplicity or claimed portability.

      Bearer

      Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

      Authority

      An accessible editor does not authorise the user to automate every connected action.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-061#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-061#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-066

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-066

      Mechanism

      No independent correctness mechanism is supplied by the artefact’s presence; retain only the communication or executable-semantic function it demonstrably serves.

      Bearer

      Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

      Authority

      A badge or drawing confers no permission or verified outcome.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-066#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-066#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-004

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-004

      Mechanism

      Choose an activity vocabulary at the level of the decision, retain the mapping from raw observations to abstract events, and test whether material conclusions survive a plausible finer or coarser alternative. Treat an abstract event as a derived object, not a newly observed fact.

      Bearer

      Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

      Authority

      Analyst proposes abstraction; domain participants test whether the resulting distinctions are sufficient for the decision. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-004#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-004#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-016

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-016

      Mechanism

      Compare candidate representations against the actual distinction required, data availability, interpretation burden and computational cost. Prefer the least costly representation that preserves the consequential relation, not necessarily the fewest nodes.

      Bearer

      Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

      Authority

      Analyst and consumer jointly select a representation; maximal expressiveness is not a delegated objective. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-016#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-016#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-017

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-004

      Mechanism

      Resolve this candidate to EPM-004. Its activity-level trigger and protected failure are identical; preserve the PM2 provenance and avoid creating another mechanism or audit obligation.

      Bearer

      Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

      Authority

      Corpus reviewer maintains the denominator while avoiding double counting. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-017#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-017#/criticism

      Disposition

      DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-026

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-026

      Mechanism

      Simplify a process view according to its communicative purpose, retain access to suppressed detail, and label the result as an abstraction rather than a complete executable specification. Test whether the consumer can answer the intended question.

      Bearer

      Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

      Authority

      Analyst constructs the view; participants judge its adequacy for the discussion, not merely its visual attractiveness. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-026#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-026#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-042

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-042

      Mechanism

      Evaluate simplicity relative to the consumer’s task and notation knowledge; inspect whether required distinctions and important exceptions remain accessible. Consider interpretive and maintenance burden, not only structural size.

      Bearer

      Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

      Authority

      The actual consumer supplies evidence of usability; analysts should not substitute aesthetic preference for task performance. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-042#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-042#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Representation adequacy is relative to a consumer and protected distinction, not appearance or size. BPM meaning/comprehension, engine behaviour and analytical abstraction require different validation oracles.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

  • Id

    BWP-K005

    Name

    Performed work and observation omissions

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-006

    • EBPM:EBPM-008

    • EBPM:EBPM-009

    • EBPM:EBPM-047

    • EBPM:EBPM-062

    • EWM:EWM-031

    • EWM:EWM-055

    • EWM:EWM-058

    • EWM:EWM-068

    • EPM:EPM-001

    • EPM:EPM-003

    • EPM:EPM-008

    • EPM:EPM-027

    • EPM:EPM-071

    • EPM:EPM-074

    Shared concern

    A record or model must not define away consequential work it cannot observe.

    Distinction

    Participant testimony, performed work and sampled events can disagree without one being universally privileged.

    Trigger

    An as-is account or evidence claim risks excluding variants, recording gaps or off-system work.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-006

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-006

      Mechanism

      Compare interviews, documents, walkthroughs, direct observation and event evidence where they reveal different aspects of work. Record provenance and disagreement; neither a remembered account, a prescription nor an event log is intrinsically the whole truth.

      Bearer

      Accounts of performed work, variants and observations outside current models

      Authority

      Analysts synthesise evidence; performers and recipients can correct it. Sponsorship does not entitle an analyst to dismiss inconvenient observations.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-006#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-006#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-008

      Mechanism

      Sample materially different case types, failure paths and informal coordination. State which variants are covered and which remain uncertain; do not infer that rare or unlogged work is irrelevant simply because it is absent from a convenient sample.

      Bearer

      Accounts of performed work, variants and observations outside current models

      Authority

      Process investigators select cases with performers and recipients; owners accept the resulting uncertainty or commission further inquiry.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-009

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-009

      Mechanism

      Establish event meaning, case/object attribution, timestamp semantics, extraction scope and known omissions before using event evidence. Keep data-processing transformations traceable and expose activities that the instrumentation cannot observe.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians explain instrumentation; analysts own inference limits; process owners decide whether evidence is adequate for action.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-009#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-009#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-047

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-047

      Mechanism

      Keep a route by which observations outside the current model—complaints, practitioner accounts, recipient experience and unlogged work—can challenge both the representation and the success measure. Do not let the model define all admissible evidence about its own adequacy.

      Bearer

      Accounts of performed work, variants and observations outside current models

      Authority

      Evidence contributors may challenge a model; revision remains an authorised decision rather than automatic acceptance of every complaint.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-047#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-047#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-062

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-062

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Event recording is selective, case identity can misfit work and off-system coordination may be essential.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians explain instrumentation; analysts own inference limits; process owners decide whether evidence is adequate for action.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-062#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-062#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-031

      Mechanism

      Include participants in defining and revising workflow support, and provide a way to handle legitimate work outside the prescription without pretending it never happened.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Discretion has boundaries; recognising situated work does not authorise every deviation.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-055

      Mechanism

      Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-058

      Mechanism

      Identify the observation boundary and connect consequential claims to an appropriate external or participant source; preserve uncertainty when correspondence cannot be checked.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      An observer need not have authority to act, and a model’s certainty cannot replace a participant’s legitimate judgement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-068

      Mechanism

      No such general property exists; scope the history to observed events and couple stronger claims to appropriate external evidence.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      An internal record cannot overrule facts or testimony it never observed merely by being durable.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-001

      Mechanism

      For each event class, establish what happened or was recorded, by whom or what, at which lifecycle phase, and with what relation to an actual work episode. Test a small number of material examples against source-system behaviour and domain testimony; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than inventing execution semantics.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-003

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-003

      Mechanism

      State extraction predicates, join cardinalities, event-to-source mappings and inclusion/exclusion rules. Check material counts and sample reconciliations against the operational sources; preserve a route back to excluded or unresolved records.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Data engineer and analyst agree on transformation meaning with the domain consumer; technical ownership of SQL does not authorise redefining the work. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-003#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-003#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-008

      Mechanism

      Declare the target population and observation window; distinguish cases, events, objects and decision occasions; examine inclusion, censoring, unlogged work and changes in capture. Match the strength of a conclusion to the actual observation process.

      Bearer

      Analytical target population, unit and observation/censoring process

      Authority

      The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-027

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-027

      Mechanism

      Classify low-frequency behaviour by relevance to the question before suppressing it; retain or separately analyse material exceptions and expose the effect of filtering on the conclusion. Do not require keeping every rare record in every main view.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Domain participants explain consequence and authorisation; the miner supplies frequency, not importance. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-027#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-027#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-071

      Mechanism

      Present traceable findings and competing explanations to relevant domain participants, including affected parties where people-related claims matter; record corrections, disagreement and evidence requested. Use focused challenge rather than treating agreement as truth.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Participants contribute situated evidence; authority to decide or revise policy remains distinct from expertise or seniority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-074

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-074

      Mechanism

      Separate traceability and computational reproducibility from semantic, population, model and causal validity. Use auditability to expose assumptions and reproduce a challenge, not as a replacement for evidence about them.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Analyst and reviewer use custody evidence to examine claims; no actor receives extra substantive authority merely by maintaining a log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-074#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-074#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A record or model must not define away consequential work it cannot observe. Participant testimony, performed work and sampled events can disagree without one being universally privileged.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

  • Id

    BWP-K006

    Name

    Participant challenge and disagreement

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-007

    • EBPM:EBPM-035

    • EBPM:EBPM-038

    • EWM:EWM-031

    • EWM:EWM-033

    • EWM:EWM-077

    • EPM:EPM-029

    • EPM:EPM-071

    • EPM:EPM-077

    Shared concern

    Relevant participants can challenge a representation or attribution without consensus becoming a truth oracle.

    Distinction

    Design participation, authorised repair and analytical challenge have different decision rights.

    Trigger

    Material domain or people-related interpretations are contested or need validation.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-007

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-007

      Mechanism

      Test a representation with people who perform, receive and coordinate the work using concrete cases and exceptions. Preserve disagreement about facts, goals and authority separately; endorsement of a picture is not evidence of shared decision meaning.

      Bearer

      Participant validation, learning and consequential participation arrangements

      Authority

      Participants validate their knowledge, not necessarily the whole process; sponsors resolve authorised choices without erasing dissent.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-007#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-007#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-035

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-035

      Mechanism

      Involve those performing and receiving work in discovery, redesign and evaluation; provide skills and incentives that permit the intended behaviour. Treat participation as consequential influence and learning, not attendance or consultation without effect.

      Bearer

      Participant validation, learning and consequential participation arrangements

      Authority

      Sponsors resource participation; performers contribute operational knowledge; consultation does not erase formal accountability.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-035#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-035#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-038

      Mechanism

      Limit process visibility and automated judgements to a declared purpose with appropriate access, participation and challenge. Examine privacy, surveillance, fairness and worker/recipient burdens as design consequences, not external afterthoughts.

      Bearer

      Process visibility, appraisal, incentives and affected-person protection

      Authority

      Managers do not acquire unlimited surveillance authority through technical availability; applicable professional, organisational and legal constraints require separate determination.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-031

      Mechanism

      Include participants in defining and revising workflow support, and provide a way to handle legitimate work outside the prescription without pretending it never happened.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Discretion has boundaries; recognising situated work does not authorise every deviation.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-033

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-033

      Mechanism

      Route unmodelled situations to an actor who can examine current state, authorise a bounded repair and record its consequences before resuming or revising the definition.

      Bearer

      Exception handlers, bounded repairs and interruption/cancellation scope

      Authority

      The ability to edit state is not permission to change business obligations or other people’s work.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-033#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-033#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-077

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-077

      Mechanism

      Use explicit request, commitment, declaration and acceptance distinctions when different participants need to agree what work is owed and whether it has been satisfied.

      Bearer

      Performer declarations, commitments, recipient acceptance and established effects

      Authority

      A recorded acceptance does not prove uncoerced consent, objective correctness or authority outside the relationship.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-077#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-077#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-029

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-029

      Mechanism

      Use domain knowledge to propose constraints, abstractions or candidate interpretations, label its origin and test its consequences against event evidence. Keep observed, inferred and prescribed statements separate when adjusting a model.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Domain experts supply contextual knowledge; the relevant institutional actor—not the analyst—authorises prescriptive rules. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-029#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-029#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-071

      Mechanism

      Present traceable findings and competing explanations to relevant domain participants, including affected parties where people-related claims matter; record corrections, disagreement and evidence requested. Use focused challenge rather than treating agreement as truth.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Participants contribute situated evidence; authority to decide or revise policy remains distinct from expertise or seniority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-077

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-077

      Mechanism

      Limit people-related inference to supported units and legitimate purposes; expose data/metric limitations, assess differential representation and consequences, and provide a meaningful route to challenge or correct material attributions. Treat fairness as a separately specified concern, not a property inferred from conformance.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Affected participants can supply corrections and objections; institutional decision makers remain accountable for use and consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-077#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-077#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Relevant participants can challenge a representation or attribution without consensus becoming a truth oracle. Design participation, authorised repair and analytical challenge have different decision rights.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    Name

    Model, engine and analytical truth separation

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-011

    • EBPM:EBPM-014

    • EBPM:EBPM-057

    • EWM:EWM-002

    • EWM:EWM-018

    • EPM:EPM-045

    • EPM:EPM-074

    Shared concern

    Validity of one representation cannot certify another bearer or use.

    Distinction

    Well-formed notation, supported executable subset, observational fit and business truth are non-equivalent.

    Trigger

    A model is translated, executed or used to warrant a stronger claim.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Mechanism

      Check notation well-formedness separately from fidelity to the intended domain and understandability for the intended user. Use the corresponding test for each claim; one kind of validity cannot stand in for the others.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Tool validators assess encoded rules; domain experts assess meaning; users demonstrate comprehension. None alone certifies the other dimensions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-014

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-014

      Mechanism

      Declare whether a model communicates, analyses or drives execution, and identify the additional implementation semantics and organisational arrangements needed to move between those uses. Keep engine events and real completion separate until their correspondence is demonstrated.

      Bearer

      The modelling-versus-execution contract between a process representation, enactment and actual work

      Authority

      Implementers control deployed semantics within their authority; process owners and recipients establish real obligations and completion criteria.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-014#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-014#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-057

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-057

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Syntax, execution semantics, domain accuracy, authority and actual enactment are distinct.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      EPM:EPM-074

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-074

      Mechanism

      Separate traceability and computational reproducibility from semantic, population, model and causal validity. Use auditability to expose assumptions and reproduce a challenge, not as a replacement for evidence about them.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Analyst and reviewer use custody evidence to examine claims; no actor receives extra substantive authority merely by maintaining a log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      EPM:EPM-074#/evidence_limit

      EPM:EPM-074#/criticism
