      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Validity of one representation cannot certify another bearer or use. Well-formed notation, supported executable subset, observational fit and business truth are non-equivalent.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    None recorded.

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use.     R4 scientific integration

    Shared concern

    A transition or decision requires the right information and interpretation at its actual decision occasion.

    Distinction

    Routing predicates, rule authority and observation-time features differ even where they use the same data.

    Trigger

    Branching, changed order or analytical inference depends on data availability and binding.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-015

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-015

      Mechanism

      Where decision rules vary independently of routing, distinguish the information/rules used to decide from the actor authorised to decide and from the consequences of that decision. Keep a traceable connection between a decision model and the process consuming its result.

      Bearer

      Decision rules, their consumers and separately authorised decision-makers

      Authority

      A rule author or prediction service is not automatically the legitimate decision maker; accountable actors retain domain-specific authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-015#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-015#/criticism

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

      EBPM:EBPM-025

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-025

      Mechanism

      Move an activity only after checking information, resource, commitment and protective dependencies. Early screening can avoid downstream effort, while premature action can create irrecoverable commitments.

      Bearer

      Task order and information/resource/commitment dependencies

      Authority

      Operational owners coordinate changes across the functions whose inputs or commitments move.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-025#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-025#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

      Mechanism

      Where the chosen formalism supports it, check that the combined constraints admit appropriate executions and that a changed instance specification remains compatible with its recorded history. Separate formal satisfiability and dead-activity checks from the truth, completeness and legitimacy of the encoded constraints.

      Bearer

      Formal declarative constraints and history-compatible instance specifications

      Authority

      Analysts check encoded behaviour; accountable domain actors decide which constraints should apply and whether a departure is authorised.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-073#/criticism

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-024

      Mechanism

      Mine supported finite-trace constraints with explicit activation semantics, distinguish satisfaction from meaningful activation, and check redundancy and consistency before interpretation. Treat a discovered constraint as a descriptive hypothesis unless independently authorised.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst explains rule semantics; domain participants evaluate meaningful activation; rule authority is a separate decision. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-034

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-034

      Mechanism

      Compare control-flow and relevant data/resource/time constraints jointly where the formalism supports them, with explicit cross-perspective costs. Diagnose which interpretation changes when a missing or inconsistent attribute is considered.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst establishes joint comparison; domain or rule authority interprets the guard and its consequence. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-034#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-034#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-060

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-060

      Mechanism

      Define the prediction occasion and information available at that moment, including attribute update histories and cross-case state. Construct features and labels accordingly; keep post-outcome or future-derived information outside the predictor and its tuning.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Predictive analyst establishes temporal eligibility; operational consumer confirms when information and action opportunities actually exist. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-060#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-060#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A transition or decision requires the right information and interpretation at its actual decision occasion. Routing predicates, rule authority and observation-time features differ even where they use the same data.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

  • Id

    BWP-K009

    Name

    Concurrency, synchronisation and partial order

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-025

    • EBPM:EBPM-026

    • EWM:EWM-007

    • EWM:EWM-008

    • EWM:EWM-009

    • EPM:EPM-034

    Shared concern

    Parallel, repeated or multi-object work cannot be represented safely by an invented serial order.

    Distinction

    Execution arbitrates or coordinates; event analysis can only infer orders warranted by recorded evidence.

    Trigger

    Overlapping work, branch joins, ties or repeated activations materially affect the claim.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-025

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-025

      Mechanism

      Move an activity only after checking information, resource, commitment and protective dependencies. Early screening can avoid downstream effort, while premature action can create irrecoverable commitments.

      Bearer

      Task order and information/resource/commitment dependencies

      Authority

      Operational owners coordinate changes across the functions whose inputs or commitments move.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-025#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-025#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-026

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-026

      Mechanism

      Execute genuinely independent activities concurrently while specifying how their outputs are joined, what happens on disagreement or partial failure, and whether resources can sustain the overlap.

      Bearer

      Concurrent activities, joins and resulting partial effects

      Authority

      The owner arranges cross-team commitments; each performer retains authority over its own result.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-026#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-026#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-007

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-007

      Mechanism

      Choose join semantics for the actual activation and re-entry model, specifying which branch arrivals are required, which remain possible and when the join resets.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Join firing establishes a coordination condition, not success of each outside action.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-007#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-007#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-008

      Mechanism

      Track distinct child instances, permitted dynamic creation, completion threshold and the disposition of remaining children after the threshold is reached.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Reaching a threshold does not authorise cancelling independently owned work or erasing its effects.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-009

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-009

      Mechanism

      Define which events compete, how a winner is committed and how late losing events are ignored, rejected or routed to another valid state.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Winning an internal race does not retract a request already accepted elsewhere.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-009#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-009#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-010

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-010

      Mechanism

      Identify the actual shared resource or invariant and exclude conflicting overlap at that scope while allowing irrelevant concurrency.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      A per-case critical section does not automatically exclude other cases or independent applications.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-010#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-010#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-011

      Mechanism

      Distinguish repeated activations and recursive parent-child scopes, define exit conditions and separate the existence of an exit path from inevitable termination.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Re-entry does not renew expired external authority automatically.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-013

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-013

      Mechanism

      When a branch is cancelled, update join obligations according to the declared scope and activation rather than pretending that cancellation produced a success token.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Only the actor entitled to change the coordination obligation may dispense with a required branch.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-013#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-013#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-006

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-006

      Mechanism

      Use the strongest ordering supported by the evidence: a total order where justified, an explicit partial order or bounded alternatives otherwise. Keep tie-breaking separate from observed chronology and test sensitivity when an algorithm requires a sequence.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst exposes ordering alternatives to the consumer; system timestamps alone do not settle the real chronology. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-006#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-006#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-013

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-013

      Mechanism

      Represent stable object identities and types, event–object participation and needed object–object relations; record qualifiers and temporal attribute changes when relevant. Preserve multiplicity instead of copying a shared event into fictional independent occurrences.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Data custodians establish identity conventions; analysts communicate relation meaning to the process consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-013#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-013#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-014

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-014

      Mechanism

      Inspect shared-event multiplicities, object-to-case cardinalities and artificial directly-follows edges before interpreting a flattened log. Compare the relevant counts or timing in the original relation structure and the flattened view.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Analyst explains distortion to the consumer before a repeated record is interpreted as repeated work. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-014#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-014#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-028

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-028

      Mechanism

      State observational equivalence and the limits of the sampled behaviour. Where competing models make different consequential predictions, seek discriminating data or domain evidence; otherwise retain alternatives or a weaker conclusion rather than asserting unique recovery.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates what is and is not identified; domain evidence can discriminate but must not be silently smuggled into the log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-028#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-028#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

  • Id

    BWP-K010

    Name

    Loops and non-DAG behaviour

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-005

    • EBPM:EBPM-016

    • EBPM:EBPM-020

    • EBPM:EBPM-026

    • EWM:EWM-007

    • EWM:EWM-011

    • EWM:EWM-012

    • EWM:EWM-064

    • EPM:EPM-019

    • EPM:EPM-020

    • EPM:EPM-024

    • EPM:EPM-028

    • EPM:EPM-030

    Shared concern

    A chosen representation must preserve needed loops and cross-dependencies.

    Distinction

    A restricted formalism can be useful; restricting all work to it is not justified.

    Trigger

    The model language excludes possible re-entry, non-free-choice or cross-cutting dependencies.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Mechanism

      Represent process families, decomposition and interfaces at the abstraction needed for coordination. Preserve cross-cutting dependencies when decomposing and adapt reference architectures to actual work rather than treating a borrowed map as an empirical description.

      Bearer

      Process architecture and cross-process dependencies

      Authority

      Enterprise/process coordinators maintain the map with local expertise; the architecture does not override functional or contractual authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Mechanism

      Select support according to what can be known in advance: goals and information needs, mandatory constraints, planned tasks or a stable flow. Allow structured sub-processes inside knowledge work and avoid making flexibility equivalent to the absence of guidance.

      Bearer

      Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

      Authority

      Case workers plan within professional and organisational authority; system flexibility does not grant new powers.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-016#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-016#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-020

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-020

      Mechanism

      Trace how a handoff, missing information or rejected output generates delay and repeated work. Distinguish avoidable rework from necessary checking, learning or repair before changing task boundaries or removing feedback.

      Bearer

      Handoff and rework mechanisms, including necessary repair/checking

      Authority

      Sending and receiving actors jointly identify the mechanism; an owner needs authority or agreement to change both sides.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-020#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-020#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-026

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-026

      Mechanism

      Execute genuinely independent activities concurrently while specifying how their outputs are joined, what happens on disagreement or partial failure, and whether resources can sustain the overlap.

      Bearer

      Concurrent activities, joins and resulting partial effects

      Authority

      The owner arranges cross-team commitments; each performer retains authority over its own result.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-026#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-026#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-007

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-007

      Mechanism

      Choose join semantics for the actual activation and re-entry model, specifying which branch arrivals are required, which remain possible and when the join resets.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Join firing establishes a coordination condition, not success of each outside action.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-007#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-007#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-011

      Mechanism

      Distinguish repeated activations and recursive parent-child scopes, define exit conditions and separate the existence of an exit path from inevitable termination.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Re-entry does not renew expired external authority automatically.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-012

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-012

      Mechanism

      Select a modelling form that preserves the needed behaviours and supports an affordable verification/explanation method.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Notation choice creates no operational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-012#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-012#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-064

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-064

      Mechanism

      No general mechanism survives this restriction; select a DAG only for a scope whose behaviour is genuinely acyclic, or label it a finite expansion of a richer process.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      A tidy representation cannot redefine the real authority or responsibilities of participants.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-064#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-064#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-019

      Mechanism

      State the model language, search space, objective, noise handling and assumptions before interpreting discovered structure. Separate properties guaranteed by construction from properties inferred from the sample and from domain claims requiring external evidence.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Model producer communicates inductive bias to the analyst and decision consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-020

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-020

      Mechanism

      Do not use original alpha as the universal default. Retain it as an explanatory baseline or for inputs satisfying its scoped conditions; select extensions or alternative miners according to the actual noise, loops and construct requirements.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst selects the method; foundational status is not evidence that it is the best operational choice. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-020#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-020#/criticism

      Disposition

      SUPERSEDED_BY_STRONGER_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-022

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-022

      Mechanism

      Use a sound-by-construction structured representation where its expressiveness is adequate; distinguish the construction’s soundness guarantee from conditions for rediscovery and from correspondence to actual work. Record fall-through or noise-handling choices that affect the result.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Algorithm establishes its scoped construction property; analyst and domain consumer judge whether the representation fits the question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-022#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-022#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-023

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-023

      Mechanism

      Formulate candidate regions and place constraints as an optimisation/synthesis problem; choose objective, admissible regions and noise treatment explicitly, then inspect the behavioural implications of the resulting net.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Model analyst chooses the formal objective; a solver’s optimum is not an organisational objective by default. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-023#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-023#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-024

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-024

      Mechanism

      Mine supported finite-trace constraints with explicit activation semantics, distinguish satisfaction from meaningful activation, and check redundancy and consistency before interpretation. Treat a discovered constraint as a descriptive hypothesis unless independently authorised.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst explains rule semantics; domain participants evaluate meaningful activation; rule authority is a separate decision. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-028

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-028

      Mechanism

      State observational equivalence and the limits of the sampled behaviour. Where competing models make different consequential predictions, seek discriminating data or domain evidence; otherwise retain alternatives or a weaker conclusion rather than asserting unique recovery.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates what is and is not identified; domain evidence can discriminate but must not be silently smuggled into the log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-028#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-028#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-030

      Mechanism

      Discover or analyse bounded fragments with explicit event selection and boundary semantics; identify shared events and interactions omitted by the decomposition. Recompose only when compatibility and the consumer’s global question are actually addressed.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates what a local result does not say; the consumer decides whether a global conclusion is needed. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A chosen representation must preserve needed loops and cross-dependencies. A restricted formalism can be useful; restricting all work to it is not justified.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

  • Id

    BWP-K011

    Name

    Formal guarantees and their quantifiers

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-011

    • EBPM:EBPM-014

    • EBPM:EBPM-073

    • EWM:EWM-015

    • EWM:EWM-016

    • EWM:EWM-017

    • EWM:EWM-019

    • EPM:EPM-015

    • EPM:EPM-019

    • EPM:EPM-022

    • EPM:EPM-023

    • EPM:EPM-024

    • EPM:EPM-035

    Shared concern

    A model-bounded guarantee is not actual progress, correct data or business success.

    Distinction

    Workflow soundness, discovery construction, uncertainty bounds and history consistency quantify over different structures.

    Trigger

    A formal verdict is relied on across a representation, population or deployment boundary.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Mechanism

      Check notation well-formedness separately from fidelity to the intended domain and understandability for the intended user. Use the corresponding test for each claim; one kind of validity cannot stand in for the others.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Tool validators assess encoded rules; domain experts assess meaning; users demonstrate comprehension. None alone certifies the other dimensions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-014

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-014

      Mechanism

      Declare whether a model communicates, analyses or drives execution, and identify the additional implementation semantics and organisational arrangements needed to move between those uses. Keep engine events and real completion separate until their correspondence is demonstrated.

      Bearer

      The modelling-versus-execution contract between a process representation, enactment and actual work

      Authority

      Implementers control deployed semantics within their authority; process owners and recipients establish real obligations and completion criteria.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-014#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-014#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-073

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-073

      Mechanism

      Where the chosen formalism supports it, check that the combined constraints admit appropriate executions and that a changed instance specification remains compatible with its recorded history. Separate formal satisfiability and dead-activity checks from the truth, completeness and legitimacy of the encoded constraints.

      Bearer

      Formal declarative constraints and history-compatible instance specifications

      Authority

      Analysts check encoded behaviour; accountable domain actors decide which constraints should apply and whether a departure is authorised.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-073#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-015

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-015

      Mechanism

      Check the exact WF-net definition: every reachable marking has some path to the final marking, final completion leaves no residual tokens, and every transition can occur in some execution.

      Bearer

      Workflow-model verification, soundness quantifiers and proof/reduction assumptions

      Authority

      A soundness verdict neither authorises tasks nor supplies resources, deadlines or successful external action.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-015#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-015#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-016

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-016

      Mechanism

      Select the initial population and quantifiers explicitly; add fairness, resource, time or ranking assumptions only when the required guarantee actually needs them.

      Bearer

      Workflow-model verification, soundness quantifiers and proof/reduction assumptions

      Authority

      Fairness assumptions concern execution policy/environment; a proof cannot compel a human to perform work.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-016#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-016#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-017

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-017

      Mechanism

      Choose an analysis method that preserves the target property and record abstraction, reduction and compositional assumptions; complement it with implementation tests where needed.

      Bearer

      Workflow-model verification, soundness quantifiers and proof/reduction assumptions

      Authority

      Verification approves a stated model claim, not uncontrolled operational changes.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-017#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-017#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-019

      Mechanism

      Assess whether eligible resources and time assumptions can support the enabled work, and specify what happens when they cannot.

      Bearer

      Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

      Authority

      Availability cannot be conjured by assigning a role; escalating does not grant competence or permission.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-015

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-015

      Mechanism

      Choose the exact object-centric formalism and required guarantee; distinguish type-level tokens from identifier-aware semantics and prove or test only the obligations that formalism states. Treat discovery, soundness and correspondence to real interactions as different claims.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Model analyst establishes formal properties; domain participants check identity interpretations; neither formal result grants intervention authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-015#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-015#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-019

      Mechanism

      State the model language, search space, objective, noise handling and assumptions before interpreting discovered structure. Separate properties guaranteed by construction from properties inferred from the sample and from domain claims requiring external evidence.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Model producer communicates inductive bias to the analyst and decision consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-022

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-022

      Mechanism

      Use a sound-by-construction structured representation where its expressiveness is adequate; distinguish the construction’s soundness guarantee from conditions for rediscovery and from correspondence to actual work. Record fall-through or noise-handling choices that affect the result.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Algorithm establishes its scoped construction property; analyst and domain consumer judge whether the representation fits the question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-022#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-022#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-023

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-023

      Mechanism

      Formulate candidate regions and place constraints as an optimisation/synthesis problem; choose objective, admissible regions and noise treatment explicitly, then inspect the behavioural implications of the resulting net.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Model analyst chooses the formal objective; a solver’s optimum is not an organisational objective by default. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-023#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-023#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-024

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-024

      Mechanism

      Mine supported finite-trace constraints with explicit activation semantics, distinguish satisfaction from meaningful activation, and check redundancy and consistency before interpretation. Treat a discovered constraint as a descriptive hypothesis unless independently authorised.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst explains rule semantics; domain participants evaluate meaningful activation; rule authority is a separate decision. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-035

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-035

      Mechanism

      Represent the admitted event uncertainties and compute or approximate lower and upper conformance costs across supported realisations. Report what holds for all, some or none of those realisations without assigning unsupported probabilities.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst explains bound semantics; the consumer decides whether the interval is informative enough to act on. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-035#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-035#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A model-bounded guarantee is not actual progress, correct data or business success. Workflow soundness, discovery construction, uncertainty bounds and history consistency quantify over different structures.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

  • Id

    BWP-K012

    Name

    Capacity, case mix and delays

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-018

    • EBPM:EBPM-019

    • EBPM:EBPM-028

    • EBPM:EBPM-029

    • EBPM:EBPM-059

    • EWM:EWM-019

    • EWM:EWM-028

    • EWM:EWM-063

    • EPM:EPM-046

    • EPM:EPM-047

    • EPM:EPM-048

    • EPM:EPM-051

    • EPM:EPM-063

    Shared concern

    Observed delay, feasible scheduling and supported bottleneck explanation are different claims.

    Distinction

    BPM redesign considers received delay; workflow assigns scarce resources; mining observes and diagnoses with missing-context limits.

    Trigger

    Demand, calendars, case mix, competition or queues affect an intervention or attribution.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-018

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-018

      Mechanism

      Separate elapsed time experienced by the case or recipient from active work effort and resource occupancy. Locate waiting, transfer and rework contributions before attributing delay to an actor or deciding which activity to accelerate.

      Bearer

      Elapsed process time, effort and resource occupancy claims

      Authority

      Analysts interpret time evidence with performers; owners can change allocation or handoff arrangements within their authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-018#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-018#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-019

      Mechanism

      Examine demand, service variation, shared capacity and allocation rules together before adding resources or seeking maximum utilisation. Use a queueing model or simulation only when its assumptions represent the relevant work; recheck the end-to-end constraint after a local change.

      Bearer

      Capacity/queueing/simulation model and conditional intervention predictions

      Authority

      Resource managers can change capacity and assignment; analysts supply conditional predictions, not authority to alter staffing or worker obligations.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-028

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-028

      Mechanism

      Compare shared capacity and consistency benefits with queueing, local-knowledge loss, authority distance and a larger failure domain. Select central, local or federated arrangements according to the actual dependency and demand structure.

      Bearer

      Case coordination, allocation, pooling and segmentation arrangements

      Authority

      Shared-service governance must have authority to allocate capacity and a route for local concerns.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-028#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-028#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-029

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-029

      Mechanism

      Separate materially different cases where this improves fit, but validate classification quality and the burdens imposed on difficult or disadvantaged cases. Reassess class boundaries when demand changes.

      Bearer

      Case coordination, allocation, pooling and segmentation arrangements

      Authority

      Classification and resource-allocation decisions require accountable authority; analysts do not define acceptable exclusion alone.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-029#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-029#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-059

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-059

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Variability, bottlenecks and queues make utilisation alone an inadequate end-to-end objective; the relevant model assumptions must be checked.

      Bearer

      Capacity/queueing/simulation model and conditional intervention predictions

      Authority

      Resource managers can change capacity and assignment; analysts supply conditional predictions, not authority to alter staffing or worker obligations.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-059#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-059#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-019

      Mechanism

      Assess whether eligible resources and time assumptions can support the enabled work, and specify what happens when they cannot.

      Bearer

      Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

      Authority

      Availability cannot be conjured by assigning a role; escalating does not grant competence or permission.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-028

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-028

      Mechanism

      Relate queue policy and escalation to actual capacity, calendars and service needs; surface starvation and overload rather than optimising only local throughput.

      Bearer

      Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

      Authority

      Escalation requests a decision; it does not authorise bypassing duty or competence requirements.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-028#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-028#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      A measured efficiency gain does not authorise shifting unacceptable burdens to others.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-046

      Mechanism

      Define each duration by its observed endpoints and lifecycle semantics; distinguish throughput, waiting, service and unobserved time. Attribute elapsed intervals only where the data and model support the attribution, and retain missing intervals as missing.

      Bearer

      Observed/inferred time, queues and candidate bottleneck explanations

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff agree what the time measure denotes before it is used as evidence of effort or blame. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-047

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-047

      Mechanism

      Use the process trace to generate candidate bottleneck explanations, then check omitted prerequisites, calendars, case mix and recording practices. Distinguish the location of an observed delay from a supported causal explanation and from an effective remedy.

      Bearer

      Observed/inferred time, queues and candidate bottleneck explanations

      Authority

      Analyst reports the pattern; operational participants provide contextual evidence; authorised managers decide on interventions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-047#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-047#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-048

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-048

      Mechanism

      Include inter-case or inter-object context when it materially affects the interpretation of queues and delays; stratify or annotate by relevant load, batching and relation states. Keep inferred context distinct from directly observed resource states.

      Bearer

      Observed/inferred time, queues and candidate bottleneck explanations

      Authority

      Analyst and operational consumer decide which context explains the decision-relevant variation. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-048#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-048#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-051

      Mechanism

      Compare like with like where possible, disclose subgroup and case-mix differences, and examine how selection, censoring and task allocation affect the result. When comparability fails, narrow the claim instead of normalising away inconvenient differences.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Analyst identifies comparability limits; affected participants and accountable decision makers assess the meaning and acceptable use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate predictive utility at actual decision times, accounting for lead time, false alarms, intervention capacity and opportunity cost. Choose thresholds or policies against an explicit decision objective rather than accuracy alone.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Operational authority specifies available actions and resource limits; the analyst evaluates decision support within those bounds. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Observed delay, feasible scheduling and supported bottleneck explanation are different claims. BPM redesign considers received delay; workflow assigns scarce resources; mining observes and diagnoses with missing-context limits.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    Shared concern

    An interval or lifecycle declaration does not identify effort or effective work.

    Distinction

    Task responsibility and recorded intervals differ from unobserved multitasking or receiving-side effect.

    Trigger

    Duration or productivity is inferred from task or event lifecycle data.

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-018

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-018

      Mechanism

      Separate elapsed time experienced by the case or recipient from active work effort and resource occupancy. Locate waiting, transfer and rework contributions before attributing delay to an actor or deciding which activity to accelerate.

      Bearer

      Elapsed process time, effort and resource occupancy claims

      Authority

      Analysts interpret time evidence with performers; owners can change allocation or handoff arrangements within their authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-018#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-018#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-020

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-020

      Mechanism

      Trace how a handoff, missing information or rejected output generates delay and repeated work. Distinguish avoidable rework from necessary checking, learning or repair before changing task boundaries or removing feedback.

      Bearer

      Handoff and rework mechanisms, including necessary repair/checking

      Authority

      Sending and receiving actors jointly identify the mechanism; an owner needs authority or agreement to change both sides.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-020#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-020#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-026

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-026

      Mechanism

      Use only the lifecycle states needed to establish current responsibility, exclusivity or permissible reassignment, and transition them consistently with the work being performed.

      Bearer

      Actor eligibility/authority/competence, work-item ownership and assignment constraints

      Authority

      Owning a work item establishes coordination responsibility only within the assignment’s authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-026#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-026#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-030

      Mechanism

      Define what evidence is sufficient for the claimed result and distinguish performer declaration, recipient acceptance and independently established effect.

      Bearer

      Performer declarations, commitments, recipient acceptance and established effects

      Authority

      Acceptance is an authorised judgement within a stated scope, not a metaphysical guarantee or substitute for consent.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-055

      Mechanism

      Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-005

      Mechanism

      Identify lifecycle phases and pairing rules; separate enabled, started, suspended, resumed and completed states where actually observed. Compute service or waiting intervals only from phases whose meaning supports them, and label unobserved intervals as unknown.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-046

      Mechanism

      Define each duration by its observed endpoints and lifecycle semantics; distinguish throughput, waiting, service and unobserved time. Attribute elapsed intervals only where the data and model support the attribution, and retain missing intervals as missing.

      Bearer

      Observed/inferred time, queues and candidate bottleneck explanations

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff agree what the time measure denotes before it is used as evidence of effort or blame. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-047

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-047

      Mechanism

      Use the process trace to generate candidate bottleneck explanations, then check omitted prerequisites, calendars, case mix and recording practices. Distinguish the location of an observed delay from a supported causal explanation and from an effective remedy.

      Bearer

      Observed/inferred time, queues and candidate bottleneck explanations

      Authority

      Analyst reports the pattern; operational participants provide contextual evidence; authorised managers decide on interventions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-047#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-047#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-049

      Mechanism

      Establish what each resource identifier denotes and when the mapping changes; distinguish people, roles, teams, systems and accounts. Do not make individual-level claims from a coarser or ambiguous identifier.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Data custodian explains account semantics; affected participants can challenge attribution; analysts do not infer personal identity by convenience. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    An interval or lifecycle declaration does not identify effort or effective work. Task responsibility and recorded intervals differ from unobserved multitasking or receiving-side effect.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    Shared concern

    Being assigned or technically enabled does not establish permission, competence, capacity or benefit.

    Distinction

    Normative authority is supplied by entitled actors, not by labels, logs or optimisation outputs.

    Trigger

    A model, worklist or recommendation is offered as sufficient warrant for action.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-015

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-015

      Mechanism

      Where decision rules vary independently of routing, distinguish the information/rules used to decide from the actor authorised to decide and from the consequences of that decision. Keep a traceable connection between a decision model and the process consuming its result.

      Bearer

      Decision rules, their consumers and separately authorised decision-makers

      Authority

      A rule author or prediction service is not automatically the legitimate decision maker; accountable actors retain domain-specific authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-015#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-015#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-027

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-027

      Mechanism

      Assign sufficient continuity of knowledge and responsibility to a case while retaining necessary specialist review and segregation of duties. Compare fewer handoffs with the competence and concentration-of-authority costs of task combination.

      Bearer

      Case coordination, allocation, pooling and segmentation arrangements

      Authority

      A coordinator may organise contributions without acquiring every professional or financial approval power.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-027#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-027#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-031

      Mechanism

      Connect responsibility for the process outcome with sufficient influence, knowledge, resources and an escalation route across participating functions. Separate an owner title from the powers actually exercised.

      Bearer

      Process governance arrangements and exercised authority

      Authority

      The process owner acts within delegated powers; functional and professional authorities retain powers not transferred. Conflicts require negotiation or escalation, not fictitious unilateral control.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-060

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-060

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. A title can coexist with absent authority, resources, knowledge or escalation ability.

      Bearer

      Process governance arrangements and exercised authority

      Authority

      The process owner acts within delegated powers; functional and professional authorities retain powers not transferred. Conflicts require negotiation or escalation, not fictitious unilateral control.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-060#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-060#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep three linked but non-equivalent claims explicit: evidence supports a distinction about work; an identified actor is authorised and able to intervene; observed consequences support an outcome judgement. Require the missing link to be established before promoting one claim into another.

      Bearer

      Evidence-to-authorised-action-to-observed-consequence relations for managed work

      Authority

      Evidence producers do not acquire execution powers by analysis; authorised actors do not acquire factual correctness by holding office.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-005

      Mechanism

      Interpret an enabled task jointly with its information inputs, eligible/available actor, interaction obligations and external effect boundary.

      Bearer

      Task enabling/transition predicates together with data, resource and action meaning

      Authority

      Eligibility, capability and authority are separate checks; the workflow cannot invent any of them.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

      Mechanism

      Assess whether eligible resources and time assumptions can support the enabled work, and specify what happens when they cannot.

      Bearer

      Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

      Authority

      Availability cannot be conjured by assigning a role; escalating does not grant competence or permission.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

      EPM:EPM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate predictive utility at actual decision times, accounting for lead time, false alarms, intervention capacity and opportunity cost. Choose thresholds or policies against an explicit decision objective rather than accuracy alone.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Operational authority specifies available actions and resource limits; the analyst evaluates decision support within those bounds. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-065

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-065

      Mechanism

      Restrict recommendations to actions that the recipient can perform within actual authority, timing and resource constraints; expose uncertainty and alternatives, allow rejection, and observe the action actually taken rather than equating advice with execution.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Operational actors retain the authority specified by the setting; analysts or models cannot grant themselves new powers through recommendations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-080

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-080

      Mechanism

      Reject the inference from observation or model competence to operative authority. Require a separately established actor, mandate, feasible action and consequence evaluation for any real change.

      Bearer

      AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

      Authority

      External accountable actors retain their actual authority; no authority is created by the analytical system. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-080#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-080#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED
