    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K015

    Name

    Discretion, exceptions and case support

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-008

    • EBPM:EBPM-016

    • EBPM:EBPM-029

    • EBPM:EBPM-036

    • EBPM:EBPM-054

    • EBPM:EBPM-064

    • EWM:EWM-031

    • EWM:EWM-032

    • EWM:EWM-033

    • EWM:EWM-050

    • EWM:EWM-051

    • EWM:EWM-052

    • EWM:EWM-053

    • EWM:EWM-054

    • EPM:EPM-021

    • EPM:EPM-024

    • EPM:EPM-027

    • EPM:EPM-029

    • EPM:EPM-036

    • EPM:EPM-038

    Shared concern

    Variation may require a permitted response without either universal routing or unlimited discretion.

    Distinction

    Descriptive variation, authorised exception and selected flexible workflow mechanisms are not interchangeable.

    Trigger

    The normal route does not adequately support a meaningful case or exceptional situation.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-008

      Mechanism

      Sample materially different case types, failure paths and informal coordination. State which variants are covered and which remain uncertain; do not infer that rare or unlogged work is irrelevant simply because it is absent from a convenient sample.

      Bearer

      Accounts of performed work, variants and observations outside current models

      Authority

      Process investigators select cases with performers and recipients; owners accept the resulting uncertainty or commission further inquiry.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Mechanism

      Select support according to what can be known in advance: goals and information needs, mandatory constraints, planned tasks or a stable flow. Allow structured sub-processes inside knowledge work and avoid making flexibility equivalent to the absence of guidance.

      Bearer

      Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

      Authority

      Case workers plan within professional and organisational authority; system flexibility does not grant new powers.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-016#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-016#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-029

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-029

      Mechanism

      Separate materially different cases where this improves fit, but validate classification quality and the burdens imposed on difficult or disadvantaged cases. Reassess class boundaries when demand changes.

      Bearer

      Case coordination, allocation, pooling and segmentation arrangements

      Authority

      Classification and resource-allocation decisions require accountable authority; analysts do not define acceptable exclusion alone.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-029#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-029#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-036

      Mechanism

      Distinguish legitimate discretion from uncontrolled deviation. Define the goals and constraints that remain binding, who can depart from the ordinary route, and how the decision and its consequences are communicated and reviewed.

      Bearer

      Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

      Authority

      A case worker’s discretion is bounded by professional and organisational authority; a model’s optional task does not confer legal or ethical permission.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-054

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-054

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Knowledge-intensive and exceptional cases can require bounded judgement; a fixed route is not universally appropriate.

      Bearer

      Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

      Authority

      A case worker’s discretion is bounded by professional and organisational authority; a model’s optional task does not confer legal or ethical permission.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-054#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-054#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-064

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-064

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Meaningful differences in needs, expertise and risk can justify variants; eliminating variation can harm difficult cases.

      Bearer

      Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

      Authority

      Classification and resource-allocation decisions require accountable authority; analysts do not define acceptable exclusion alone.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-064#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-064#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-031

      Mechanism

      Include participants in defining and revising workflow support, and provide a way to handle legitimate work outside the prescription without pretending it never happened.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Discretion has boundaries; recognising situated work does not authorise every deviation.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-032

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-032

      Mechanism

      Specify detected exception classes, handler scope, allowed continuation and the resulting state of both current and dependent work.

      Bearer

      Exception handlers, bounded repairs and interruption/cancellation scope

      Authority

      The handler can only perform actions within its supplied authority and external capabilities.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-032#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-032#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-033

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-033

      Mechanism

      Route unmodelled situations to an actor who can examine current state, authorise a bounded repair and record its consequences before resuming or revising the definition.

      Bearer

      Exception handlers, bounded repairs and interruption/cancellation scope

      Authority

      The ability to edit state is not permission to change business obligations or other people’s work.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-033#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-033#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-050

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-050

      Mechanism

      Select the flexibility mechanism according to whether variation is anticipated, temporarily tolerated, deliberately left open or requires a changed definition/state.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Freedom to choose a next step does not authorise changing the constraints that make it acceptable.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-050#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-050#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-051

      Mechanism

      Express necessary temporal/data constraints, analyse their consistency and progress implications, and explain which obligations remain pending before completion.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      An allowed trace is not automatically authorised or wise; external powers remain separately supplied.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-052

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-052

      Mechanism

      Expose relevant case data and permissible operations so an accountable actor can select the next justified action without inventing a full predetermined sequence.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Discretion is exercised within the actor’s actual authority; broad data access is not automatically justified.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-052#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-052#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-053

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-053

      Mechanism

      Separate the available plan from selected work, declare who may add/activate items, and define completion without equating every terminal item state with success.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Planning tables express permitted roles in a model; they do not establish external authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-053#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-053#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-054

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-054

      Mechanism

      Select a bounded subworkflow for the current case context and preserve the selection rationale and exception precedence when extending the rule base.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      The ability to add a worklet does not authorise changing parent commitments or external privileges.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-054#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-054#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-021

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-021

      Mechanism

      Use frequency-sensitive dependency estimates and thresholds to obtain a useful model; disclose threshold choices and inspect the behaviour removed or changed. Re-evaluate material low-frequency paths rather than classifying all of them as noise.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst proposes thresholds; domain consumer decides whether suppressed behaviour is important. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-021#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-021#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-024

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-024

      Mechanism

      Mine supported finite-trace constraints with explicit activation semantics, distinguish satisfaction from meaningful activation, and check redundancy and consistency before interpretation. Treat a discovered constraint as a descriptive hypothesis unless independently authorised.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst explains rule semantics; domain participants evaluate meaningful activation; rule authority is a separate decision. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-027

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-027

      Mechanism

      Classify low-frequency behaviour by relevance to the question before suppressing it; retain or separately analyse material exceptions and expose the effect of filtering on the conclusion. Do not require keeping every rare record in every main view.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Domain participants explain consequence and authorisation; the miner supplies frequency, not importance. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-027#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-027#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-029

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-029

      Mechanism

      Use domain knowledge to propose constraints, abstractions or candidate interpretations, label its origin and test its consequences against event evidence. Keep observed, inferred and prescribed statements separate when adjusting a model.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Domain experts supply contextual knowledge; the relevant institutional actor—not the analyst—authorises prescriptive rules. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-029#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-029#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-036

      Mechanism

      For a consequential deviation, keep plausible data, reference, execution and exception explanations separate; gather discriminating evidence and state which alternatives remain. Match the remedy to the supported cause rather than automatically correcting the process.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst frames competing explanations; data custodians, process participants and authorised decision makers establish causes and appropriate action. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-038

      Mechanism

      Decide whether evidence supports correcting data, repairing a descriptive model, changing execution or formally revising an authorised rule. For model repair, preserve unaffected intent and re-evaluate changed behaviour; maintain the prior reference when continuity matters.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Model maintainer can repair a descriptive model within mandate; changing an obligation requires its own authorised actor and process. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Variation may require a permitted response without either universal routing or unlimited discretion. Descriptive variation, authorised exception and selected flexible workflow mechanisms are not interchangeable.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K016

    Name

    Workaround and conformance interpretation

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-006

    • EBPM:EBPM-036

    • EBPM:EBPM-037

    • EBPM:EBPM-047

    • EWM:EWM-031

    • EWM:EWM-033

    • EWM:EWM-056

    • EPM:EPM-031

    • EPM:EPM-032

    • EPM:EPM-033

    • EPM:EPM-034

    • EPM:EPM-036

    • EPM:EPM-037

    • EPM:EPM-038

    Shared concern

    A detected mismatch does not by itself select defect, legitimate repair, evasion or obsolete reference.

    Distinction

    Conformance detects a defined relation; explanation and authorisation require additional evidence and actors.

    Trigger

    A deviation could have data, reference, contextual or execution explanations.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-006

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-006

      Mechanism

      Compare interviews, documents, walkthroughs, direct observation and event evidence where they reveal different aspects of work. Record provenance and disagreement; neither a remembered account, a prescription nor an event log is intrinsically the whole truth.

      Bearer

      Accounts of performed work, variants and observations outside current models

      Authority

      Analysts synthesise evidence; performers and recipients can correct it. Sponsorship does not entitle an analyst to dismiss inconvenient observations.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-006#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-006#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-036

      Mechanism

      Distinguish legitimate discretion from uncontrolled deviation. Define the goals and constraints that remain binding, who can depart from the ordinary route, and how the decision and its consequences are communicated and reviewed.

      Bearer

      Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

      Authority

      A case worker’s discretion is bounded by professional and organisational authority; a model’s optional task does not confer legal or ethical permission.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-037

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-037

      Mechanism

      Investigate a workaround’s cause, protected purpose, risks and affected parties before either suppressing it or institutionalising it. Distinguish useful repair, constraint evasion and temporary accommodation, then decide whether to change the system, the work or neither.

      Bearer

      A workaround and its cause, purpose, risks and authorised disposition

      Authority

      Performers can explain the workaround; authorised owners and relevant control holders decide its acceptance or replacement.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-037#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-037#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-047

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-047

      Mechanism

      Keep a route by which observations outside the current model—complaints, practitioner accounts, recipient experience and unlogged work—can challenge both the representation and the success measure. Do not let the model define all admissible evidence about its own adequacy.

      Bearer

      Accounts of performed work, variants and observations outside current models

      Authority

      Evidence contributors may challenge a model; revision remains an authorised decision rather than automatic acceptance of every complaint.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-047#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-047#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-031

      Mechanism

      Include participants in defining and revising workflow support, and provide a way to handle legitimate work outside the prescription without pretending it never happened.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Discretion has boundaries; recognising situated work does not authorise every deviation.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-033

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-033

      Mechanism

      Route unmodelled situations to an actor who can examine current state, authorise a bounded repair and record its consequences before resuming or revising the definition.

      Bearer

      Exception handlers, bounded repairs and interruption/cancellation scope

      Authority

      The ability to edit state is not permission to change business obligations or other people’s work.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-033#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-033#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-056

      Mechanism

      Check log-to-case/activity/order assumptions and the model’s intended scope before interpreting deviations or conformance as evidence about enactment.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      A detected mismatch is a question for adjudication, not automatic authority to sanction or repair.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-031

      Mechanism

      Record whether the reference is descriptive, intended, contractual, technical or otherwise externally authorised; identify its version, scope and approving actor. Limit conformance conclusions to the actual reference semantics and route normative judgements to the actor entitled to make them.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst computes correspondence; externally entitled actors interpret or amend obligations. No legal ruling or institutional power is inferred from mining.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-032

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-032

      Mechanism

      Replay a trace under stated net and mapping semantics, expose missing/remaining-token diagnostics and identify artificial token insertion or other replay choices. Use the result as a bounded explanation of mismatch, not as a unique cause of failure.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst presents replay diagnostics to model and process experts; they evaluate possible explanations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-032#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-032#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-033

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-033

      Mechanism

      Specify synchronous moves, log moves, model moves, admissible paths and their costs; distinguish an exact optimum from a heuristic bound or timed-out search. Present alternative low-cost explanations where they change interpretation.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst chooses and discloses costs; domain experts assess whether those costs reflect diagnostic importance; optimisation grants no authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-033#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-033#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-034

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-034

      Mechanism

      Compare control-flow and relevant data/resource/time constraints jointly where the formalism supports them, with explicit cross-perspective costs. Diagnose which interpretation changes when a missing or inconsistent attribute is considered.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst establishes joint comparison; domain or rule authority interprets the guard and its consequence. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-034#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-034#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-036

      Mechanism

      For a consequential deviation, keep plausible data, reference, execution and exception explanations separate; gather discriminating evidence and state which alternatives remain. Match the remedy to the supported cause rather than automatically correcting the process.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst frames competing explanations; data custodians, process participants and authorised decision makers establish causes and appropriate action. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-037

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-037

      Mechanism

      Reject the implication. Conformance establishes only the relation defined by the model, mapping and comparison; external normative predicates require separate standards, interpretation and authority.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Competent external authorities or accountable decision makers, not the mining algorithm, determine the additional predicates. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-037#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-037#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-038

      Mechanism

      Decide whether evidence supports correcting data, repairing a descriptive model, changing execution or formally revising an authorised rule. For model repair, preserve unaffected intent and re-evaluate changed behaviour; maintain the prior reference when continuity matters.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Model maintainer can repair a descriptive model within mandate; changing an obligation requires its own authorised actor and process. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A detected mismatch does not by itself select defect, legitimate repair, evasion or obsolete reference. Conformance detects a defined relation; explanation and authorisation require additional evidence and actors.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K017

    Name

    Interrupts, cancellation and uncertain completion

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-003

    • EBPM:EBPM-042

    • EBPM:EBPM-043

    • EWM:EWM-003

    • EWM:EWM-013

    • EWM:EWM-014

    • EWM:EWM-032

    • EWM:EWM-034

    • EWM:EWM-035

    • EWM:EWM-037

    • EPM:EPM-005

    • EPM:EPM-006

    • EPM:EPM-036

    • EPM:EPM-057

    Shared concern

    A stop, missing reply or incomplete prefix must not be turned into success or established failure.

    Distinction

    Workflow changes permitted continuations; analysis describes only observed effects and open uncertainty.

    Trigger

    Work is interrupted, a reply is missing, or analysis observes only a prefix.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-003

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-003

      Mechanism

      State what initiates the work, what object or case is being advanced and what counts as completion, cancellation or continuing responsibility. Do not force a single stable case identifier or a terminal event onto open-ended knowledge work without justification.

      Bearer

      Process cases, triggering needs and continuing/completion responsibilities

      Authority

      Operational owners and recipients define business completion; a system administrator defines only the system’s representational boundary.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-003#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-003#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-042

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-042

      Mechanism

      Distinguish a local task or engine completion from completion of the obligation to a recipient or partner. Identify the external effects that matter and obtain appropriate receiving-side or operational evidence before declaring the business case complete.

      Bearer

      Business/external obligation completion and receiving-side evidence

      Authority

      Each actor controls its own commitments; a local owner cannot declare another party’s obligations fulfilled by fiat.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-042#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-042#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-043

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-043

      Mechanism

      Where failed or interrupted work can leave consequential partial effects, ensure actors know how to pause, assess outstanding obligations and select an authorised continuation or recovery. The BPM-level requirement does not prescribe engine-specific retry, rollback or compensation algorithms.

      Bearer

      Interrupted work, outstanding obligations and authorised continuation/recovery

      Authority

      Operators may stop within delegated authority; reversal or compensation of another actor’s commitment requires the relevant authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-043#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-043#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-003

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-003

      Mechanism

      Declare what instance completion establishes, what work may remain and whether residual effects are closed, transferred or explicitly accepted; do not equate terminal status with success.

      Bearer

      Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

      Authority

      A permitted engine completion is not authority to dismiss somebody else’s unresolved obligation.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-003#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-003#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-013

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-013

      Mechanism

      When a branch is cancelled, update join obligations according to the declared scope and activation rather than pretending that cancellation produced a success token.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Only the actor entitled to change the coordination obligation may dispense with a required branch.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-013#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-013#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-014

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-014

      Mechanism

      Specify the scope ended by termination and account for live children, subscriptions, pending work items and transferred external obligations.

      Bearer

      Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

      Authority

      An enclosing model can terminate only work within its effective control; external parties may need separate requests.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-014#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-014#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-032

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-032

      Mechanism

      Specify detected exception classes, handler scope, allowed continuation and the resulting state of both current and dependent work.

      Bearer

      Exception handlers, bounded repairs and interruption/cancellation scope

      Authority

      The handler can only perform actions within its supplied authority and external capabilities.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-032#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-032#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-034

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-034

      Mechanism

      Specify whether the original work continues, what is cancelled or suspended, and how partial acknowledgement or inability to stop is represented.

      Bearer

      Exception handlers, bounded repairs and interruption/cancellation scope

      Authority

      A cancellation request is not control over an independent participant or an irreversible effect.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-034#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-034#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-035

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-035

      Mechanism

      Treat a timed-out action’s effect as unknown until the relevant protocol, idempotency boundary or reconciliation establishes what happened.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      Timeout does not authorise a conflicting second action or unilateral reversal.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-035#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-035#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-037

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-037

      Mechanism

      Track outstanding remedies and their uncertainty separately from the stopped process, with a permitted retry, alternative remedy, transfer or accepted residual outcome.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      An engine cannot waive external commitments by deleting failed compensation state.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-037#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-037#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-005

      Mechanism

      Identify lifecycle phases and pairing rules; separate enabled, started, suspended, resumed and completed states where actually observed. Compute service or waiting intervals only from phases whose meaning supports them, and label unobserved intervals as unknown.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-006

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-006

      Mechanism

      Use the strongest ordering supported by the evidence: a total order where justified, an explicit partial order or bounded alternatives otherwise. Keep tie-breaking separate from observed chronology and test sensitivity when an algorithm requires a sequence.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst exposes ordering alternatives to the consumer; system timestamps alone do not settle the real chronology. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-006#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-006#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-036

      Mechanism

      For a consequential deviation, keep plausible data, reference, execution and exception explanations separate; gather discriminating evidence and state which alternatives remain. Match the remedy to the supported cause rather than automatically correcting the process.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst frames competing explanations; data custodians, process participants and authorised decision makers establish causes and appropriate action. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-057

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-057

      Mechanism

      Specify window/forgetting policy, event arrival order, late-data handling and prefix semantics; expose the trade-off between latency, memory and historical coverage. Assess partial-case conformance as partial rather than pretending the case has ended.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Stream analyst or service operator discloses retention and delay to the decision consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-057#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-057#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A stop, missing reply or incomplete prefix must not be turned into success or established failure. Workflow changes permitted continuations; analysis describes only observed effects and open uncertainty.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K018

    Name

    Compensation, retries and real external effects

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-020

    • EBPM:EBPM-042

    • EBPM:EBPM-043

    • EWM:EWM-035

    • EWM:EWM-036

    • EWM:EWM-037

    • EWM:EWM-042

    • EWM:EWM-043

    • EWM:EWM-044

    • EWM:EWM-065

    • EWM:EWM-069

    • EWM:EWM-075

    • EPM:EPM-001

    • EPM:EPM-005

    • EPM:EPM-008

    • EPM:EPM-036

    • EPM:EPM-046

    • EPM:EPM-084

    Shared concern

    Recovery records must not falsely imply that committed effects disappeared or occurred once.

    Distinction

    A compensator is another action; an event label is not a universal inverse or receiving-side confirmation.

    Trigger

    Retries, cancellation, recovery or remedies can leave external effects outside engine state.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-020

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-020

      Mechanism

      Trace how a handoff, missing information or rejected output generates delay and repeated work. Distinguish avoidable rework from necessary checking, learning or repair before changing task boundaries or removing feedback.

      Bearer

      Handoff and rework mechanisms, including necessary repair/checking

      Authority

      Sending and receiving actors jointly identify the mechanism; an owner needs authority or agreement to change both sides.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-020#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-020#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-042

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-042

      Mechanism

      Distinguish a local task or engine completion from completion of the obligation to a recipient or partner. Identify the external effects that matter and obtain appropriate receiving-side or operational evidence before declaring the business case complete.

      Bearer

      Business/external obligation completion and receiving-side evidence

      Authority

      Each actor controls its own commitments; a local owner cannot declare another party’s obligations fulfilled by fiat.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-042#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-042#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-043

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-043

      Mechanism

      Where failed or interrupted work can leave consequential partial effects, ensure actors know how to pause, assess outstanding obligations and select an authorised continuation or recovery. The BPM-level requirement does not prescribe engine-specific retry, rollback or compensation algorithms.

      Bearer

      Interrupted work, outstanding obligations and authorised continuation/recovery

      Authority

      Operators may stop within delegated authority; reversal or compensation of another actor’s commitment requires the relevant authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-043#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-043#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-035

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-035

      Mechanism

      Treat a timed-out action’s effect as unknown until the relevant protocol, idempotency boundary or reconciliation establishes what happened.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      Timeout does not authorise a conflicting second action or unilateral reversal.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-035#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-035#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-036

      Mechanism

      Describe compensation as another action with its own preconditions and result, and identify which effects it can offset rather than claim universal world restoration.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      The original actor’s permission need not include permission to compensate; new approval may be required.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-037

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-037

      Mechanism

      Track outstanding remedies and their uncertainty separately from the stopped process, with a permitted retry, alternative remedy, transfer or accepted residual outcome.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      An engine cannot waive external commitments by deleting failed compensation state.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-037#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-037#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-042

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-042

      Mechanism

      Persist enough committed coordination state to resume the same instance claim after failure, with a declared boundary between durable orchestration and separately executed work.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Durability of an engine record does not establish the current state of an outside service.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-042#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-042#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-043

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-043

      Mechanism

      Control repeated effects through a suitable combination of idempotency, deduplication with durable keys, atomic participation, rollback support or explicit reconciliation.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      An orchestrator cannot impose idempotency on an uncooperative external service.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-043#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-043#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-044

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-044

      Mechanism

      Reconcile intent, recorded acknowledgement and authoritative external outcome before a recovery decision that would otherwise assume the world matches engine history.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      The reconciler may observe without being authorised to mutate; discrepancies require the right decision-maker.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-044#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-044#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-065

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-065

      Mechanism

      Replace the unqualified claim with an explicit effect boundary and validated idempotency, rollback, persistence or participation assumptions.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      No engine controls an arbitrary uncooperative external world.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-065#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-065#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-069

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-069

      Mechanism

      No universal inverse exists; record the compensator’s own effect and residual differences.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      Permission to act once does not necessarily include permission to reverse or remedy.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-069#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-069#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-075

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-003

      Mechanism

      Before asserting closure, reconcile the local terminal state with the disposition of work and material external obligations: fulfilled, legitimately waived, transferred or explicitly unresolved under an accepted closure policy.

      Bearer

      Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

      Authority

      Local terminal status is not unilateral permission to waive another participant’s commitment.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-075#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-075#/criticism

      Disposition

      DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-001

      Mechanism

      For each event class, establish what happened or was recorded, by whom or what, at which lifecycle phase, and with what relation to an actual work episode. Test a small number of material examples against source-system behaviour and domain testimony; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than inventing execution semantics.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-005

      Mechanism

      Identify lifecycle phases and pairing rules; separate enabled, started, suspended, resumed and completed states where actually observed. Compute service or waiting intervals only from phases whose meaning supports them, and label unobserved intervals as unknown.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-008

      Mechanism

      Declare the target population and observation window; distinguish cases, events, objects and decision occasions; examine inclusion, censoring, unlogged work and changes in capture. Match the strength of a conclusion to the actual observation process.

      Bearer

      Analytical target population, unit and observation/censoring process

      Authority

      The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-036

      Mechanism

      For a consequential deviation, keep plausible data, reference, execution and exception explanations separate; gather discriminating evidence and state which alternatives remain. Match the remedy to the supported cause rather than automatically correcting the process.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst frames competing explanations; data custodians, process participants and authorised decision makers establish causes and appropriate action. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-046

      Mechanism

      Define each duration by its observed endpoints and lifecycle semantics; distinguish throughput, waiting, service and unobserved time. Attribute elapsed intervals only where the data and model support the attribution, and retain missing intervals as missing.

      Bearer

      Observed/inferred time, queues and candidate bottleneck explanations

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff agree what the time measure denotes before it is used as evidence of effort or blame. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Recovery records must not falsely imply that committed effects disappeared or occurred once. A compensator is another action; an event label is not a universal inverse or receiving-side confirmation.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K019

    Name

    Closure, commitments and acceptance

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-001

    • EBPM:EBPM-003

    • EBPM:EBPM-042

    • EBPM:EBPM-068

    • EWM:EWM-003

    • EWM:EWM-014

    • EWM:EWM-030

    • EWM:EWM-039

    • EWM:EWM-053

    • EWM:EWM-075

    • EWM:EWM-077

    • EPM:EPM-005

    • EPM:EPM-008

    • EPM:EPM-031

    • EPM:EPM-053

    • EPM:EPM-057

    Shared concern

    Terminal status, fulfilment, waiver, transfer and explicit unresolved responsibility must remain distinct.

    Distinction

    Business acceptance is not control-flow soundness, a completed event or analytical delivery.

    Trigger

    A case is declared complete or an outcome is inferred from termination records.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Mechanism

      Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.

      Bearer

      Process purposes, beneficiaries and strategic outcome commitments

      Authority

      Responsible managers can commit resources; beneficiaries and affected workers contribute outcome evidence. Analysts cannot decide whose interests prevail merely by drawing the boundary.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-003

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-003

      Mechanism

      State what initiates the work, what object or case is being advanced and what counts as completion, cancellation or continuing responsibility. Do not force a single stable case identifier or a terminal event onto open-ended knowledge work without justification.

      Bearer

      Process cases, triggering needs and continuing/completion responsibilities

      Authority

      Operational owners and recipients define business completion; a system administrator defines only the system’s representational boundary.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-003#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-003#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-042

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-042

      Mechanism

      Distinguish a local task or engine completion from completion of the obligation to a recipient or partner. Identify the external effects that matter and obtain appropriate receiving-side or operational evidence before declaring the business case complete.

      Bearer

      Business/external obligation completion and receiving-side evidence

      Authority

      Each actor controls its own commitments; a local owner cannot declare another party’s obligations fulfilled by fiat.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-042#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-042#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep three linked but non-equivalent claims explicit: evidence supports a distinction about work; an identified actor is authorised and able to intervene; observed consequences support an outcome judgement. Require the missing link to be established before promoting one claim into another.

      Bearer

      Evidence-to-authorised-action-to-observed-consequence relations for managed work

      Authority

      Evidence producers do not acquire execution powers by analysis; authorised actors do not acquire factual correctness by holding office.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-003

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-003

      Mechanism

      Declare what instance completion establishes, what work may remain and whether residual effects are closed, transferred or explicitly accepted; do not equate terminal status with success.

      Bearer

      Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

      Authority

      A permitted engine completion is not authority to dismiss somebody else’s unresolved obligation.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-003#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-003#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-014

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-014

      Mechanism

      Specify the scope ended by termination and account for live children, subscriptions, pending work items and transferred external obligations.

      Bearer

      Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

      Authority

      An enclosing model can terminate only work within its effective control; external parties may need separate requests.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-014#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-014#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-030

      Mechanism

      Define what evidence is sufficient for the claimed result and distinguish performer declaration, recipient acceptance and independently established effect.

      Bearer

      Performer declarations, commitments, recipient acceptance and established effects

      Authority

      Acceptance is an authorised judgement within a stated scope, not a metaphysical guarantee or substitute for consent.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-039

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-039

      Mechanism

      Define message types, correlation, ordering, error responses and the evidence needed for received, accepted, performed or satisfied states.

      Bearer

      Participant workflows, message contracts and global interaction compatibility

      Authority

      Receipt is not consent; acceptance must be made by an appropriate participant under the relevant rules.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-039#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-039#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-053

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-053

      Mechanism

      Separate the available plan from selected work, declare who may add/activate items, and define completion without equating every terminal item state with success.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Planning tables express permitted roles in a model; they do not establish external authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-053#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-053#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-075

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-003

      Mechanism

      Before asserting closure, reconcile the local terminal state with the disposition of work and material external obligations: fulfilled, legitimately waived, transferred or explicitly unresolved under an accepted closure policy.

      Bearer

      Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

      Authority

      Local terminal status is not unilateral permission to waive another participant’s commitment.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-075#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-075#/criticism

      Disposition

      DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-077

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-077

      Mechanism

      Use explicit request, commitment, declaration and acceptance distinctions when different participants need to agree what work is owed and whether it has been satisfied.

      Bearer

      Performer declarations, commitments, recipient acceptance and established effects

      Authority

      A recorded acceptance does not prove uncoerced consent, objective correctness or authority outside the relationship.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-077#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-077#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-005

      Mechanism

      Identify lifecycle phases and pairing rules; separate enabled, started, suspended, resumed and completed states where actually observed. Compute service or waiting intervals only from phases whose meaning supports them, and label unobserved intervals as unknown.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-008

      Mechanism

      Declare the target population and observation window; distinguish cases, events, objects and decision occasions; examine inclusion, censoring, unlogged work and changes in capture. Match the strength of a conclusion to the actual observation process.

      Bearer

      Analytical target population, unit and observation/censoring process

      Authority

      The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-031

      Mechanism

      Record whether the reference is descriptive, intended, contractual, technical or otherwise externally authorised; identify its version, scope and approving actor. Limit conformance conclusions to the actual reference semantics and route normative judgements to the actor entitled to make them.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst computes correspondence; externally entitled actors interpret or amend obligations. No legal ruling or institutional power is inferred from mining.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-053

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-053

      Mechanism

      Identify who needs the result, what decision it can change and what observation would establish the consequence. Separate analytical delivery, organisational agreement, implemented action and measured outcome; stop or retire an analysis without an adequate consumer.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates evidence and uncertainty; operational actors act within their mandate; outcome measurement must not be replaced by analyst self-report. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-057

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-057

      Mechanism

      Specify window/forgetting policy, event arrival order, late-data handling and prefix semantics; expose the trade-off between latency, memory and historical coverage. Assess partial-case conformance as partial rather than pretending the case has ended.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Stream analyst or service operator discloses retention and delay to the decision consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-057#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-057#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Terminal status, fulfilment, waiver, transfer and explicit unresolved responsibility must remain distinct. Business acceptance is not control-flow soundness, a completed event or analytical delivery.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.
