    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K020

    Name

    Partner interfaces and distributed compatibility

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-005

    • EBPM:EBPM-048

    • EBPM:EBPM-049

    • EWM:EWM-021

    • EWM:EWM-022

    • EWM:EWM-038

    • EWM:EWM-039

    • EWM:EWM-040

    • EWM:EWM-041

    • EPM:EPM-011

    • EPM:EPM-012

    • EPM:EPM-013

    • EPM:EPM-030

    • EPM:EPM-078

    • EPM:EPM-084

    Shared concern

    Local interfaces do not establish global compatibility, shared meaning or a right to disclose.

    Distinction

    BPM negotiates obligations; workflow governs participant protocols; mining joins and interprets information under a disclosure boundary.

    Trigger

    Autonomous participants exchange messages, objects or analytical results.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Mechanism

      Represent process families, decomposition and interfaces at the abstraction needed for coordination. Preserve cross-cutting dependencies when decomposing and adapt reference architectures to actual work rather than treating a borrowed map as an empirical description.

      Bearer

      Process architecture and cross-process dependencies

      Authority

      Enterprise/process coordinators maintain the map with local expertise; the architecture does not override functional or contractual authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-048

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-048

      Mechanism

      Negotiate shared outcomes, interfaces, responsibilities and dispute handling among autonomous organisations. Make differences in incentives, information and decision rights explicit; no single process diagram grants one participant authority over the network.

      Bearer

      Negotiated cross-organisational obligations and dispute/decision rights

      Authority

      Each organisation can commit only within its mandate; joint decisions require agreed governance rather than assumed central control.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-048#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-048#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Mechanism

      Reconcile the meanings of cases, events, messages and completion across interfaces while limiting disclosure to a justified purpose. Technical schema compatibility is not enough when organisations interpret the same field differently.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians control authorised disclosure; process parties jointly resolve business meaning within their commitments.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-021

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-021

      Mechanism

      Define who reads/writes each relevant value, when binding occurs and whether values are copied, shared or referenced across scopes.

      Bearer

      Task data flow, binding, ownership, freshness and concurrent-update semantics

      Authority

      Workflow scope is not legal or organisational authority; access policy needs its own basis.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-021#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-021#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-022

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-022

      Mechanism

      Validate correlation keys and their scopes before accepting a message or callback as a transition for a case; distinguish deduplication from correct association.

      Bearer

      Bindings among definition versions, instances, work items, messages and external business objects

      Authority

      Correct routing neither authenticates the sender nor establishes its authority to request a change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-022#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-022#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-038

      Mechanism

      Declare which participant controls each action and what the global interaction view omits; keep local execution and shared communication contracts distinct.

      Bearer

      Participant workflows, message contracts and global interaction compatibility

      Authority

      No choreography picture creates a central authority; orchestration only controls its own effective scope.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-039

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-039

      Mechanism

      Define message types, correlation, ordering, error responses and the evidence needed for received, accepted, performed or satisfied states.

      Bearer

      Participant workflows, message contracts and global interaction compatibility

      Authority

      Receipt is not consent; acceptance must be made by an appropriate participant under the relevant rules.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-039#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-039#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-040

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-040

      Mechanism

      Analyse the shared protocol and local behaviours together under explicit message ordering, delivery and partner assumptions; check global deadlocks and incompatible expectations.

      Bearer

      Participant workflows, message contracts and global interaction compatibility

      Authority

      Compatibility does not make an unwilling or unavailable participant cooperate.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-040#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-040#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-041

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-041

      Mechanism

      Declare the portability layer—diagram, interchange syntax, executable subset, data bindings or runtime interaction—and test the layer actually relied upon.

      Bearer

      Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

      Authority

      A standard name is not evidence of conformance at every layer or permission to move data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-041#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-041#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-011

      Mechanism

      Record the exact data format, version, required extensions and interpretation conventions; test representative round trips or imports. Preserve semantic mappings when converting between case-centric and object-centric formats.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Data producer and tool consumer agree on accepted meanings and reject silent coercions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-012

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-012

      Mechanism

      Select a case notion according to the question and unit of responsibility; test relevant alternative correlations. When one case cannot retain required object interactions, keep a relational/object-centric representation instead of forcing a convenient identifier.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Analyst and domain consumer choose the unit; the database’s primary key is not an automatic answer to the business question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-012#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-012#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-013

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-013

      Mechanism

      Represent stable object identities and types, event–object participation and needed object–object relations; record qualifiers and temporal attribute changes when relevant. Preserve multiplicity instead of copying a shared event into fictional independent occurrences.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Data custodians establish identity conventions; analysts communicate relation meaning to the process consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-013#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-013#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-030

      Mechanism

      Discover or analyse bounded fragments with explicit event selection and boundary semantics; identify shared events and interactions omitted by the decomposition. Recompose only when compatibility and the consumer’s global question are actually addressed.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates what a local result does not say; the consumer decides whether a global conclusion is needed. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-078

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-078

      Mechanism

      Choose a federated protocol with explicit participant, identifier, activity-mapping and adversary assumptions; distinguish what is hidden during computation from what the protocol and released result reveal. Compare privacy, communication and computation costs with simpler aggregate exchange.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Participating organisations jointly authorise the computation and release; analysts cannot promise secrecy beyond the protocol’s boundary. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-078#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-078#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Local interfaces do not establish global compatibility, shared meaning or a right to disclose. BPM negotiates obligations; workflow governs participant protocols; mining joins and interprets information under a disclosure boundary.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

  • Id

    BWP-K021

    Name

    Version, migration and historical applicability

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-030

    • EBPM:EBPM-043

    • EBPM:EBPM-045

    • EBPM:EBPM-071

    • EBPM:EBPM-073

    • EWM:EWM-073

    • EPM:EPM-002

    • EPM:EPM-011

    • EPM:EPM-056

    • EPM:EPM-058

    • EPM:EPM-069

    • EPM:EPM-084

    Shared concern

    Changed definitions must not reinterpret ongoing or historical work without a compatible mapping.

    Distinction

    Safe state migration and valid historical comparison are separate checks; old-version coexistence is legitimate.

    Trigger

    Any dependent definition, implementation, extraction, semantic environment or rule changes.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-030

      Mechanism

      Choose the scale and pace of change by the inadequacy of the current mechanism, uncertainty, transition risk and continuity needs. Consider radical replacement, incremental repair, mixed migration and no change as genuine alternatives.

      Bearer

      Intervention portfolio and chosen scale of change

      Authority

      Sponsors authorise strategic disruption; performers and affected recipients contribute transition and continuity evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-043

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-043

      Mechanism

      Where failed or interrupted work can leave consequential partial effects, ensure actors know how to pause, assess outstanding obligations and select an authorised continuation or recovery. The BPM-level requirement does not prescribe engine-specific retry, rollback or compensation algorithms.

      Bearer

      Interrupted work, outstanding obligations and authorised continuation/recovery

      Authority

      Operators may stop within delegated authority; reversal or compensation of another actor’s commitment requires the relevant authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-043#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-043#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-045

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-045

      Mechanism

      Reassess models, assumptions and measures when demand, case mix, resources, interfaces or actual practices change. Distinguish benign variation from a changed mechanism and avoid updating the model merely to normalise a harmful deviation.

      Bearer

      Changed demand, models, practice and assumptions requiring reassessment

      Authority

      Analysts identify changed evidence; owners and affected actors decide whether models, operations or objectives need revision.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-045#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-045#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Mechanism

      Allow feedback to change a representation, the real work, the measure or the intervention hypothesis, but distinguish these acts. Review their consistency and continuity: updating a diagram does not change work, and changed work may require a revised account without implying improvement.

      Bearer

      Coupled but distinct revisions of representations, actual work, measures and hypotheses

      Authority

      Modellers may revise descriptions within their remit; changing operational commitments or evaluation criteria requires the responsible authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-073

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-073

      Mechanism

      Where the chosen formalism supports it, check that the combined constraints admit appropriate executions and that a changed instance specification remains compatible with its recorded history. Separate formal satisfiability and dead-activity checks from the truth, completeness and legitimacy of the encoded constraints.

      Bearer

      Formal declarative constraints and history-compatible instance specifications

      Authority

      Analysts check encoded behaviour; accountable domain actors decide which constraints should apply and whether a departure is authorised.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-073#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-001

      Mechanism

      Bind each transition to its definition version, case, work item and, where relevant, message attempt and external business object; do not substitute one identifier for all of them.

      Bearer

      Bindings among definition versions, instances, work items, messages and external business objects

      Authority

      Identity locates an object; it grants no person or service permission to act on it.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-042

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-042

      Mechanism

      Persist enough committed coordination state to resume the same instance claim after failure, with a declared boundary between durable orchestration and separately executed work.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Durability of an engine record does not establish the current state of an outside service.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-042#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-042#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-045

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-045

      Mechanism

      Keep replay-sensitive decisions within the deterministic contract and isolate or record nondeterministic inputs and effects through the supported interfaces.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Replay consistency is not permission to repeat an external action or proof that its returned value was correct.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-045#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-045#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-046

      Mechanism

      Determine the minimum retained state, history and external references required for specified recovery, review and continuity claims; retire records only after those consumers and obligations are addressed.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      This is not legal retention advice; applicable obligations must be supplied by the relevant authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      EWM:EWM-047

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-047

      Mechanism

      Bind in-flight work to a compatible implementation/definition version and test upgrade or routing strategies against real persisted states before replacing them.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Deployment access does not authorise changing the meaning of commitments already made.

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-048

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-048

      Mechanism

      Check the actual marking, data, completed work, pending interactions and relevant constraints when migrating an instance; a sound new definition alone is insufficient.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Migration permission must cover changed obligations, not just permission to edit a diagram.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-049

      EWM:EWM-049

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      EWM:EWM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      Bearer

      Authority

      Authority

      Recover or revise an instance only with a coherent account of its governing version, current state, pending work, message/effect identities and known external outcomes.

      Bearer

      Authority

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-002

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-002

      Mechanism

      Retain a feasible trace-back from a consequential output through selected events, source identifiers and extraction versions. Use protected pseudonymous keys where direct identifiers are unnecessary. Record which lineage edges cannot be reconstructed.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst, data custodian and reviewer exchange the minimal trace evidence required to diagnose a result. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-002#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-002#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-011

      Mechanism

      Record the exact data format, version, required extensions and interpretation conventions; test representative round trips or imports. Preserve semantic mappings when converting between case-centric and object-centric formats.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Data producer and tool consumer agree on accepted meanings and reject silent coercions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-054

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-054

      Mechanism

      Keep observation windows, event-schema versions, model versions and reference expectations distinguishable; tie a result to the regime in which its assumptions were assessed. Preserve enough prior identity to compare changes or reconstruct a past decision.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data and model custodians communicate changes; consumers know which temporal claim a result supports. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-056

      Mechanism

      On an apparent drift, compare instrumentation, extraction, population and process explanations; inspect the change history and selected raw examples. Revise the process hypothesis only after distinguishing or explicitly retaining these alternatives.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data custodian explains instrumentation; analyst evaluates the observed shift; process authority decides on operational consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-058

      Mechanism

      Maintain a distinction between the model describing recent behaviour and any stable or separately authorised reference. Compare them, diagnose change and obtain the relevant decision before amending obligations; adaptation of description is not self-authorising revision.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Analyst may update a descriptive estimate within scope; rule owners or other entitled actors decide whether the intended process changes. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-069

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-069

      Mechanism

      Preserve the executable transformation/analysis recipe, relevant data identity, parameters, tool and dependency versions, random seeds and excluded or failed runs. Where raw data cannot be shared, expose the limitation and provide lawful substitutes that support only their stated claims.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Analyst produces reproducible evidence; data custodians enforce access boundaries; reviewers distinguish executable replication from data access. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-069#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-069#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Changed definitions must not reinterpret ongoing or historical work without a compatible mapping. Safe state migration and valid historical comparison are separate checks; old-version coexistence is legitimate.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K022

    Name

    Drift and normative-reference continuity

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-037

    • EBPM:EBPM-045

    • EBPM:EBPM-046

    • EBPM:EBPM-071

    • EWM:EWM-048

    • EWM:EWM-049

    • EWM:EWM-050

    • EWM:EWM-056

    • EWM:EWM-073

    • EWM:EWM-076

    • EPM:EPM-038

    • EPM:EPM-054

    • EPM:EPM-055

    • EPM:EPM-056

    • EPM:EPM-057

    • EPM:EPM-058

    • EPM:EPM-059

    • EPM:EPM-066

    • EPM:EPM-084

    Shared concern

    Changing description, actual work, instrumentation and obligations must not be conflated.

    Distinction

    An alarm invites inquiry; neither a new descriptive model nor an old reference self-authorises current work.

    Trigger

    A drift signal or changed regime affects a consequential claim or active obligation.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-037

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-037

      Mechanism

      Investigate a workaround’s cause, protected purpose, risks and affected parties before either suppressing it or institutionalising it. Distinguish useful repair, constraint evasion and temporary accommodation, then decide whether to change the system, the work or neither.

      Bearer

      A workaround and its cause, purpose, risks and authorised disposition

      Authority

      Performers can explain the workaround; authorised owners and relevant control holders decide its acceptance or replacement.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-037#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-037#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-045

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-045

      Mechanism

      Reassess models, assumptions and measures when demand, case mix, resources, interfaces or actual practices change. Distinguish benign variation from a changed mechanism and avoid updating the model merely to normalise a harmful deviation.

      Bearer

      Changed demand, models, practice and assumptions requiring reassessment

      Authority

      Analysts identify changed evidence; owners and affected actors decide whether models, operations or objectives need revision.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-045#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-045#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-046

      Mechanism

      Separate model change, implementation, adoption and measured outcome change. Review the proposed mechanism against observed consequences and retire, simplify or replace a control when its risk, consumer or payoff no longer warrants its cost.

      Bearer

      Post-enactment outcome evaluation and control continuation/retirement decision

      Authority

      Owners and sponsors decide continuation within their powers; affected actors provide evidence of benefits and burdens.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Mechanism

      Allow feedback to change a representation, the real work, the measure or the intervention hypothesis, but distinguish these acts. Review their consistency and continuity: updating a diagram does not change work, and changed work may require a revised account without implying improvement.

      Bearer

      Coupled but distinct revisions of representations, actual work, measures and hypotheses

      Authority

      Modellers may revise descriptions within their remit; changing operational commitments or evaluation criteria requires the responsible authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-048

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-048

      Mechanism

      Check the actual marking, data, completed work, pending interactions and relevant constraints when migrating an instance; a sound new definition alone is insufficient.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Migration permission must cover changed obligations, not just permission to edit a diagram.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-049

      Mechanism

      Declare deployment selection and permit coexistence where appropriate, with clear routing of new work, events and operators to the right version.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Coexistence must not silently violate externally required rule changes; those obligations need separate judgement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-050

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-050

      Mechanism

      Select the flexibility mechanism according to whether variation is anticipated, temporarily tolerated, deliberately left open or requires a changed definition/state.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Freedom to choose a next step does not authorise changing the constraints that make it acceptable.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-050#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-050#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-056

      Mechanism

      Check log-to-case/activity/order assumptions and the model’s intended scope before interpreting deviations or conformance as evidence about enactment.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      A detected mismatch is a question for adjudication, not automatic authority to sanction or repair.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-073

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-073

      Mechanism

      Bind and disclose the environment needed to interpret a decision or continuation, and evaluate declared compatibility before combining outputs from changed environments.

      Bearer

      Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

      Authority

      A compatibility declaration is not proof of correctness and cannot authorise its own acceptance.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-073#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-076

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-076

      Mechanism

      Recover or revise an instance only with a coherent account of its governing version, current state, pending work, message/effect identities and known external outcomes.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Continuity does not grant authority to modify prior commitments or fabricate missing evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-076#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-076#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-038

      Mechanism

      Decide whether evidence supports correcting data, repairing a descriptive model, changing execution or formally revising an authorised rule. For model repair, preserve unaffected intent and re-evaluate changed behaviour; maintain the prior reference when continuity matters.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Model maintainer can repair a descriptive model within mandate; changing an obligation requires its own authorised actor and process. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-054

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-054

      Mechanism

      Keep observation windows, event-schema versions, model versions and reference expectations distinguishable; tie a result to the regime in which its assumptions were assessed. Preserve enough prior identity to compare changes or reconstruct a past decision.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data and model custodians communicate changes; consumers know which temporal claim a result supports. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-055

      Mechanism

      Choose observable features and a detector matched to the relevant kind of change; evaluate sensitivity, false alarms, detection delay and resource costs under plausible stable and changed conditions. Treat an alarm as evidence for investigation, not proof of a particular cause.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Analyst defines and evaluates detection; operational/model authorities decide what a confirmed change means. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-056

      Mechanism

      On an apparent drift, compare instrumentation, extraction, population and process explanations; inspect the change history and selected raw examples. Revise the process hypothesis only after distinguishing or explicitly retaining these alternatives.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data custodian explains instrumentation; analyst evaluates the observed shift; process authority decides on operational consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-057

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-057

      Mechanism

      Specify window/forgetting policy, event arrival order, late-data handling and prefix semantics; expose the trade-off between latency, memory and historical coverage. Assess partial-case conformance as partial rather than pretending the case has ended.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Stream analyst or service operator discloses retention and delay to the decision consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-057#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-057#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-058

      Mechanism

      Maintain a distinction between the model describing recent behaviour and any stable or separately authorised reference. Compare them, diagnose change and obtain the relevant decision before amending obligations; adaptation of description is not self-authorising revision.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Analyst may update a descriptive estimate within scope; rule owners or other entitled actors decide whether the intended process changes. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-059

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-059

      Mechanism

      Reject automatic normative normalisation. Drift may warrant a new descriptive model, process correction, instrumentation repair or an authorised rule review; detection alone selects none of these.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Only the relevant authorised actor can revise an obligation; a detector has no such authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-059#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-059#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-066

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-066

      Mechanism

      Record when recommendations or interventions alter exposure, action selection or outcomes; reassess predictive, calibration and causal claims against the new regime. Preserve the prior evaluation as historical evidence and explicitly test the revised policy or narrow its use.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst identifies changed validity conditions; operational authority decides continued use, revision or retirement based on new evidence. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-066#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-066#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Changing description, actual work, instrumentation and obligations must not be conflated. An alarm invites inquiry; neither a new descriptive model nor an old reference self-authorises current work.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K023

    Name

    Prediction, simulation and causal restraint

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-019

    • EBPM:EBPM-021

    • EBPM:EBPM-022

    • EBPM:EBPM-023

    • EBPM:EBPM-051

    • EWM:EWM-019

    • EWM:EWM-028

    • EWM:EWM-063

    • EWM:EWM-074

    • EPM:EPM-028

    • EPM:EPM-043

    • EPM:EPM-052

    • EPM:EPM-060

    • EPM:EPM-061

    • EPM:EPM-062

    • EPM:EPM-063

    • EPM:EPM-064

    • EPM:EPM-068

    Shared concern

    Predictive or simulated adequacy does not establish the effect of a feasible real intervention.

    Distinction

    Technical performance, causal identification and realised outcomes have distinct assumptions and evidence.

    Trigger

    Forecasts, scores or scenario results are used to choose or justify an intervention.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-019

      Mechanism

      Examine demand, service variation, shared capacity and allocation rules together before adding resources or seeking maximum utilisation. Use a queueing model or simulation only when its assumptions represent the relevant work; recheck the end-to-end constraint after a local change.

      Bearer

      Capacity/queueing/simulation model and conditional intervention predictions

      Authority

      Resource managers can change capacity and assignment; analysts supply conditional predictions, not authority to alter staffing or worker obligations.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-021

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-021

      Mechanism

      Calibrate the model to the relevant case mix, resource behaviour and current work state; validate predictions against observations and report uncertainty and sensitivity. Treat scenarios as conditional forecasts, not observed consequences of an intervention.

      Bearer

      Capacity/queueing/simulation model and conditional intervention predictions

      Authority

      Analysts own model assumptions; operational decision makers decide whether the conditional evidence justifies action.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-021#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-021#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-022

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-022

      Mechanism

      Distinguish description, prediction and causal intervention claims. State the proposed mechanism, plausible confounding and comparison; use stronger designs or bounded trials when an observational association could recommend the wrong intervention.

      Bearer

      Intervention hypotheses, comparisons and analytical claim roles

      Authority

      Analysts can identify evidence limits; authorised owners decide on precaution, experimentation or non-intervention.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-022#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-022#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-023

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-023

      Mechanism

      Form a specific change hypothesis and compare it with plausible organisational, informational and technical alternatives, including doing nothing. Define what would count as improvement, what may not worsen and how the choice will be evaluated after enactment.

      Bearer

      Intervention hypotheses, comparisons and analytical claim roles

      Authority

      Owners/sponsors authorise changes within their remit; performers and recipients contribute feasibility and harm evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-023#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-023#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-051

      Mechanism

      Use analytical outputs as evidence for accountable inquiry and intervention, preserving data, causal and organisational limits. Distinguish descriptive pattern, predictive performance, feasible intervention and achieved outcome.

      Bearer

      Intervention hypotheses, comparisons and analytical claim roles

      Authority

      Analysts and tools generate evidence or recommendations; process actors retain responsibility for actions and consequences.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-019

      Mechanism

      Assess whether eligible resources and time assumptions can support the enabled work, and specify what happens when they cannot.

      Bearer

      Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

      Authority

      Availability cannot be conjured by assigning a role; escalating does not grant competence or permission.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-028

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-028

      Mechanism

      Relate queue policy and escalation to actual capacity, calendars and service needs; surface starvation and overload rather than optimising only local throughput.

      Bearer

      Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

      Authority

      Escalation requests a decision; it does not authorise bypassing duty or competence requirements.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-028#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-028#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      A measured efficiency gain does not authorise shifting unacceptable burdens to others.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-074

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-074

      Mechanism

      Treat proposed optimisation as an unvalidated change requiring an external objective, semantic constraints, authority, evaluation and continuity checks; no general guarantee is supplied.

      Bearer

      Unresolved general autonomous workflow optimisation capability

      Authority

      The optimiser cannot confer on itself the authority or criteria for accepting its own change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-074#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-074#/criticism

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-028

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-028

      Mechanism

      State observational equivalence and the limits of the sampled behaviour. Where competing models make different consequential predictions, seek discriminating data or domain evidence; otherwise retain alternatives or a weaker conclusion rather than asserting unique recovery.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates what is and is not identified; domain evidence can discriminate but must not be silently smuggled into the log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-028#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-028#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-043

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-043

      Mechanism

      Match the experimental unit, split and comparison to the intended inference; isolate test information from tuning, preserve appropriate temporal availability, include meaningful baselines and account for failures/timeouts. State exactly what the dataset collection can and cannot represent.

      Bearer

      Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

      Authority

      Researcher designs the comparison; reviewer checks whether the conclusion follows from its units and assumptions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-043#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-043#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-052

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-052

      Mechanism

      Use simulation to explore consequences under stated process, resource, arrival and intervention assumptions; compare baseline reproduction and sensitivity before drawing a conditional scenario conclusion. Keep calibration evidence separate from intervention validation.

      Bearer

      Conditional simulation scenarios and counterfactual interpretation

      Authority

      Analyst constructs scenarios; authorised decision makers choose whether and how to test them in reality. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-052#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-052#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-060

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-060

      Mechanism

      Define the prediction occasion and information available at that moment, including attribute update histories and cross-case state. Construct features and labels accordingly; keep post-outcome or future-derived information outside the predictor and its tuning.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Predictive analyst establishes temporal eligibility; operational consumer confirms when information and action opportunities actually exist. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-060#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-060#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-061

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-061

      Mechanism

      Split at the unit and time boundary appropriate to the deployment claim; ensure training outcomes were available then, keep dependent prefixes together where required, and disclose censoring, length restrictions and exclusions. Report performance by meaningful decision horizon and compare an adequate simple baseline.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Researcher states the claim and split design; reviewer examines what excluded cases and dependence do to the result. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-061#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-061#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-062

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-062

      Mechanism

      Choose uncertainty measures appropriate to the decision, evaluate calibration/coverage and set usefulness separately, and provide a human-review or abstention path where uncertainty defeats actionability. State assumptions such as exchangeability, valid calibration separation and limits under drift.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Analyst explains uncertainty semantics; accountable operators decide how uncertain cases are handled rather than reading a singleton set as certainty. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-062#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-062#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate predictive utility at actual decision times, accounting for lead time, false alarms, intervention capacity and opportunity cost. Choose thresholds or policies against an explicit decision objective rather than accuracy alone.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Operational authority specifies available actions and resource limits; the analyst evaluates decision support within those bounds. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-064

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-064

      Mechanism

      Define the intervention, outcome and comparison; state the identification assumptions and assess confounding, treatment availability, temporal order and support. Use experimental or suitably justified causal evidence for interventional claims, and otherwise present recommendations as hypotheses requiring evaluation.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst establishes the causal claim’s conditions; authorised decision makers decide whether a test or intervention is acceptable. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep broad deployed benefit unresolved. Retain the narrower formal, simulation and retrospective findings and specify the prospective, multi-setting intervention evidence needed for stronger transfer.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Researcher and operational evaluator must establish realised effects; a developer’s simulation is not a deployment verdict. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Predictive or simulated adequacy does not establish the effect of a feasible real intervention. Technical performance, causal identification and realised outcomes have distinct assumptions and evidence.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.
