  • Id

    BWP-K024

    Name

    Recommendation, action and achieved effect

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-031

    • EBPM:EBPM-040

    • EBPM:EBPM-044

    • EBPM:EBPM-051

    • EBPM:EBPM-058

    • EBPM:EBPM-061

    • EBPM:EBPM-068

    • EWM:EWM-019

    • EWM:EWM-025

    • EWM:EWM-030

    • EWM:EWM-057

    • EWM:EWM-062

    • EWM:EWM-071

    • EWM:EWM-074

    • EPM:EPM-053

    • EPM:EPM-063

    • EPM:EPM-064

    • EPM:EPM-065

    • EPM:EPM-068

    • EPM:EPM-080

    Shared concern

    Warrant, authority, enactment and effect are separate links rather than an automatic pipeline.

    Distinction

    Advice may be ignored, infeasible, impermissible or ineffective despite locally valid analysis.

    Trigger

    A recommendation is promoted into action or a successful outcome claim.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-031

      Mechanism

      Connect responsibility for the process outcome with sufficient influence, knowledge, resources and an escalation route across participating functions. Separate an owner title from the powers actually exercised.

      Bearer

      Process governance arrangements and exercised authority

      Authority

      The process owner acts within delegated powers; functional and professional authorities retain powers not transferred. Conflicts require negotiation or escalation, not fictitious unilateral control.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-040

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-040

      Mechanism

      Treat enactment as the joint establishment of working technology, roles, skills, resources, coordination and actual adoption. Verify that actors can perform the intended work and that the organisation receives the outcome; deployment is only one observation.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      Sponsors resource change; owners coordinate adoption; technical teams control only technical deployment within their mandate.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-040#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-040#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-044

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-044

      Mechanism

      Connect each consequential indicator to a decision, a responsible consumer and a feasible action or inquiry. A dashboard can inform action but its production is not itself adaptation or improvement.

      Bearer

      Monitoring outputs linked, or not linked, to a capable decision consumer

      Authority

      Monitoring analysts provide evidence; authorised owners or professionals decide interventions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-044#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-044#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-051

      Mechanism

      Use analytical outputs as evidence for accountable inquiry and intervention, preserving data, causal and organisational limits. Distinguish descriptive pattern, predictive performance, feasible intervention and achieved outcome.

      Bearer

      Intervention hypotheses, comparisons and analytical claim roles

      Authority

      Analysts and tools generate evidence or recommendations; process actors retain responsibility for actions and consequences.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-058

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Automation can amplify a flawed decision, shift manual repair or fail to be adopted.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      Automation executes delegated operations; it does not establish the legitimacy of the underlying business decision.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-061

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-061

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. A report with no capable consumer or consequential decision is not a functioning feedback mechanism.

      Bearer

      Monitoring outputs linked, or not linked, to a capable decision consumer

      Authority

      Monitoring analysts provide evidence; authorised owners or professionals decide interventions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-061#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-061#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep three linked but non-equivalent claims explicit: evidence supports a distinction about work; an identified actor is authorised and able to intervene; observed consequences support an outcome judgement. Require the missing link to be established before promoting one claim into another.

      Bearer

      Evidence-to-authorised-action-to-observed-consequence relations for managed work

      Authority

      Evidence producers do not acquire execution powers by analysis; authorised actors do not acquire factual correctness by holding office.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-019

      Mechanism

      Assess whether eligible resources and time assumptions can support the enabled work, and specify what happens when they cannot.

      Bearer

      Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

      Authority

      Availability cannot be conjured by assigning a role; escalating does not grant competence or permission.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-025

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-025

      Mechanism

      Separate role eligibility, current authorisation, competence and availability; obtain each needed condition from an appropriate authority rather than from a worklist label.

      Bearer

      Actor eligibility/authority/competence, work-item ownership and assignment constraints

      Authority

      Workflow assignment records do not create external legal, professional or organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-025#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-025#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-030

      Mechanism

      Define what evidence is sufficient for the claimed result and distinguish performer declaration, recipient acceptance and independently established effect.

      Bearer

      Performer declarations, commitments, recipient acceptance and established effects

      Authority

      Acceptance is an authorised judgement within a stated scope, not a metaphysical guarantee or substitute for consent.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-057

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-057

      Mechanism

      Connect each monitored quantity to a decision-maker and a possible action, while preserving scope, uncertainty and incentives.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Monitoring does not authorise intervention beyond the responsible actor’s powers.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-057#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-057#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-062

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-062

      Mechanism

      Treat generated routes or decisions as proposals under separately established semantic, authority, effect and observation constraints; distinguish configuration links from actual execution paths.

      Bearer

      Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

      Authority

      An agent’s generated instruction is not self-authorising; external permissions and approval remain separate.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-062#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-062#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-071

      Mechanism

      No universal improvement guarantee is established; use EWM-063’s contextual evaluation, retain measured gains and include failed implementations without treating organisational cancellation as proof of engine malfunction.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      Efficiency rhetoric does not settle whose costs count or legitimise every organisational change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-074

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-074

      Mechanism

      Treat proposed optimisation as an unvalidated change requiring an external objective, semantic constraints, authority, evaluation and continuity checks; no general guarantee is supplied.

      Bearer

      Unresolved general autonomous workflow optimisation capability

      Authority

      The optimiser cannot confer on itself the authority or criteria for accepting its own change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-074#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-074#/criticism

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-053

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-053

      Mechanism

      Identify who needs the result, what decision it can change and what observation would establish the consequence. Separate analytical delivery, organisational agreement, implemented action and measured outcome; stop or retire an analysis without an adequate consumer.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates evidence and uncertainty; operational actors act within their mandate; outcome measurement must not be replaced by analyst self-report. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate predictive utility at actual decision times, accounting for lead time, false alarms, intervention capacity and opportunity cost. Choose thresholds or policies against an explicit decision objective rather than accuracy alone.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Operational authority specifies available actions and resource limits; the analyst evaluates decision support within those bounds. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-064

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-064

      Mechanism

      Define the intervention, outcome and comparison; state the identification assumptions and assess confounding, treatment availability, temporal order and support. Use experimental or suitably justified causal evidence for interventional claims, and otherwise present recommendations as hypotheses requiring evaluation.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst establishes the causal claim’s conditions; authorised decision makers decide whether a test or intervention is acceptable. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-065

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-065

      Mechanism

      Restrict recommendations to actions that the recipient can perform within actual authority, timing and resource constraints; expose uncertainty and alternatives, allow rejection, and observe the action actually taken rather than equating advice with execution.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Operational actors retain the authority specified by the setting; analysts or models cannot grant themselves new powers through recommendations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep broad deployed benefit unresolved. Retain the narrower formal, simulation and retrospective findings and specify the prospective, multi-setting intervention evidence needed for stronger transfer.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Researcher and operational evaluator must establish realised effects; a developer’s simulation is not a deployment verdict. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-080

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-080

      Mechanism

      Reject the inference from observation or model competence to operative authority. Require a separately established actor, mandate, feasible action and consequence evaluation for any real change.

      Bearer

      AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

      Authority

      External accountable actors retain their actual authority; no authority is created by the analytical system. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-080#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-080#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Warrant, authority, enactment and effect are separate links rather than an automatic pipeline. Advice may be ignored, infeasible, impermissible or ineffective despite locally valid analysis.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K025

    Name

    Intervention evaluation under a changed regime

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-017

    • EBPM:EBPM-022

    • EBPM:EBPM-023

    • EBPM:EBPM-040

    • EBPM:EBPM-046

    • EBPM:EBPM-069

    • EBPM:EBPM-071

    • EWM:EWM-048

    • EWM:EWM-055

    • EWM:EWM-058

    • EWM:EWM-063

    • EWM:EWM-071

    • EPM:EPM-008

    • EPM:EPM-043

    • EPM:EPM-051

    • EPM:EPM-054

    • EPM:EPM-056

    • EPM:EPM-061

    • EPM:EPM-064

    • EPM:EPM-066

    • EPM:EPM-083

    • EPM:EPM-084

    Shared concern

    A correct change and correctly calculated metric can still support a wrong improvement attribution.

    Distinction

    Outcome boundary, state migration and observation-population comparability must be checked without conflating them.

    Trigger

    Enactment changes exposure, case mix, instrumentation, timing or external burdens.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Mechanism

      Use measures that represent the intended received outcome and material costs, with case mix and affected groups visible. Keep time, effort, quality, flexibility, resilience and fairness distinct where they can move in opposing directions; select justified constraints and priorities rather than pretending all are maximised.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      Accountable decision makers choose priorities with affected-party input; analysts expose measurement limitations rather than choosing values by convenience.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-017#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-017#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-022

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-022

      Mechanism

      Distinguish description, prediction and causal intervention claims. State the proposed mechanism, plausible confounding and comparison; use stronger designs or bounded trials when an observational association could recommend the wrong intervention.

      Bearer

      Intervention hypotheses, comparisons and analytical claim roles

      Authority

      Analysts can identify evidence limits; authorised owners decide on precaution, experimentation or non-intervention.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-022#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-022#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-023

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-023

      Mechanism

      Form a specific change hypothesis and compare it with plausible organisational, informational and technical alternatives, including doing nothing. Define what would count as improvement, what may not worsen and how the choice will be evaluated after enactment.

      Bearer

      Intervention hypotheses, comparisons and analytical claim roles

      Authority

      Owners/sponsors authorise changes within their remit; performers and recipients contribute feasibility and harm evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-023#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-023#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-040

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-040

      Mechanism

      Treat enactment as the joint establishment of working technology, roles, skills, resources, coordination and actual adoption. Verify that actors can perform the intended work and that the organisation receives the outcome; deployment is only one observation.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      Sponsors resource change; owners coordinate adoption; technical teams control only technical deployment within their mandate.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-040#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-040#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-046

      Mechanism

      Separate model change, implementation, adoption and measured outcome change. Review the proposed mechanism against observed consequences and retire, simplify or replace a control when its risk, consumer or payoff no longer warrants its cost.

      Bearer

      Post-enactment outcome evaluation and control continuation/retirement decision

      Authority

      Owners and sponsors decide continuation within their powers; affected actors provide evidence of benefits and burdens.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Mechanism

      Accept an improvement claim only over its declared consequence boundary and protected outcomes. A local gain remains qualified when material receiving-side burdens are unknown; do not aggregate away a harmed group or silently change the boundary to rescue the claim.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      The party claiming benefit cannot unilaterally accept another party’s material burden as harmless.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-069#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-069#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Mechanism

      Allow feedback to change a representation, the real work, the measure or the intervention hypothesis, but distinguish these acts. Review their consistency and continuity: updating a diagram does not change work, and changed work may require a revised account without implying improvement.

      Bearer

      Coupled but distinct revisions of representations, actual work, measures and hypotheses

      Authority

      Modellers may revise descriptions within their remit; changing operational commitments or evaluation criteria requires the responsible authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-048

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-048

      Mechanism

      Check the actual marking, data, completed work, pending interactions and relevant constraints when migrating an instance; a sound new definition alone is insufficient.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Migration permission must cover changed obligations, not just permission to edit a diagram.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-055

      Mechanism

      Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-058

      Mechanism

      Identify the observation boundary and connect consequential claims to an appropriate external or participant source; preserve uncertainty when correspondence cannot be checked.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      An observer need not have authority to act, and a model’s certainty cannot replace a participant’s legitimate judgement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      A measured efficiency gain does not authorise shifting unacceptable burdens to others.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-071

      Mechanism

      No universal improvement guarantee is established; use EWM-063’s contextual evaluation, retain measured gains and include failed implementations without treating organisational cancellation as proof of engine malfunction.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      Efficiency rhetoric does not settle whose costs count or legitimise every organisational change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-008

      Mechanism

      Declare the target population and observation window; distinguish cases, events, objects and decision occasions; examine inclusion, censoring, unlogged work and changes in capture. Match the strength of a conclusion to the actual observation process.

      Bearer

      Analytical target population, unit and observation/censoring process

      Authority

      The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-043

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-043

      Mechanism

      Match the experimental unit, split and comparison to the intended inference; isolate test information from tuning, preserve appropriate temporal availability, include meaningful baselines and account for failures/timeouts. State exactly what the dataset collection can and cannot represent.

      Bearer

      Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

      Authority

      Researcher designs the comparison; reviewer checks whether the conclusion follows from its units and assumptions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-043#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-043#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-051

      Mechanism

      Compare like with like where possible, disclose subgroup and case-mix differences, and examine how selection, censoring and task allocation affect the result. When comparability fails, narrow the claim instead of normalising away inconvenient differences.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Analyst identifies comparability limits; affected participants and accountable decision makers assess the meaning and acceptable use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-054

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-054

      Mechanism

      Keep observation windows, event-schema versions, model versions and reference expectations distinguishable; tie a result to the regime in which its assumptions were assessed. Preserve enough prior identity to compare changes or reconstruct a past decision.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data and model custodians communicate changes; consumers know which temporal claim a result supports. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-056

      Mechanism

      On an apparent drift, compare instrumentation, extraction, population and process explanations; inspect the change history and selected raw examples. Revise the process hypothesis only after distinguishing or explicitly retaining these alternatives.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data custodian explains instrumentation; analyst evaluates the observed shift; process authority decides on operational consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-061

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-061

      Mechanism

      Split at the unit and time boundary appropriate to the deployment claim; ensure training outcomes were available then, keep dependent prefixes together where required, and disclose censoring, length restrictions and exclusions. Report performance by meaningful decision horizon and compare an adequate simple baseline.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Researcher states the claim and split design; reviewer examines what excluded cases and dependence do to the result. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-061#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-061#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-064

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-064

      Mechanism

      Define the intervention, outcome and comparison; state the identification assumptions and assess confounding, treatment availability, temporal order and support. Use experimental or suitably justified causal evidence for interventional claims, and otherwise present recommendations as hypotheses requiring evaluation.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst establishes the causal claim’s conditions; authorised decision makers decide whether a test or intervention is acceptable. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-066

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-066

      Mechanism

      Record when recommendations or interventions alter exposure, action selection or outcomes; reassess predictive, calibration and causal claims against the new regime. Preserve the prior evaluation as historical evidence and explicitly test the revised policy or narrow its use.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst identifies changed validity conditions; operational authority decides continued use, revision or retirement based on new evidence. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-066#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-066#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-083

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-083

      Mechanism

      Reject universal return. Assess benefits, acquisition and cleaning effort, interpretation, tooling, privacy, organisational response and opportunity cost for the actual purpose; retain negative, null and no-action outcomes.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      The accountable sponsor evaluates value; a vendor case or analyst report cannot establish universal economic authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-083#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-083#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A correct change and correctly calculated metric can still support a wrong improvement attribution. Outcome boundary, state migration and observation-population comparability must be checked without conflating them.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K026

    Name

    Proportionate mechanisms and control retirement

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-004

    • EBPM:EBPM-024

    • EBPM:EBPM-030

    • EBPM:EBPM-033

    • EBPM:EBPM-034

    • EBPM:EBPM-046

    • EBPM:EBPM-055

    • EBPM:EBPM-056

    • EBPM:EBPM-065

    • EBPM:EBPM-070

    • EWM:EWM-004

    • EWM:EWM-046

    • EWM:EWM-063

    • EWM:EWM-070

    • EWM:EWM-071

    • EWM:EWM-072

    • EPM:EPM-009

    • EPM:EPM-016

    • EPM:EPM-025

    • EPM:EPM-042

    • EPM:EPM-067

    • EPM:EPM-073

    • EPM:EPM-075

    • EPM:EPM-083

    Shared concern

    Individually useful machinery need not justify its combined cost or continued presence.

    Distinction

    Omission is conditional on preserving needed functions; neither maximal features nor minimal size is a universal optimum.

    Trigger

    A mechanism is added, retained, replaced, pooled or withdrawn.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-004

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-004

      Mechanism

      Select interventions according to outcome importance, observed problems, dependencies and feasible change, not the convenience of what is already modelled. Include no intervention and deferred investigation as legitimate portfolio decisions.

      Bearer

      Intervention portfolio and chosen scale of change

      Authority

      Sponsors allocate scarce effort; affected process owners challenge feasibility and displacement assumptions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-004#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-004#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-024

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-024

      Mechanism

      Before deleting a task, identify both its productive and protective functions, their consumers, and whether another mechanism preserves necessary assurance. Compare avoided effort with the error or accountability exposure created by removal.

      Bearer

      Tasks/controls proposed for removal and their protected functions

      Authority

      The owner can propose deletion; the party accountable for the controlled consequence must be involved in accepting the changed exposure.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-024#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-024#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-030

      Mechanism

      Choose the scale and pace of change by the inadequacy of the current mechanism, uncertainty, transition risk and continuity needs. Consider radical replacement, incremental repair, mixed migration and no change as genuine alternatives.

      Bearer

      Intervention portfolio and chosen scale of change

      Authority

      Sponsors authorise strategic disruption; performers and affected recipients contribute transition and continuity evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-033

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-033

      Mechanism

      Select centralised, decentralised or federated governance according to process interdependence, organisational context and available capabilities. Specify the decisions each arrangement enables rather than treating a BPM office as a universal requirement.

      Bearer

      Process governance arrangements and exercised authority

      Authority

      A BPM office may advise, enable or govern only within its mandate; process and functional managers retain explicitly allocated decisions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-033#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-033#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-034

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-034

      Mechanism

      Use a capability assessment as a fallible diagnostic hypothesis about specific competencies, not as a proxy for process success or an obligatory stage ladder. Check evidence behind ratings and whether the proposed development addresses a real outcome problem.

      Bearer

      Capability/maturity assessments and claims made from their artefacts or ratings

      Authority

      Assessors describe evidence and limits; sponsors decide whether an identified capability warrants investment.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-034#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-034#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-046

      Mechanism

      Separate model change, implementation, adoption and measured outcome change. Review the proposed mechanism against observed consequences and retire, simplify or replace a control when its risk, consumer or payoff no longer warrants its cost.

      Bearer

      Post-enactment outcome evaluation and control continuation/retirement decision

      Authority

      Owners and sponsors decide continuation within their powers; affected actors provide evidence of benefits and burdens.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-055

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Disruption and transition costs can dominate, while incremental repair or no change may address the actual problem.

      Bearer

      Intervention portfolio and chosen scale of change

      Authority

      Sponsors authorise strategic disruption; performers and affected recipients contribute transition and continuity evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-056

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Artefacts and self-assessed stages do not establish exercised capability or received outcomes.

      Bearer

      Capability/maturity assessments and claims made from their artefacts or ratings

      Authority

      Assessors describe evidence and limits; sponsors decide whether an identified capability warrants investment.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-065

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-065

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Some steps protect against consequential error or preserve legitimate judgement; their functions cannot be erased by relabelling them overhead.

      Bearer

      Tasks/controls proposed for removal and their protected functions

      Authority

      The owner can propose deletion; the party accountable for the controlled consequence must be involved in accepting the changed exposure.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-065#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-065#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-070

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-070

      Mechanism

      Select a proportionate adequate portfolio from feasible considered alternatives that covers the actual purpose, evidence, authority and feedback needs. Compare shared functions, dependencies and total burden; omit or retire machinery whose function is adequately supplied or no longer needed. A global minimum is not established.

      Bearer

      The jointly sufficient portfolio of BPM mechanisms, dependencies and costs

      Authority

      The accountable consumer and affected actors judge adequacy; method specialists do not mandate tools merely because they are standard practice.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-070#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-070#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-004

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-004

      Mechanism

      Select the least costly representation and enactment mechanism adequate to the actual coordination risk and its consumer; revisit it when risk or demand changes.

      Bearer

      Selected workflow representation/enactment infrastructure and total fitness/cost

      Authority

      Technical elegance or a licence purchase does not authorise redesign of other people’s responsibilities.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-004#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-004#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-046

      Mechanism

      Determine the minimum retained state, history and external references required for specified recovery, review and continuity claims; retire records only after those consumers and obligations are addressed.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      This is not legal retention advice; applicable obligations must be supplied by the relevant authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      A measured efficiency gain does not authorise shifting unacceptable burdens to others.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-070

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-070

      Mechanism

      Replace feature-count maximisation with fit to required behaviours, semantic fidelity and total operating cost.

      Bearer

      Selected workflow representation/enactment infrastructure and total fitness/cost

      Authority

      Feature counts do not authorise adoption or prove organisational benefit.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-070#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-070#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-071

      Mechanism

      No universal improvement guarantee is established; use EWM-063’s contextual evaluation, retain measured gains and include failed implementations without treating organisational cancellation as proof of engine malfunction.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      Efficiency rhetoric does not settle whose costs count or legitimise every organisational change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-072

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-072

      Mechanism

      Replace unlimited retention with claim-relative sufficient state and a justified retirement rule.

      Bearer

      History-retention policy and continuing recovery/evidence consumers

      Authority

      This packet determines no legal retention period or permission to erase required records.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-072#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-072#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-009

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-009

      Mechanism

      Specify what uncertainty additional logging would reduce, compare it with burden and exposure, and collect only the granularity and retention needed for that purpose. Reassess the need when the consumer or risk changes.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Operational and data-governance decision makers authorise collection; analysts advise on informational value, not unilateral monitoring rights. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-009#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-009#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-016

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-016

      Mechanism

      Compare candidate representations against the actual distinction required, data availability, interpretation burden and computational cost. Prefer the least costly representation that preserves the consequential relation, not necessarily the fewest nodes.

      Bearer

      Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

      Authority

      Analyst and consumer jointly select a representation; maximal expressiveness is not a delegated objective. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-016#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-016#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-025

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-025

      Mechanism

      Search candidate models using explicit fitness objectives, mutation/crossover choices, resource limits and stochastic seeds; retain multiple runs and compare with simpler baselines. Do not interpret the returned best candidate as a proven global optimum.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst chooses the search objective and stopping condition; the optimiser cannot supply the missing definition of a useful process. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-025#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-025#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-042

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-042

      Mechanism

      Evaluate simplicity relative to the consumer’s task and notation knowledge; inspect whether required distinctions and important exceptions remain accessible. Consider interpretive and maintenance burden, not only structural size.

      Bearer

      Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

      Authority

      The actual consumer supplies evidence of usability; analysts should not substitute aesthetic preference for task performance. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-042#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-042#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-067

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-067

      Mechanism

      Reject the universal claim; compare appropriate baselines on valid task-specific splits, including inference cost, data needs, interpretability and timing.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Analyst supplies evidence; consumer judges cost and decision relevance rather than accepting architectural prestige. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-067#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-067#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-073

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-073

      Mechanism

      Do not export dashboard possession as an obligation. Evaluate whether a representation supports the actual traceable inference and consumer interaction; keep the tool only if it earns that role.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      Consumer evaluates function; vendor or project branding does not establish analytical authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-073#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-075

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-075

      Mechanism

      Permit non-use, narrowed use and retirement when the data cannot support the question, the result cannot affect a legitimate decision, or the harm/cost exceeds its plausible value. State what evidence or changed condition would justify reconsideration.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      The accountable consumer and data authority decide whether to proceed; analysts must be able to report an evidence gap without manufacturing a model. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-075#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-075#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-083

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-083

      Mechanism

      Reject universal return. Assess benefits, acquisition and cleaning effort, interpretation, tooling, privacy, organisational response and opportunity cost for the actual purpose; retain negative, null and no-action outcomes.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      The accountable sponsor evaluates value; a vendor case or analyst report cannot establish universal economic authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-083#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-083#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Individually useful machinery need not justify its combined cost or continued presence. Omission is conditional on preserving needed functions; neither maximal features nor minimal size is a universal optimum.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    Current scientific account

    Each actual candidate supplies its protected function or evidence limit to a feasible considered portfolio comparison. Selection/retirement constrains use, not the truth of a theorem or unresolved scientific claim. Adequacy among considered alternatives is not global minimality.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    Shared concern

    Accountability and analytical usefulness do not authorise unrestricted identification or disclosure.

    Distinction

    Access, result disclosure, differential burden and the power to challenge attributions require distinct decisions.

    Trigger

    Shared data or people-related conclusions create material visibility or distributional consequences.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Mechanism

      Use measures that represent the intended received outcome and material costs, with case mix and affected groups visible. Keep time, effort, quality, flexibility, resilience and fairness distinct where they can move in opposing directions; select justified constraints and priorities rather than pretending all are maximised.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      Accountable decision makers choose priorities with affected-party input; analysts expose measurement limitations rather than choosing values by convenience.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-017#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-017#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-029

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-029

      Mechanism

      Separate materially different cases where this improves fit, but validate classification quality and the burdens imposed on difficult or disadvantaged cases. Reassess class boundaries when demand changes.

      Bearer

      Case coordination, allocation, pooling and segmentation arrangements

      Authority

      Classification and resource-allocation decisions require accountable authority; analysts do not define acceptable exclusion alone.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-029#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-029#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-035

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-035

      Mechanism

      Involve those performing and receiving work in discovery, redesign and evaluation; provide skills and incentives that permit the intended behaviour. Treat participation as consequential influence and learning, not attendance or consultation without effect.

      Bearer

      Participant validation, learning and consequential participation arrangements

      Authority

      Sponsors resource participation; performers contribute operational knowledge; consultation does not erase formal accountability.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-035#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-035#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-038

      Mechanism

      Limit process visibility and automated judgements to a declared purpose with appropriate access, participation and challenge. Examine privacy, surveillance, fairness and worker/recipient burdens as design consequences, not external afterthoughts.

      Bearer

      Process visibility, appraisal, incentives and affected-person protection

      Authority

      Managers do not acquire unlimited surveillance authority through technical availability; applicable professional, organisational and legal constraints require separate determination.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-039

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-039

      Mechanism

      Interpret indicators in light of the behaviour they reward, omitted work and differences in case difficulty. Use multiple relevant observations and inquiry into gaming rather than assuming the measured quantity remains a neutral description once tied to appraisal.

      Bearer

      Process visibility, appraisal, incentives and affected-person protection

      Authority

      Appraisal decision-makers are accountable for the use of measures; analysts must expose limitations rather than authorising sanctions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-039#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-039#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Mechanism

      Reconcile the meanings of cases, events, messages and completion across interfaces while limiting disclosure to a justified purpose. Technical schema compatibility is not enough when organisations interpret the same field differently.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians control authorised disclosure; process parties jointly resolve business meaning within their commitments.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-050

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-050

      Mechanism

      Include material environmental and societal consequences in process purpose, boundaries and redesign comparisons. Identify who or what bears these effects and distinguish measured outcomes from reporting capability, commitments or maturity ratings.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      Sponsors and owners decide within legitimate constraints; affected parties and domain experts contribute consequences that internal metrics may omit.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-050#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-050#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-021

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-021

      Mechanism

      Define who reads/writes each relevant value, when binding occurs and whether values are copied, shared or referenced across scopes.

      Bearer

      Task data flow, binding, ownership, freshness and concurrent-update semantics

      Authority

      Workflow scope is not legal or organisational authority; access policy needs its own basis.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-021#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-021#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-025

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-025

      Mechanism

      Separate role eligibility, current authorisation, competence and availability; obtain each needed condition from an appropriate authority rather than from a worklist label.

      Bearer

      Actor eligibility/authority/competence, work-item ownership and assignment constraints

      Authority

      Workflow assignment records do not create external legal, professional or organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-025#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-025#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-029

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-029

      Mechanism

      Check assignment satisfiability under the stated constraint language; recheck when users, roles or prior assignments change.

      Bearer

      Actor eligibility/authority/competence, work-item ownership and assignment constraints

      Authority

      A satisfying assignment is permission-consistent in the model, not proof of current availability or real-world authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-029#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-029#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-031

      Mechanism

      Include participants in defining and revising workflow support, and provide a way to handle legitimate work outside the prescription without pretending it never happened.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      Discretion has boundaries; recognising situated work does not authorise every deviation.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-046

      Mechanism

      Determine the minimum retained state, history and external references required for specified recovery, review and continuity claims; retire records only after those consumers and obligations are addressed.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      This is not legal retention advice; applicable obligations must be supplied by the relevant authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-058

      Mechanism

      Identify the observation boundary and connect consequential claims to an appropriate external or participant source; preserve uncertainty when correspondence cannot be checked.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      An observer need not have authority to act, and a model’s certainty cannot replace a participant’s legitimate judgement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-072

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-072

      Mechanism

      Replace unlimited retention with claim-relative sufficient state and a justified retirement rule.

      Bearer

      History-retention policy and continuing recovery/evidence consumers

      Authority

      This packet determines no legal retention period or permission to erase required records.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-072#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-072#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-002

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-002

      Mechanism

      Retain a feasible trace-back from a consequential output through selected events, source identifiers and extraction versions. Use protected pseudonymous keys where direct identifiers are unnecessary. Record which lineage edges cannot be reconstructed.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst, data custodian and reviewer exchange the minimal trace evidence required to diagnose a result. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-002#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-002#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-009

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-009

      Mechanism

      Specify what uncertainty additional logging would reduce, compare it with burden and exposure, and collect only the granularity and retention needed for that purpose. Reassess the need when the consumer or risk changes.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Operational and data-governance decision makers authorise collection; analysts advise on informational value, not unilateral monitoring rights. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-009#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-009#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-013

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-013

      Mechanism

      Represent stable object identities and types, event–object participation and needed object–object relations; record qualifiers and temporal attribute changes when relevant. Preserve multiplicity instead of copying a shared event into fictional independent occurrences.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Data custodians establish identity conventions; analysts communicate relation meaning to the process consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-013#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-013#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-049

      Mechanism

      Establish what each resource identifier denotes and when the mapping changes; distinguish people, roles, teams, systems and accounts. Do not make individual-level claims from a coarser or ambiguous identifier.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Data custodian explains account semantics; affected participants can challenge attribution; analysts do not infer personal identity by convenience. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-050

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-050

      Mechanism

      Define the exact event-derived relation and its unit; validate what the metric means with organisational participants and separate technical handoff from social relationship. Prefer aggregates where individual identification is not needed.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Analyst describes the operational relation; participants contest interpretation; organisational decisions remain externally accountable. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-050#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-050#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-051

      Mechanism

      Compare like with like where possible, disclose subgroup and case-mix differences, and examine how selection, censoring and task allocation affect the result. When comparability fails, narrow the claim instead of normalising away inconvenient differences.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Analyst identifies comparability limits; affected participants and accountable decision makers assess the meaning and acceptable use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-071

      Mechanism

      Present traceable findings and competing explanations to relevant domain participants, including affected parties where people-related claims matter; record corrections, disagreement and evidence requested. Use focused challenge rather than treating agreement as truth.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Participants contribute situated evidence; authority to decide or revise policy remains distinct from expertise or seniority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-076

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-076

      Mechanism

      Define the protected information, adversary’s plausible background knowledge and release/processing boundary; select and evaluate privacy transformations against that model and measure analytical utility loss. Treat output disclosure separately from secure computation.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Data governance determines acceptable exposure; privacy specialists and analysts assess the mechanism and its loss of useful distinctions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-076#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-076#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-077

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-077

      Mechanism

      Limit people-related inference to supported units and legitimate purposes; expose data/metric limitations, assess differential representation and consequences, and provide a meaningful route to challenge or correct material attributions. Treat fairness as a separately specified concern, not a property inferred from conformance.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Affected participants can supply corrections and objections; institutional decision makers remain accountable for use and consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-077#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-077#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-078

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-078

      Mechanism

      Choose a federated protocol with explicit participant, identifier, activity-mapping and adversary assumptions; distinguish what is hidden during computation from what the protocol and released result reveal. Compare privacy, communication and computation costs with simpler aggregate exchange.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Participating organisations jointly authorise the computation and release; analysts cannot promise secrecy beyond the protocol’s boundary. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-078#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-078#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

  • Id

    BWP-K028

    Name

    Reproducibility versus truth and retention

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-009

    • EBPM:EBPM-011

    • EBPM:EBPM-057

    • EBPM:EBPM-062
