    • EPM:EPM-084

    Shared concern

    Custody and rerunability preserve a claim for examination, not its semantic truth.

    Distinction

    Workflow continuity and scientific reuse do not imply indefinite mining-data retention or valid world interpretation.

    Trigger

    A history, repeatable computation or package is offered as proof beyond identity or repeatability.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-009

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-009

      Mechanism

      Establish event meaning, case/object attribution, timestamp semantics, extraction scope and known omissions before using event evidence. Keep data-processing transformations traceable and expose activities that the instrumentation cannot observe.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians explain instrumentation; analysts own inference limits; process owners decide whether evidence is adequate for action.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-009#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-009#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Mechanism

      Check notation well-formedness separately from fidelity to the intended domain and understandability for the intended user. Use the corresponding test for each claim; one kind of validity cannot stand in for the others.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Tool validators assess encoded rules; domain experts assess meaning; users demonstrate comprehension. None alone certifies the other dimensions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Mechanism

      Reconcile the meanings of cases, events, messages and completion across interfaces while limiting disclosure to a justified purpose. Technical schema compatibility is not enough when organisations interpret the same field differently.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians control authorised disclosure; process parties jointly resolve business meaning within their commitments.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-057

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-057

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Syntax, execution semantics, domain accuracy, authority and actual enactment are distinct.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Implementers control deployed semantics within their authority; process owners and recipients establish real obligations and completion criteria.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-057#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-057#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-062

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-062

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Event recording is selective, case identity can misfit work and off-system coordination may be essential.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians explain instrumentation; analysts own inference limits; process owners decide whether evidence is adequate for action.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-062#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-062#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-046

      Mechanism

      Determine the minimum retained state, history and external references required for specified recovery, review and continuity claims; retire records only after those consumers and obligations are addressed.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      This is not legal retention advice; applicable obligations must be supplied by the relevant authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-055

      Mechanism

      Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-058

      Mechanism

      Identify the observation boundary and connect consequential claims to an appropriate external or participant source; preserve uncertainty when correspondence cannot be checked.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      An observer need not have authority to act, and a model’s certainty cannot replace a participant’s legitimate judgement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-059

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-059

      Mechanism

      Preserve the workflow, relevant input/dependency/environment identity and provenance needed for a declared rerun or result-comparison claim; choose an appropriate output oracle.

      Bearer

      Scientific workflow provenance, environments, execution and reproduction claims

      Authority

      Workflow execution is not scientific authority and metadata completeness does not validate an inference.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-059#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-059#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-068

      Mechanism

      No such general property exists; scope the history to observed events and couple stronger claims to appropriate external evidence.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      An internal record cannot overrule facts or testimony it never observed merely by being durable.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-072

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-072

      Mechanism

      Replace unlimited retention with claim-relative sufficient state and a justified retirement rule.

      Bearer

      History-retention policy and continuing recovery/evidence consumers

      Authority

      This packet determines no legal retention period or permission to erase required records.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-072#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-072#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-002

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-002

      Mechanism

      Retain a feasible trace-back from a consequential output through selected events, source identifiers and extraction versions. Use protected pseudonymous keys where direct identifiers are unnecessary. Record which lineage edges cannot be reconstructed.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst, data custodian and reviewer exchange the minimal trace evidence required to diagnose a result. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-002#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-002#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-003

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-003

      Mechanism

      State extraction predicates, join cardinalities, event-to-source mappings and inclusion/exclusion rules. Check material counts and sample reconciliations against the operational sources; preserve a route back to excluded or unresolved records.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Data engineer and analyst agree on transformation meaning with the domain consumer; technical ownership of SQL does not authorise redefining the work. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-003#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-003#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-007

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-007

      Mechanism

      Classify suspected defects, keep the original or a recoverable trace, justify each material repair, and compare important results with unrepaired or alternative treatments. Where correction is unsupported, carry uncertainty or decline the affected inference.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst and data custodian review repair rules; domain participants distinguish atypical work from recording error. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-007#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-007#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-010

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-010

      Mechanism

      Reject the sufficiency implication. Structural validity can be checked separately, but event meaning, extraction and representativeness still need their own evidence.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Data consumer must not accept technical parsing as semantic validation. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-010#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-010#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-011

      Mechanism

      Record the exact data format, version, required extensions and interpretation conventions; test representative round trips or imports. Preserve semantic mappings when converting between case-centric and object-centric formats.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Data producer and tool consumer agree on accepted meanings and reject silent coercions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-069

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-069

      Mechanism

      Preserve the executable transformation/analysis recipe, relevant data identity, parameters, tool and dependency versions, random seeds and excluded or failed runs. Where raw data cannot be shared, expose the limitation and provide lawful substitutes that support only their stated claims.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Analyst produces reproducible evidence; data custodians enforce access boundaries; reviewers distinguish executable replication from data access. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-069#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-069#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-070

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-070

      Mechanism

      Vary plausible consequential analytical choices and identify which findings survive; treat changed conclusions as evidence about assumption sensitivity rather than selecting the preferred run. Include simple baselines and report computational failures.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Analyst defines and reports sensitivity; reviewer challenges whether excluded alternatives were genuinely implausible. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-070#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-070#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-072

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-072

      Mechanism

      Record shared datasets, sites, experimental generators, author programmes and repeated cases; distinguish sample size within one study from independent replication. Preserve materially different versions without counting them as new field settings.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Evidence synthesiser reports dependence; consumers judge generality using actual independent settings rather than citation volume. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-072#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-072#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-074

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-074

      Mechanism

      Separate traceability and computational reproducibility from semantic, population, model and causal validity. Use auditability to expose assumptions and reproduce a challenge, not as a replacement for evidence about them.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Analyst and reviewer use custody evidence to examine claims; no actor receives extra substantive authority merely by maintaining a log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-074#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-074#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Custody and rerunability preserve a claim for examination, not its semantic truth. Workflow continuity and scientific reuse do not imply indefinite mining-data retention or valid world interpretation.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    None recorded.

    • EPM:EPM-065

    Shared concern

    Generated artefacts or bounded demonstrations do not settle generally safe autonomous process change.

    Distinction

    Low-code usability, semantic isolation, extracted event hypotheses and deployed causal benefit are different claims.

    Trigger

    Tool assistance or autonomous revision is proposed beyond an independently checked scope.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-040

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-040

      Mechanism

      Treat enactment as the joint establishment of working technology, roles, skills, resources, coordination and actual adoption. Verify that actors can perform the intended work and that the organisation receives the outcome; deployment is only one observation.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      Sponsors resource change; owners coordinate adoption; technical teams control only technical deployment within their mandate.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-040#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-040#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-041

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-041

      Mechanism

      Select automation according to process stability, interface characteristics, data quality, exception load and the value of human judgement. Compare interface-level RPA, deeper integration, bounded process-aware agents and non-automation; test the actual changed work rather than relying on a tool category.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      Automation executes delegated operations; it does not establish the legitimacy of the underlying business decision.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-041#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-041#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-052

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-052

      Mechanism

      Use generated process artefacts as drafts that require independent checking of syntax, domain meaning, omitted work and purpose. Separate benchmark task success from truthful reconstruction of an organisation and from authority to execute the generated design.

      Bearer

      AI-generated process artefacts and their independent acceptance checks

      Authority

      The model has no independent business authority; authorised people remain responsible for accepting representations and interventions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-052#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-052#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-053

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-053

      Mechanism

      Candidate proposition: agents could autonomously revise consequential organisational goals or process policies and enact the changes with accountable long-term outcomes. Bounded process-aware execution and supplied adaptations now have prototype and simulation evidence; transferable autonomous self-revision remains unresolved.

      Bearer

      Unresolved autonomous organisational process self-revision capability

      Authority

      A goal prompt does not grant unlimited organisational authority. Any permissible autonomy must be separately delegated and justified.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-053#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-053#/criticism

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-058

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Automation can amplify a flawed decision, shift manual repair or fail to be adopted.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      Automation executes delegated operations; it does not establish the legitimacy of the underlying business decision.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-072

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-072

      Mechanism

      Match low-code users’ skills, support, permitted scope and release authority to the consequences of the applications they build. Distinguish a simpler modelling interface from validated competence to change shared processes or sensitive data use.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      A citizen developer may create within delegated scope; platform access does not confer authority over another function’s commitments or protected data.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-072#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-072#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-018

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-018

      Mechanism

      Check the employed constructs and combinations against actual engine/version behaviour, including regressions, extensions and replay constraints.

      Bearer

      Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

      Authority

      Product branding is not an authority to assert untested semantics.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-018#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-018#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-061

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-061

      Mechanism

      Inspect the used abstraction’s execution, data, extension and exit boundaries before relying on visual simplicity or claimed portability.

      Bearer

      Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

      Authority

      An accessible editor does not authorise the user to automate every connected action.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-061#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-061#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-062

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-062

      Mechanism

      Treat generated routes or decisions as proposals under separately established semantic, authority, effect and observation constraints; distinguish configuration links from actual execution paths.

      Bearer

      Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

      Authority

      An agent’s generated instruction is not self-authorising; external permissions and approval remain separate.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-062#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-062#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-073

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-073

      Mechanism

      Bind and disclose the environment needed to interpret a decision or continuation, and evaluate declared compatibility before combining outputs from changed environments.

      Bearer

      Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

      Authority

      A compatibility declaration is not proof of correctness and cannot authorise its own acceptance.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-073#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-074

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-074

      Mechanism

      Treat proposed optimisation as an unvalidated change requiring an external objective, semantic constraints, authority, evaluation and continuity checks; no general guarantee is supplied.

      Bearer

      Unresolved general autonomous workflow optimisation capability

      Authority

      The optimiser cannot confer on itself the authority or criteria for accepting its own change.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-074#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-074#/criticism

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-065

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-065

      Mechanism

      Restrict recommendations to actions that the recipient can perform within actual authority, timing and resource constraints; expose uncertainty and alternatives, allow rejection, and observe the action actually taken rather than equating advice with execution.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Operational actors retain the authority specified by the setting; analysts or models cannot grant themselves new powers through recommendations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep broad deployed benefit unresolved. Retain the narrower formal, simulation and retrospective findings and specify the prospective, multi-setting intervention evidence needed for stronger transfer.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Researcher and operational evaluator must establish realised effects; a developer’s simulation is not a deployment verdict. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-079

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-079

      Mechanism

      Use LLM assistance for bounded tasks with explicit input, output semantics and independent checking of consequential claims or executable artefacts. Preserve source spans for extracted facts, tool/model versions and failed outputs; do not infer autonomous competence from a benchmark score.

      Bearer

      AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

      Authority

      Analyst retains responsibility for claims and tool execution; an LLM receives no operative authority from producing a plausible answer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-079#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-079#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-080

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-080

      Mechanism

      Reject the inference from observation or model competence to operative authority. Require a separately established actor, mandate, feasible action and consequence evaluation for any real change.

      Bearer

      AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

      Authority

      External accountable actors retain their actual authority; no authority is created by the analytical system. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-080#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-080#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-081

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-081

      Mechanism

      Treat text-derived events, identities, order and object relations as extracted hypotheses with source-span provenance and validation appropriate to their intended use. Separate explicit statements, inferred links and absent information; evaluate downstream sensitivity to extraction alternatives.

      Bearer

      AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

      Authority

      Extractor proposes records; analyst/domain reviewer establishes admissibility for the intended claim; narrative authorship does not guarantee factual correctness. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-081#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-081#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-082

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-082

      Mechanism

      Keep the broad transfer claim unresolved; preserve each exact representation, uncertainty model and scoped guarantee, and identify which combinations have actually been evaluated.

      Bearer

      AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

      Authority

      Researchers establish formal compatibility; domain evaluators establish practical interpretation and usefulness. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-082#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-082#/criticism

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Generated artefacts or bounded demonstrations do not settle generally safe autonomous process change. Low-code usability, semantic isolation, extracted event hypotheses and deployed causal benefit are different claims.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    Name

    Metric plurality and anti-proxy judgement

    Shared concern

    A score or formal property cannot stand for all dimensions of validity, value or fairness.

    Distinction

    Process outcomes, soundness variants, discovery metrics and prediction scores have distinct units and trade-offs.

    Trigger

    A ranking, threshold or status substitutes for a decision-specific quality or outcome judgement.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Mechanism

      Check notation well-formedness separately from fidelity to the intended domain and understandability for the intended user. Use the corresponding test for each claim; one kind of validity cannot stand in for the others.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Tool validators assess encoded rules; domain experts assess meaning; users demonstrate comprehension. None alone certifies the other dimensions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-011#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Mechanism

      Use measures that represent the intended received outcome and material costs, with case mix and affected groups visible. Keep time, effort, quality, flexibility, resilience and fairness distinct where they can move in opposing directions; select justified constraints and priorities rather than pretending all are maximised.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      Accountable decision makers choose priorities with affected-party input; analysts expose measurement limitations rather than choosing values by convenience.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-017#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-017#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-034

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-034

      Mechanism

      Use a capability assessment as a fallible diagnostic hypothesis about specific competencies, not as a proxy for process success or an obligatory stage ladder. Check evidence behind ratings and whether the proposed development addresses a real outcome problem.

      Bearer

      Capability/maturity assessments and claims made from their artefacts or ratings

      Authority

      Assessors describe evidence and limits; sponsors decide whether an identified capability warrants investment.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-034#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-034#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-039

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-039

      Mechanism

      Interpret indicators in light of the behaviour they reward, omitted work and differences in case difficulty. Use multiple relevant observations and inquiry into gaming rather than assuming the measured quantity remains a neutral description once tied to appraisal.

      Bearer

      Process visibility, appraisal, incentives and affected-person protection

      Authority

      Appraisal decision-makers are accountable for the use of measures; analysts must expose limitations rather than authorising sanctions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-039#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-039#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-056

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Artefacts and self-assessed stages do not establish exercised capability or received outcomes.

      Bearer

      Capability/maturity assessments and claims made from their artefacts or ratings

      Authority

      Assessors describe evidence and limits; sponsors decide whether an identified capability warrants investment.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-066

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-066

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. A single local metric can conceal burden displacement, unfairness, reduced resilience or worse received outcomes.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      Accountable decision makers choose priorities with affected-party input; analysts expose measurement limitations rather than choosing values by convenience.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-066#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-066#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-015

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-015

      Mechanism

      Check the exact WF-net definition: every reachable marking has some path to the final marking, final completion leaves no residual tokens, and every transition can occur in some execution.

      Bearer

      Workflow-model verification, soundness quantifiers and proof/reduction assumptions

      Authority

      A soundness verdict neither authorises tasks nor supplies resources, deadlines or successful external action.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-015#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-015#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-016

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-016

      Mechanism

      Select the initial population and quantifiers explicitly; add fairness, resource, time or ranking assumptions only when the required guarantee actually needs them.

      Bearer

      Workflow-model verification, soundness quantifiers and proof/reduction assumptions

      Authority

      Fairness assumptions concern execution policy/environment; a proof cannot compel a human to perform work.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-016#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-016#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-057

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-057

      Mechanism

      Connect each monitored quantity to a decision-maker and a possible action, while preserving scope, uncertainty and incentives.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Monitoring does not authorise intervention beyond the responsible actor’s powers.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-057#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-057#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-063

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

      Bearer

      Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

      Authority

      A measured efficiency gain does not authorise shifting unacceptable burdens to others.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-063#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-066

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-066

      Mechanism

      No independent correctness mechanism is supplied by the artefact’s presence; retain only the communication or executable-semantic function it demonstrably serves.

      Bearer

      Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

      Authority

      A badge or drawing confers no permission or verified outcome.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-066#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-066#/criticism

      Disposition

      CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-070

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-070

      Mechanism

      Replace feature-count maximisation with fit to required behaviours, semantic fidelity and total operating cost.

      Bearer

      Selected workflow representation/enactment infrastructure and total fitness/cost

      Authority

      Feature counts do not authorise adoption or prove organisational benefit.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-070#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-070#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-019

      Mechanism

      State the model language, search space, objective, noise handling and assumptions before interpreting discovered structure. Separate properties guaranteed by construction from properties inferred from the sample and from domain claims requiring external evidence.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Model producer communicates inductive bias to the analyst and decision consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-039

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-039

      Mechanism

      Evaluate fitness, precision, generalisation and simplicity as distinct questions, naming each operational measure and its assumptions. Report trade-offs and missing measurements rather than compressing them into an unexplained total.

      Bearer

      Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

      Authority

      Analyst explains the measures; the consumer supplies the decision priorities rather than allowing a metric package to choose them. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-039#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-039#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-040

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-040

      Mechanism

      State the precision definition, behavioural equivalence and evaluated representation; check known axiomatic or computational limitations before using the value for ranking. Compare alternatives only where their operationalisations are compatible.

      Bearer

      Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

      Authority

      Analyst interprets the measure; decision consumers must not equate the score with an externally validated false-behaviour rate. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-040#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-040#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-041

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-041

      Mechanism

      State the unseen-behaviour target and sample-generation assumptions; use held-out, simulation-ground-truth or resampling evidence only for the claim it supports. Compare simple baselines and examine sensitivity to representativeness and sample size.

      Bearer

      Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates population assumptions; domain consumer decides whether external validity is adequate for the planned use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-041#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-041#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-043

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-043

      Mechanism

      Match the experimental unit, split and comparison to the intended inference; isolate test information from tuning, preserve appropriate temporal availability, include meaningful baselines and account for failures/timeouts. State exactly what the dataset collection can and cannot represent.

      Bearer

      Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

      Authority

      Researcher designs the comparison; reviewer checks whether the conclusion follows from its units and assumptions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-043#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-043#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-044

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-044

      Mechanism

      Reject a context-free aggregate ranking. A decision-specific utility function may be used only with explicit weights, commensurability assumptions, exclusions and sensitivity to alternative priorities.

      Bearer

      Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

      Authority

      The consumer specifies priorities; a metric designer cannot supply universal organisational preferences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-044#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-044#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-045

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-045

      Mechanism

      Reject perfect fitness as sufficient validity. Test what additional behaviour the model admits and whether the event semantics, population and intended use are supported.

      Bearer

      Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

      Authority

      Analyst reports the narrow fitness result; consumer requires other evidence for stronger conclusions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-045#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-045#/criticism

      Disposition

      REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-051

      Mechanism

      Compare like with like where possible, disclose subgroup and case-mix differences, and examine how selection, censoring and task allocation affect the result. When comparability fails, narrow the claim instead of normalising away inconvenient differences.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Analyst identifies comparability limits; affected participants and accountable decision makers assess the meaning and acceptable use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-067

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-067

      Mechanism

      Reject the universal claim; compare appropriate baselines on valid task-specific splits, including inference cost, data needs, interpretability and timing.

      Bearer

      Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

      Authority

      Analyst supplies evidence; consumer judges cost and decision relevance rather than accepting architectural prestige. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-067#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-067#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-074

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-074

      Mechanism

      Separate traceability and computational reproducibility from semantic, population, model and causal validity. Use auditability to expose assumptions and reproduce a challenge, not as a replacement for evidence about them.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Analyst and reviewer use custody evidence to examine claims; no actor receives extra substantive authority merely by maintaining a log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-074#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-074#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A score or formal property cannot stand for all dimensions of validity, value or fairness. Process outcomes, soundness variants, discovery metrics and prediction scores have distinct units and trade-offs.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    Bwp e properties

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

  • Id

    BWP-K031

    Name

    Selective technical methods and domain boundaries

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-010

    • EBPM:EBPM-012

    Shared concern

    A specialised method remains conditional on its language, data, domain and economic scope.

    Distinction

    Scientific rerun, replay, declarative support, federated computation and discovery are not competing universal methodologies.

    Trigger

    A method or theorem is imported outside its actual prerequisites.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-010

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-010

      Mechanism

      Choose the representation and abstraction by the decision it must support and the people who must use it. Preserve the distinctions needed for that task; a narrative, table, decision model, process graph or case representation can be adequate without being interchangeable.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      The intended users help judge fitness; a notation specialist cannot infer business authority from technical sophistication.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-010#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-010#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-012

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-012

      Mechanism

      Reduce unnecessary representational complexity while preserving decision-relevant behaviour and relationships. Test the simplified form with its users; use modularisation or multiple coordinated views when a single small diagram would conceal essential interactions.

      Bearer

      Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

      Authority

      Modellers propose changes; users and domain experts check that useful meaning has not been lost.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-012#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-012#/criticism

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_BUREAUCRATISED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Mechanism

      Select support according to what can be known in advance: goals and information needs, mandatory constraints, planned tasks or a stable flow. Allow structured sub-processes inside knowledge work and avoid making flexibility equivalent to the absence of guidance.

      Bearer

      Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

      Authority

      Case workers plan within professional and organisational authority; system flexibility does not grant new powers.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-016#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-016#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-041

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-041

      Mechanism

      Select automation according to process stability, interface characteristics, data quality, exception load and the value of human judgement. Compare interface-level RPA, deeper integration, bounded process-aware agents and non-automation; test the actual changed work rather than relying on a tool category.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      Automation executes delegated operations; it does not establish the legitimacy of the underlying business decision.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-041#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-041#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-072

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-072

      Mechanism

      Match low-code users’ skills, support, permitted scope and release authority to the consequences of the applications they build. Distinguish a simpler modelling interface from validated competence to change shared processes or sensitive data use.

      Bearer

      Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

      Authority

      A citizen developer may create within delegated scope; platform access does not confer authority over another function’s commitments or protected data.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-072#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-072#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-073

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-073

      Mechanism

      Where the chosen formalism supports it, check that the combined constraints admit appropriate executions and that a changed instance specification remains compatible with its recorded history. Separate formal satisfiability and dead-activity checks from the truth, completeness and legitimacy of the encoded constraints.

      Bearer

      Formal declarative constraints and history-compatible instance specifications

      Authority

      Analysts check encoded behaviour; accountable domain actors decide which constraints should apply and whether a departure is authorised.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-073#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-012

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-012

      Mechanism

      Select a modelling form that preserves the needed behaviours and supports an affordable verification/explanation method.

      Bearer

      Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

      Authority

      Notation choice creates no operational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-012#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-012#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-017

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-017

      Mechanism

      Choose an analysis method that preserves the target property and record abstraction, reduction and compositional assumptions; complement it with implementation tests where needed.

      Bearer

      Workflow-model verification, soundness quantifiers and proof/reduction assumptions

      Authority

      Verification approves a stated model claim, not uncontrolled operational changes.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-017#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-017#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-041

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-041

      Mechanism

      Declare the portability layer—diagram, interchange syntax, executable subset, data bindings or runtime interaction—and test the layer actually relied upon.

      Bearer

      Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

      Authority

      A standard name is not evidence of conformance at every layer or permission to move data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-041#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-041#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-045

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-045

      Mechanism

      Keep replay-sensitive decisions within the deterministic contract and isolate or record nondeterministic inputs and effects through the supported interfaces.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Replay consistency is not permission to repeat an external action or proof that its returned value was correct.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-045#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-045#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-051

      Mechanism

      Express necessary temporal/data constraints, analyse their consistency and progress implications, and explain which obligations remain pending before completion.

      Bearer

      Participatory/flexible/declarative/case-based support with accountable discretion

      Authority

      An allowed trace is not automatically authorised or wise; external powers remain separately supplied.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-059

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-059

      Mechanism

      Preserve the workflow, relevant input/dependency/environment identity and provenance needed for a declared rerun or result-comparison claim; choose an appropriate output oracle.

      Bearer

      Scientific workflow provenance, environments, execution and reproduction claims

      Authority

      Workflow execution is not scientific authority and metadata completeness does not validate an inference.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-059#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-059#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-060

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-060

      Mechanism

      Model the data availability, placement, execution capability and failure/recovery boundary relevant to the scientific task, without equating a scheduler graph with the whole scientific process.

      Bearer

      Scientific workflow provenance, environments, execution and reproduction claims

      Authority

      Scheduling authority is limited to allocated resources and permitted data movement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-060#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-060#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-061

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-061

      Mechanism

      Inspect the used abstraction’s execution, data, extension and exit boundaries before relying on visual simplicity or claimed portability.

      Bearer

      Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

      Authority

      An accessible editor does not authorise the user to automate every connected action.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-061#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-061#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-015

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-015

      Mechanism

      Choose the exact object-centric formalism and required guarantee; distinguish type-level tokens from identifier-aware semantics and prove or test only the obligations that formalism states. Treat discovery, soundness and correspondence to real interactions as different claims.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Model analyst establishes formal properties; domain participants check identity interpretations; neither formal result grants intervention authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-015#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-015#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-018

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-018

      Mechanism

      Reject unconditional superiority. Select object-centric methods where retaining relationships changes the inquiry; otherwise preserve simpler case or relational views.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Consumer decides whether added relations are worth their acquisition and interpretation burden. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-018#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-018#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-020

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-020

      Mechanism

      Do not use original alpha as the universal default. Retain it as an explanatory baseline or for inputs satisfying its scoped conditions; select extensions or alternative miners according to the actual noise, loops and construct requirements.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst selects the method; foundational status is not evidence that it is the best operational choice. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-020#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-020#/criticism

      Disposition

      SUPERSEDED_BY_STRONGER_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-021

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-021

      Mechanism

      Use frequency-sensitive dependency estimates and thresholds to obtain a useful model; disclose threshold choices and inspect the behaviour removed or changed. Re-evaluate material low-frequency paths rather than classifying all of them as noise.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst proposes thresholds; domain consumer decides whether suppressed behaviour is important. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-021#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-021#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-022

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-022

      Mechanism

      Use a sound-by-construction structured representation where its expressiveness is adequate; distinguish the construction’s soundness guarantee from conditions for rediscovery and from correspondence to actual work. Record fall-through or noise-handling choices that affect the result.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Algorithm establishes its scoped construction property; analyst and domain consumer judge whether the representation fits the question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-022#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-022#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-023

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-023

      Mechanism

      Formulate candidate regions and place constraints as an optimisation/synthesis problem; choose objective, admissible regions and noise treatment explicitly, then inspect the behavioural implications of the resulting net.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Model analyst chooses the formal objective; a solver’s optimum is not an organisational objective by default. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-023#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-023#/criticism

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-024

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-024

      Mechanism

      Mine supported finite-trace constraints with explicit activation semantics, distinguish satisfaction from meaningful activation, and check redundancy and consistency before interpretation. Treat a discovered constraint as a descriptive hypothesis unless independently authorised.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst explains rule semantics; domain participants evaluate meaningful activation; rule authority is a separate decision. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-024#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-025

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-025

      Mechanism

      Search candidate models using explicit fitness objectives, mutation/crossover choices, resource limits and stochastic seeds; retain multiple runs and compare with simpler baselines. Do not interpret the returned best candidate as a proven global optimum.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst chooses the search objective and stopping condition; the optimiser cannot supply the missing definition of a useful process. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-025#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-025#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-026

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-026

      Mechanism

      Simplify a process view according to its communicative purpose, retain access to suppressed detail, and label the result as an abstraction rather than a complete executable specification. Test whether the consumer can answer the intended question.

      Bearer

      Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

      Authority

      Analyst constructs the view; participants judge its adequacy for the discussion, not merely its visual attractiveness. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-026#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-026#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-030

      Mechanism

      Discover or analyse bounded fragments with explicit event selection and boundary semantics; identify shared events and interactions omitted by the decomposition. Recompose only when compatibility and the consumer’s global question are actually addressed.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates what a local result does not say; the consumer decides whether a global conclusion is needed. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-035

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-035

      Mechanism

      Represent the admitted event uncertainties and compute or approximate lower and upper conformance costs across supported realisations. Report what holds for all, some or none of those realisations without assigning unsupported probabilities.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst explains bound semantics; the consumer decides whether the interval is informative enough to act on. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-035#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-035#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-052

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-052

      Mechanism

      Use simulation to explore consequences under stated process, resource, arrival and intervention assumptions; compare baseline reproduction and sensitivity before drawing a conditional scenario conclusion. Keep calibration evidence separate from intervention validation.

      Bearer

      Conditional simulation scenarios and counterfactual interpretation

      Authority

      Analyst constructs scenarios; authorised decision makers choose whether and how to test them in reality. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-052#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-052#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-078

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-078

      Mechanism

      Choose a federated protocol with explicit participant, identifier, activity-mapping and adversary assumptions; distinguish what is hidden during computation from what the protocol and released result reveal. Compare privacy, communication and computation costs with simpler aggregate exchange.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Participating organisations jointly authorise the computation and release; analysts cannot promise secrecy beyond the protocol’s boundary. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-078#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-078#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-079

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-079

      Mechanism

      Use LLM assistance for bounded tasks with explicit input, output semantics and independent checking of consequential claims or executable artefacts. Preserve source spans for extracted facts, tool/model versions and failed outputs; do not infer autonomous competence from a benchmark score.

      Bearer

      AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

      Authority

      Analyst retains responsibility for claims and tool execution; an LLM receives no operative authority from producing a plausible answer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-079#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-079#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-081

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-081

      Mechanism

      Treat text-derived events, identities, order and object relations as extracted hypotheses with source-span provenance and validation appropriate to their intended use. Separate explicit statements, inferred links and absent information; evaluate downstream sensitivity to extraction alternatives.

      Bearer

      AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

      Authority

      Extractor proposes records; analyst/domain reviewer establishes admissibility for the intended claim; narrative authorship does not guarantee factual correctness. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-081#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-081#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A specialised method remains conditional on its language, data, domain and economic scope. Scientific rerun, replay, declarative support, federated computation and discovery are not competing universal methodologies.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

    None recorded.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    R5 native frontier owner
