    Shared concern

    A receiving conclusion must preserve the meaning, scope and validity conditions of its inputs.

    Distinction

    BPM intent, enacted semantics and event evidence may remain distinct; reconciled interpretation does not require one universal schema.

    Trigger

    A material result crosses representation, actor, identity or time-regime boundaries.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-009

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-009

      Mechanism

      Establish event meaning, case/object attribution, timestamp semantics, extraction scope and known omissions before using event evidence. Keep data-processing transformations traceable and expose activities that the instrumentation cannot observe.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians explain instrumentation; analysts own inference limits; process owners decide whether evidence is adequate for action.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-009#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-009#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-014

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-014

      Mechanism

      Declare whether a model communicates, analyses or drives execution, and identify the additional implementation semantics and organisational arrangements needed to move between those uses. Keep engine events and real completion separate until their correspondence is demonstrated.

      Bearer

      The modelling-versus-execution contract between a process representation, enactment and actual work

      Authority

      Implementers control deployed semantics within their authority; process owners and recipients establish real obligations and completion criteria.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-014#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-014#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-049

      Mechanism

      Reconcile the meanings of cases, events, messages and completion across interfaces while limiting disclosure to a justified purpose. Technical schema compatibility is not enough when organisations interpret the same field differently.

      Bearer

      Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

      Authority

      Data custodians control authorised disclosure; process parties jointly resolve business meaning within their commitments.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep three linked but non-equivalent claims explicit: evidence supports a distinction about work; an identified actor is authorised and able to intervene; observed consequences support an outcome judgement. Require the missing link to be established before promoting one claim into another.

      Bearer

      Evidence-to-authorised-action-to-observed-consequence relations for managed work

      Authority

      Evidence producers do not acquire execution powers by analysis; authorised actors do not acquire factual correctness by holding office.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Mechanism

      Allow feedback to change a representation, the real work, the measure or the intervention hypothesis, but distinguish these acts. Review their consistency and continuity: updating a diagram does not change work, and changed work may require a revised account without implying improvement.

      Bearer

      Coupled but distinct revisions of representations, actual work, measures and hypotheses

      Authority

      Modellers may revise descriptions within their remit; changing operational commitments or evaluation criteria requires the responsible authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-001

      Mechanism

      Bind each transition to its definition version, case, work item and, where relevant, message attempt and external business object; do not substitute one identifier for all of them.

      Bearer

      Bindings among definition versions, instances, work items, messages and external business objects

      Authority

      Identity locates an object; it grants no person or service permission to act on it.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-005

      Mechanism

      Interpret an enabled task jointly with its information inputs, eligible/available actor, interaction obligations and external effect boundary.

      Bearer

      Task enabling/transition predicates together with data, resource and action meaning

      Authority

      Eligibility, capability and authority are separate checks; the workflow cannot invent any of them.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-018

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-018

      Mechanism

      Check the employed constructs and combinations against actual engine/version behaviour, including regressions, extensions and replay constraints.

      Bearer

      Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

      Authority

      Product branding is not an authority to assert untested semantics.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-018#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-018#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-039

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-039

      Mechanism

      Define message types, correlation, ordering, error responses and the evidence needed for received, accepted, performed or satisfied states.

      Bearer

      Participant workflows, message contracts and global interaction compatibility

      Authority

      Receipt is not consent; acceptance must be made by an appropriate participant under the relevant rules.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-039#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-039#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-040

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-040

      Mechanism

      Analyse the shared protocol and local behaviours together under explicit message ordering, delivery and partner assumptions; check global deadlocks and incompatible expectations.

      Bearer

      Participant workflows, message contracts and global interaction compatibility

      Authority

      Compatibility does not make an unwilling or unavailable participant cooperate.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-040#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-040#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-055

      Mechanism

      Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-058

      Mechanism

      Identify the observation boundary and connect consequential claims to an appropriate external or participant source; preserve uncertainty when correspondence cannot be checked.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      An observer need not have authority to act, and a model’s certainty cannot replace a participant’s legitimate judgement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-073

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-073

      Mechanism

      Bind and disclose the environment needed to interpret a decision or continuation, and evaluate declared compatibility before combining outputs from changed environments.

      Bearer

      Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

      Authority

      A compatibility declaration is not proof of correctness and cannot authorise its own acceptance.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-073#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-073#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-076

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-076

      Mechanism

      Recover or revise an instance only with a coherent account of its governing version, current state, pending work, message/effect identities and known external outcomes.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Continuity does not grant authority to modify prior commitments or fabricate missing evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-076#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-076#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-001

      Mechanism

      For each event class, establish what happened or was recorded, by whom or what, at which lifecycle phase, and with what relation to an actual work episode. Test a small number of material examples against source-system behaviour and domain testimony; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than inventing execution semantics.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-012

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-012

      Mechanism

      Select a case notion according to the question and unit of responsibility; test relevant alternative correlations. When one case cannot retain required object interactions, keep a relational/object-centric representation instead of forcing a convenient identifier.

      Bearer

      Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

      Authority

      Analyst and domain consumer choose the unit; the database’s primary key is not an automatic answer to the business question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-012#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-012#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-028

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-028

      Mechanism

      State observational equivalence and the limits of the sampled behaviour. Where competing models make different consequential predictions, seek discriminating data or domain evidence; otherwise retain alternatives or a weaker conclusion rather than asserting unique recovery.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates what is and is not identified; domain evidence can discriminate but must not be silently smuggled into the log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-028#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-028#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-030

      Mechanism

      Discover or analyse bounded fragments with explicit event selection and boundary semantics; identify shared events and interactions omitted by the decomposition. Recompose only when compatibility and the consumer’s global question are actually addressed.

      Bearer

      Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates what a local result does not say; the consumer decides whether a global conclusion is needed. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-054

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-054

      Mechanism

      Keep observation windows, event-schema versions, model versions and reference expectations distinguishable; tie a result to the regime in which its assumptions were assessed. Preserve enough prior identity to compare changes or reconstruct a past decision.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data and model custodians communicate changes; consumers know which temporal claim a result supports. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-074

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-074

      Mechanism

      Separate traceability and computational reproducibility from semantic, population, model and causal validity. Use auditability to expose assumptions and reproduce a challenge, not as a replacement for evidence about them.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      Analyst and reviewer use custody evidence to examine claims; no actor receives extra substantive authority merely by maintaining a log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-074#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-074#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    A receiving conclusion must preserve the meaning, scope and validity conditions of its inputs. BPM intent, enacted semantics and event evidence may remain distinct; reconciled interpretation does not require one universal schema.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

  • Id

    BWP-K033

    Name

    Organisational structure versus work relations

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-005

    • EBPM:EBPM-027

    • EBPM:EBPM-067

    • EWM:EWM-026

    • EWM:EWM-038

    • EPM:EPM-049

    • EPM:EPM-050

    Shared concern

    Formal reporting, accountable task ownership and event-derived interaction are not the same network.

    Distinction

    The role/resource/account identifier and a reporting relation cannot establish end-to-end work or a social relation without additional interpretation.

    Trigger

    An organisational chart, worklist or event-derived network is substituted for process or social meaning.

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared mechanism

    No universal shared implementation is asserted. The shared function is the guarded concern; exact mechanisms remain at each member.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Mechanism

      Represent process families, decomposition and interfaces at the abstraction needed for coordination. Preserve cross-cutting dependencies when decomposing and adapt reference architectures to actual work rather than treating a borrowed map as an empirical description.

      Bearer

      Process architecture and cross-process dependencies

      Authority

      Enterprise/process coordinators maintain the map with local expertise; the architecture does not override functional or contractual authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-027

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-027

      Mechanism

      Assign sufficient continuity of knowledge and responsibility to a case while retaining necessary specialist review and segregation of duties. Compare fewer handoffs with the competence and concentration-of-authority costs of task combination.

      Bearer

      Case coordination, allocation, pooling and segmentation arrangements

      Authority

      A coordinator may organise contributions without acquiring every professional or financial approval power.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-027#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-027#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-067

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-067

      Mechanism

      No unconditional operating mechanism is retained. Reporting relationships do not identify end-to-end work, cases, dependencies or received outcomes.

      Bearer

      Process architecture and cross-process dependencies

      Authority

      Enterprise/process coordinators maintain the map with local expertise; the architecture does not override functional or contractual authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-067#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-067#/criticism

      Disposition

      NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-026

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-026

      Mechanism

      Use only the lifecycle states needed to establish current responsibility, exclusivity or permissible reassignment, and transition them consistently with the work being performed.

      Bearer

      Actor eligibility/authority/competence, work-item ownership and assignment constraints

      Authority

      Owning a work item establishes coordination responsibility only within the assignment’s authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-026#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-026#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-038

      Mechanism

      Declare which participant controls each action and what the global interaction view omits; keep local execution and shared communication contracts distinct.

      Bearer

      Participant workflows, message contracts and global interaction compatibility

      Authority

      No choreography picture creates a central authority; orchestration only controls its own effective scope.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-049

      Mechanism

      Establish what each resource identifier denotes and when the mapping changes; distinguish people, roles, teams, systems and accounts. Do not make individual-level claims from a coarser or ambiguous identifier.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Data custodian explains account semantics; affected participants can challenge attribution; analysts do not infer personal identity by convenience. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-050

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-050

      Mechanism

      Define the exact event-derived relation and its unit; validate what the metric means with organisational participants and separate technical handoff from social relationship. Prefer aggregates where individual identification is not needed.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Analyst describes the operational relation; participants contest interpretation; organisational decisions remain externally accountable. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-050#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-050#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    Implementation neutral interpretation

    Formal reporting, accountable task ownership and event-derived interaction are not the same network. The role/resource/account identifier and a reporting relation cannot establish end-to-end work or a social relation without additional interpretation.

    Why members remain separate

    Different bearer, trigger, mechanism, source/evidence ceiling and/or frozen disposition. A convergence is metadata, never row deletion or target ownership.

  • Id

    BWP-K034

    Name

    Meaningful evidence for a process decision

    Composition class

    ONE_TO_MANY

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-044

    • EBPM:EBPM-001

    • EBPM:EBPM-031

    • EWM:EWM-055

    • EWM:EWM-058

    • EPM:EPM-001

    • EPM:EPM-008

    • EPM:EPM-053

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Originating property

    EBPM:EBPM-044

    Shared concern

    A relevant observation results in a documented decision, inquiry or reasoned non-action rather than passive reporting.

    Shared mechanism

    No single shared implementation owner; the originating criterion consumes several distinct mechanisms.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-044

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-044

      Mechanism

      Connect each consequential indicator to a decision, a responsible consumer and a feasible action or inquiry. A dashboard can inform action but its production is not itself adaptation or improvement.

      Bearer

      Monitoring outputs linked, or not linked, to a capable decision consumer

      Authority

      Monitoring analysts provide evidence; authorised owners or professionals decide interventions.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-044#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-044#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Mechanism

      Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.

      Bearer

      Process purposes, beneficiaries and strategic outcome commitments

      Authority

      Responsible managers can commit resources; beneficiaries and affected workers contribute outcome evidence. Analysts cannot decide whose interests prevail merely by drawing the boundary.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-031

      Mechanism

      Connect responsibility for the process outcome with sufficient influence, knowledge, resources and an escalation route across participating functions. Separate an owner title from the powers actually exercised.

      Bearer

      Process governance arrangements and exercised authority

      Authority

      The process owner acts within delegated powers; functional and professional authorities retain powers not transferred. Conflicts require negotiation or escalation, not fictitious unilateral control.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-055

      Mechanism

      Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-058

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-058

      Mechanism

      Identify the observation boundary and connect consequential claims to an appropriate external or participant source; preserve uncertainty when correspondence cannot be checked.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      An observer need not have authority to act, and a model’s certainty cannot replace a participant’s legitimate judgement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-058#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-001

      Mechanism

      For each event class, establish what happened or was recorded, by whom or what, at which lifecycle phase, and with what relation to an actual work episode. Test a small number of material examples against source-system behaviour and domain testimony; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than inventing execution semantics.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-008

      Mechanism

      Declare the target population and observation window; distinguish cases, events, objects and decision occasions; examine inclusion, censoring, unlogged work and changes in capture. Match the strength of a conclusion to the actual observation process.

      Bearer

      Analytical target population, unit and observation/censoring process

      Authority

      The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-053

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-053

      Mechanism

      Identify who needs the result, what decision it can change and what observation would establish the consequence. Separate analytical delivery, organisational agreement, implemented action and measured outcome; stop or retire an analysis without an adequate consumer.

      Bearer

      Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

      Authority

      Analyst communicates evidence and uncertainty; operational actors act within their mandate; outcome measurement must not be replaced by analyst self-report. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-053#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Minimal composition

    The listed mechanisms are an explicit sufficient candidate realisation, not a proven globally cardinality-minimal implementation. Alternatives may supply equivalent protected functions.

    Required constituent mechanisms

    • EBPM:EBPM-001

    • EWM:EWM-055

    • EWM:EWM-058

    • EPM:EPM-001

    • EPM:EPM-008

    • EPM:EPM-053

    Why no one mechanism is enough

    The monitoring decision requires purpose, a capable consumer, intelligible observations and bounded use; a dashboard alone supplies none of the missing links.

    Failure if mechanism absent
    • Property

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Missing function

      A proposed change can be judged against an explicit outcome and identified recipients, rather than only a department’s activity count.

      Bounded failure

      The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

    • Property

      EBPM:EBPM-031

      Missing function

      A consequential cross-functional decision can actually be made and implemented by identified actors.

      Bounded failure

      The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

    • Property

      EWM:EWM-055

      Missing function

      A reviewer can distinguish request, start, acknowledgement, completion and externally established effect where those distinctions matter.

      Bounded failure

      The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

    • Property

      EWM:EWM-058

      Missing function

      The claim’s evidence boundary is visible and no external success is asserted solely from an inadequate internal event.

      Bounded failure

      The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

    • Property

      EPM:EPM-001

      Missing function

      A sampled event can be traced to an intelligible recorded occurrence; ambiguous classes are excluded, bounded or clearly labelled in results.

      Bounded failure

      The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

    • Property

      EPM:EPM-008

      Missing function

      Reported denominators correspond to the declared unit, and material exclusions and generalisation limits are explicit.

      Bounded failure

      The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

    • Property

      EPM:EPM-053

      Missing function

      The result has a known consumer, disposition and consequence test, including a legitimate no-action outcome.

      Bounded failure

      The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Mechanism

      Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.

      Bearer

      Process purposes, beneficiaries and strategic outcome commitments

      Authority

      Responsible managers can commit resources; beneficiaries and affected workers contribute outcome evidence. Analysts cannot decide whose interests prevail merely by drawing the boundary.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-030

      Mechanism

      Define what evidence is sufficient for the claimed result and distinguish performer declaration, recipient acceptance and independently established effect.

      Bearer

      Performer declarations, commitments, recipient acceptance and established effects

      Authority

      Acceptance is an authorised judgement within a stated scope, not a metaphysical guarantee or substitute for consent.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-039

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-039

      Mechanism

      Define message types, correlation, ordering, error responses and the evidence needed for received, accepted, performed or satisfied states.

      Bearer

      Participant workflows, message contracts and global interaction compatibility

      Authority

      Receipt is not consent; acceptance must be made by an appropriate participant under the relevant rules.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-039#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-039#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-075

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-003

      Mechanism

      Before asserting closure, reconcile the local terminal state with the disposition of work and material external obligations: fulfilled, legitimately waived, transferred or explicitly unresolved under an accepted closure policy.

      Bearer

      Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

      Authority

      Local terminal status is not unilateral permission to waive another participant’s commitment.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-075#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-075#/criticism

      Disposition

      DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-005

      Mechanism

      Identify lifecycle phases and pairing rules; separate enabled, started, suspended, resumed and completed states where actually observed. Compute service or waiting intervals only from phases whose meaning supports them, and label unobserved intervals as unknown.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-008

      Mechanism

      Declare the target population and observation window; distinguish cases, events, objects and decision occasions; examine inclusion, censoring, unlogged work and changes in capture. Match the strength of a conclusion to the actual observation process.

      Bearer

      Analytical target population, unit and observation/censoring process

      Authority

      The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Current scientific account

    Closure uses the qualified EWM003 completion/residual criterion; EWM075 remains its historical duplicate. A terminal instance, an accounted closure disposition and fulfilled external obligations are separate predicates.

    R2 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R2 composition limit

    New native operands and separately returned constraints do not make this group an obligatory conjunction, establish a joint guarantee, or add a new property. Actual units, scope and authority remain distinct.

    R3 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R3 scientific integration

    The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

    R4 native frontier owner

    ../CAUSAL_FRONTIER_OWNER.json

    R4 scientific integration

    Named actual event-support, sampling and prospective-evidence operands may enter this group where its members and guards match. Each native duty, actual return and incompatible-scope control remains separate; no mandatory whole-lineage conjunction follows.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Mechanism

      Allow feedback to change a representation, the real work, the measure or the intervention hypothesis, but distinguish these acts. Review their consistency and continuity: updating a diagram does not change work, and changed work may require a revised account without implying improvement.

      Bearer

      Coupled but distinct revisions of representations, actual work, measures and hypotheses

      Authority

      Modellers may revise descriptions within their remit; changing operational commitments or evaluation criteria requires the responsible authority.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-071#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-048

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-048

      Mechanism

      Check the actual marking, data, completed work, pending interactions and relevant constraints when migrating an instance; a sound new definition alone is insufficient.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Migration permission must cover changed obligations, not just permission to edit a diagram.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-049

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-049

      Mechanism

      Declare deployment selection and permit coexistence where appropriate, with clear routing of new work, events and operators to the right version.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Coexistence must not silently violate externally required rule changes; those obligations need separate judgement.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-049#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-049#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-076

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-076

      Mechanism

      Recover or revise an instance only with a coherent account of its governing version, current state, pending work, message/effect identities and known external outcomes.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Continuity does not grant authority to modify prior commitments or fabricate missing evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-076#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-076#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-054

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-054

      Mechanism

      Keep observation windows, event-schema versions, model versions and reference expectations distinguishable; tie a result to the regime in which its assumptions were assessed. Preserve enough prior identity to compare changes or reconstruct a past decision.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data and model custodians communicate changes; consumers know which temporal claim a result supports. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-054#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-056

      Mechanism

      On an apparent drift, compare instrumentation, extraction, population and process explanations; inspect the change history and selected raw examples. Revise the process hypothesis only after distinguishing or explicitly retaining these alternatives.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data custodian explains instrumentation; analyst evaluates the observed shift; process authority decides on operational consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Name

    Legitimate disposition of a deviation

    Composition class

    ONE_TO_MANY

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-037

    • EBPM:EBPM-036

    Originating property

    EBPM:EBPM-037

    Shared concern

    The workaround receives an evidence-based disposition and material unresolved consequences are visible.

    Shared mechanism

    No single shared implementation owner; the originating criterion consumes several distinct mechanisms.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-037

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-037

      Mechanism

      Investigate a workaround’s cause, protected purpose, risks and affected parties before either suppressing it or institutionalising it. Distinguish useful repair, constraint evasion and temporary accommodation, then decide whether to change the system, the work or neither.

      Bearer

      A workaround and its cause, purpose, risks and authorised disposition

      Authority

      Performers can explain the workaround; authorised owners and relevant control holders decide its acceptance or replacement.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-037#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-037#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-036

      Mechanism

      Distinguish legitimate discretion from uncontrolled deviation. Define the goals and constraints that remain binding, who can depart from the ordinary route, and how the decision and its consequences are communicated and reviewed.

      Bearer

      Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

      Authority

      A case worker’s discretion is bounded by professional and organisational authority; a model’s optional task does not confer legal or ethical permission.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-033

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-033

      Mechanism

      Route unmodelled situations to an actor who can examine current state, authorise a bounded repair and record its consequences before resuming or revising the definition.

      Bearer

      Exception handlers, bounded repairs and interruption/cancellation scope

      Authority

      The ability to edit state is not permission to change business obligations or other people’s work.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-033#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-033#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-056

      Mechanism

      Check log-to-case/activity/order assumptions and the model’s intended scope before interpreting deviations or conformance as evidence about enactment.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      A detected mismatch is a question for adjudication, not automatic authority to sanction or repair.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-031

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-031

      Mechanism

      Record whether the reference is descriptive, intended, contractual, technical or otherwise externally authorised; identify its version, scope and approving actor. Limit conformance conclusions to the actual reference semantics and route normative judgements to the actor entitled to make them.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst computes correspondence; externally entitled actors interpret or amend obligations. No legal ruling or institutional power is inferred from mining.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-031#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-031#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-036

      Mechanism

      For a consequential deviation, keep plausible data, reference, execution and exception explanations separate; gather discriminating evidence and state which alternatives remain. Match the remedy to the supported cause rather than automatically correcting the process.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Analyst frames competing explanations; data custodians, process participants and authorised decision makers establish causes and appropriate action. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-038

      Mechanism

      Decide whether evidence supports correcting data, repairing a descriptive model, changing execution or formally revising an authorised rule. For model repair, preserve unaffected intent and re-evaluate changed behaviour; maintain the prior reference when continuity matters.

      Bearer

      Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

      Authority

      Model maintainer can repair a descriptive model within mandate; changing an obligation requires its own authorised actor and process. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Name

    Enactable, evaluable recommendation

    Composition class

    ONE_TO_MANY

    Originating property

    EBPM:EBPM-068

    Shared concern

    A claim of improvement can be traced through warranted observation, an actual authorised intervention and its observed result, with missing links explicit.

    Shared mechanism

    No single shared implementation owner; the originating criterion consumes several distinct mechanisms.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep three linked but non-equivalent claims explicit: evidence supports a distinction about work; an identified actor is authorised and able to intervene; observed consequences support an outcome judgement. Require the missing link to be established before promoting one claim into another.

      Bearer

      Evidence-to-authorised-action-to-observed-consequence relations for managed work

      Authority

      Evidence producers do not acquire execution powers by analysis; authorised actors do not acquire factual correctness by holding office.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-068#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Mechanism

      Accept an improvement claim only over its declared consequence boundary and protected outcomes. A local gain remains qualified when material receiving-side burdens are unknown; do not aggregate away a harmed group or silently change the boundary to rescue the claim.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      The party claiming benefit cannot unilaterally accept another party’s material burden as harmless.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-069#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-069#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-019

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-019

      Mechanism

      Assess whether eligible resources and time assumptions can support the enabled work, and specify what happens when they cannot.

      Bearer

      Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

      Authority

      Availability cannot be conjured by assigning a role; escalating does not grant competence or permission.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-019#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-025

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-025

      Mechanism

      Separate role eligibility, current authorisation, competence and availability; obtain each needed condition from an appropriate authority rather than from a worklist label.

      Bearer

      Actor eligibility/authority/competence, work-item ownership and assignment constraints

      Authority

      Workflow assignment records do not create external legal, professional or organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-025#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-025#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-030

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-030

      Mechanism

      Define what evidence is sufficient for the claimed result and distinguish performer declaration, recipient acceptance and independently established effect.

      Bearer

      Performer declarations, commitments, recipient acceptance and established effects

      Authority

      Acceptance is an authorised judgement within a stated scope, not a metaphysical guarantee or substitute for consent.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-030#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-064

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-064

      Mechanism

      Define the intervention, outcome and comparison; state the identification assumptions and assess confounding, treatment availability, temporal order and support. Use experimental or suitably justified causal evidence for interventional claims, and otherwise present recommendations as hypotheses requiring evaluation.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst establishes the causal claim’s conditions; authorised decision makers decide whether a test or intervention is acceptable. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-065

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-065

      Mechanism

      Restrict recommendations to actions that the recipient can perform within actual authority, timing and resource constraints; expose uncertainty and alternatives, allow rejection, and observe the action actually taken rather than equating advice with execution.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Operational actors retain the authority specified by the setting; analysts or models cannot grant themselves new powers through recommendations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-065#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-066

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-066

      Mechanism

      Record when recommendations or interventions alter exposure, action selection or outcomes; reassess predictive, calibration and causal claims against the new regime. Preserve the prior evaluation as historical evidence and explicitly test the revised policy or narrow its use.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst identifies changed validity conditions; operational authority decides continued use, revision or retirement based on new evidence. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-066#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-066#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Originating property

    EWM:EWM-076

    Shared concern

    The resumed case’s next action is justified by a coherent state/effect/version account or is explicitly held for adjudication.

    Shared mechanism

    No single shared implementation owner; the originating criterion consumes several distinct mechanisms.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EWM:EWM-076

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-076

      Mechanism

      Recover or revise an instance only with a coherent account of its governing version, current state, pending work, message/effect identities and known external outcomes.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Continuity does not grant authority to modify prior commitments or fabricate missing evidence.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-076#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-076#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-042

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-042

      Mechanism

      Distinguish a local task or engine completion from completion of the obligation to a recipient or partner. Identify the external effects that matter and obtain appropriate receiving-side or operational evidence before declaring the business case complete.

      Bearer

      Business/external obligation completion and receiving-side evidence

      Authority

      Each actor controls its own commitments; a local owner cannot declare another party’s obligations fulfilled by fiat.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-042#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-042#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-035

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-035

      Mechanism

      Treat a timed-out action’s effect as unknown until the relevant protocol, idempotency boundary or reconciliation establishes what happened.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      Timeout does not authorise a conflicting second action or unilateral reversal.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-035#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-035#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-036

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-036

      Mechanism

      Describe compensation as another action with its own preconditions and result, and identify which effects it can offset rather than claim universal world restoration.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      The original actor’s permission need not include permission to compensate; new approval may be required.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-036#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-036#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-043

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-043

      Mechanism

      Control repeated effects through a suitable combination of idempotency, deduplication with durable keys, atomic participation, rollback support or explicit reconciliation.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      An orchestrator cannot impose idempotency on an uncooperative external service.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-043#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-043#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-044

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-044

      Mechanism

      Reconcile intent, recorded acknowledgement and authoritative external outcome before a recovery decision that would otherwise assume the world matches engine history.

      Bearer

      Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

      Authority

      The reconciler may observe without being authorised to mutate; discrepancies require the right decision-maker.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-044#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-044#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-001

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-001

      Mechanism

      For each event class, establish what happened or was recorded, by whom or what, at which lifecycle phase, and with what relation to an actual work episode. Test a small number of material examples against source-system behaviour and domain testimony; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than inventing execution semantics.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-001#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-005

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-005

      Mechanism

      Identify lifecycle phases and pairing rules; separate enabled, started, suspended, resumed and completed states where actually observed. Compute service or waiting intervals only from phases whose meaning supports them, and label unobserved intervals as unknown.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-005#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-084

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-084

      Mechanism

      At a consequential analytical handoff, carry the output’s unit, event interpretation, population/time scope, model/reference semantics, uncertainty and supported use. The receiving method checks compatibility with its own assumptions; a material mismatch causes reinterpretation, additional evidence, a narrower claim or non-use. Invalidate affected downstream conclusions when an upstream assumption materially changes.

      Bearer

      Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

      Authority

      The producer communicates the bounded claim; the receiver checks semantic compatibility; externally authorised actors still decide and act. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-084#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    Originating property

    EBPM:EBPM-046

    Shared concern

    The change receives a reasoned retain, revise, withdraw or evidence-insufficient decision.

    Shared mechanism

    No single shared implementation owner; the originating criterion consumes several distinct mechanisms.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-046

      Mechanism

      Separate model change, implementation, adoption and measured outcome change. Review the proposed mechanism against observed consequences and retire, simplify or replace a control when its risk, consumer or payoff no longer warrants its cost.

      Bearer

      Post-enactment outcome evaluation and control continuation/retirement decision

      Authority

      Owners and sponsors decide continuation within their powers; affected actors provide evidence of benefits and burdens.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Mechanism

      Accept an improvement claim only over its declared consequence boundary and protected outcomes. A local gain remains qualified when material receiving-side burdens are unknown; do not aggregate away a harmed group or silently change the boundary to rescue the claim.

      Bearer

      Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

      Authority

      The party claiming benefit cannot unilaterally accept another party’s material burden as harmless.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-069#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-069#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-048

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-048

      Mechanism

      Check the actual marking, data, completed work, pending interactions and relevant constraints when migrating an instance; a sound new definition alone is insufficient.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      Migration permission must cover changed obligations, not just permission to edit a diagram.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-048#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-055

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-055

      Mechanism

      Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

      Bearer

      Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

      Authority

      Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-055#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-008

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-008

      Mechanism

      Declare the target population and observation window; distinguish cases, events, objects and decision occasions; examine inclusion, censoring, unlogged work and changes in capture. Match the strength of a conclusion to the actual observation process.

      Bearer

      Analytical target population, unit and observation/censoring process

      Authority

      The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-008#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-051

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-051

      Mechanism

      Compare like with like where possible, disclose subgroup and case-mix differences, and examine how selection, censoring and task allocation affect the result. When comparability fails, narrow the claim instead of normalising away inconvenient differences.

      Bearer

      Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

      Authority

      Analyst identifies comparability limits; affected participants and accountable decision makers assess the meaning and acceptable use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-051#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-056

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-056

      Mechanism

      On an apparent drift, compare instrumentation, extraction, population and process explanations; inspect the change history and selected raw examples. Revise the process hypothesis only after distinguishing or explicitly retaining these alternatives.

      Bearer

      Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

      Authority

      Data custodian explains instrumentation; analyst evaluates the observed shift; process authority decides on operational consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-056#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-064

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-064

      Mechanism

      Define the intervention, outcome and comparison; state the identification assumptions and assess confounding, treatment availability, temporal order and support. Use experimental or suitably justified causal evidence for interventional claims, and otherwise present recommendations as hypotheses requiring evaluation.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst establishes the causal claim’s conditions; authorised decision makers decide whether a test or intervention is acceptable. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-064#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-066

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-066

      Mechanism

      Record when recommendations or interventions alter exposure, action selection or outcomes; reassess predictive, calibration and causal claims against the new regime. Preserve the prior evaluation as historical evidence and explicitly test the revised policy or narrow its use.

      Bearer

      Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

      Authority

      Analyst identifies changed validity conditions; operational authority decides continued use, revision or retirement based on new evidence. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-066#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-066#/criticism

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    Minimal composition

    The listed mechanisms are an explicit sufficient candidate realisation, not a proven globally cardinality-minimal implementation. Alternatives may supply equivalent protected functions.

  • Id

    BWP-K041

    Name

    Proportionate, protected visibility

    Composition class

    ONE_TO_MANY

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-038

    • EBPM:EBPM-070

    • EWM:EWM-021

    • EWM:EWM-046

    • EPM:EPM-009

    • EPM:EPM-076

    • EPM:EPM-077

    • EPM:EPM-078

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Originating property

    EBPM:EBPM-038

    Shared concern

    The evidence used for decisions has a defensible purpose and access boundary, with harms and disputes visible.

    Shared mechanism

    No single shared implementation owner; the originating criterion consumes several distinct mechanisms.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-038

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-038

      Mechanism

      Limit process visibility and automated judgements to a declared purpose with appropriate access, participation and challenge. Examine privacy, surveillance, fairness and worker/recipient burdens as design consequences, not external afterthoughts.

      Bearer

      Process visibility, appraisal, incentives and affected-person protection

      Authority

      Managers do not acquire unlimited surveillance authority through technical availability; applicable professional, organisational and legal constraints require separate determination.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-038#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-038#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-070

      Canonical mechanism

      EBPM:EBPM-070

      Mechanism

      Select a proportionate adequate portfolio from feasible considered alternatives that covers the actual purpose, evidence, authority and feedback needs. Compare shared functions, dependencies and total burden; omit or retire machinery whose function is adequately supplied or no longer needed. A global minimum is not established.

      Bearer

      The jointly sufficient portfolio of BPM mechanisms, dependencies and costs

      Authority

      The accountable consumer and affected actors judge adequacy; method specialists do not mandate tools merely because they are standard practice.

      Evidence ref

      EBPM:EBPM-070#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EBPM:EBPM-070#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-021

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-021

      Mechanism

      Define who reads/writes each relevant value, when binding occurs and whether values are copied, shared or referenced across scopes.

      Bearer

      Task data flow, binding, ownership, freshness and concurrent-update semantics

      Authority

      Workflow scope is not legal or organisational authority; access policy needs its own basis.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-021#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-021#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-046

      Canonical mechanism

      EWM:EWM-046

      Mechanism

      Determine the minimum retained state, history and external references required for specified recovery, review and continuity claims; retire records only after those consumers and obligations are addressed.

      Bearer

      Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

      Authority

      This is not legal retention advice; applicable obligations must be supplied by the relevant authority.

      Evidence ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EWM:EWM-046#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-009

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-009

      Mechanism

      Specify what uncertainty additional logging would reduce, compare it with burden and exposure, and collect only the granularity and retention needed for that purpose. Reassess the need when the consumer or risk changes.

      Bearer

      Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

      Authority

      Operational and data-governance decision makers authorise collection; analysts advise on informational value, not unilateral monitoring rights. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-009#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-009#/criticism

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-076

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-076

      Mechanism

      Define the protected information, adversary’s plausible background knowledge and release/processing boundary; select and evaluate privacy transformations against that model and measure analytical utility loss. Treat output disclosure separately from secure computation.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Data governance determines acceptable exposure; privacy specialists and analysts assess the mechanism and its loss of useful distinctions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-076#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-076#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-077

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-077

      Mechanism

      Limit people-related inference to supported units and legitimate purposes; expose data/metric limitations, assess differential representation and consequences, and provide a meaningful route to challenge or correct material attributions. Treat fairness as a separately specified concern, not a property inferred from conformance.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Affected participants can supply corrections and objections; institutional decision makers remain accountable for use and consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-077#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-077#/criticism

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-078

      Canonical mechanism

      EPM:EPM-078

      Mechanism

      Choose a federated protocol with explicit participant, identifier, activity-mapping and adversary assumptions; distinguish what is hidden during computation from what the protocol and released result reveal. Compare privacy, communication and computation costs with simpler aggregate exchange.

      Bearer

      Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

      Authority

      Participating organisations jointly authorise the computation and release; analysts cannot promise secrecy beyond the protocol’s boundary. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Evidence ref

      EPM:EPM-078#/evidence_limit

      Criticism ref

      EPM:EPM-078#/criticism

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE
