  • Id

    BWP-K042

    Name

    Bounded temporal and action-presence support

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-016

    • EBPM:EBPM-018

    • EWM:EWM-052

    • EPM:EPM-035

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared concern

    A known action and meaningful temporal bounds can jointly constrain the same event-realisation set. Incompatible case identities or unsupported clocks defeat the join; a single adequate record may suffice.

    Distinction

    The roles are partial and non-equivalent; all listed mechanisms need not be used together.

    Trigger

    Actual scope-matched use of the named native outputs at the declared receiving question.

    Shared mechanism

    No common implementation or irreducible new property is inferred.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Mechanism

      Select support according to what can be known in advance: goals and information needs, mandatory constraints, planned tasks or a stable flow. Allow structured sub-processes inside knowledge work and avoid making flexibility equivalent to the absence of guidance.

      Authority

      Case workers plan within professional and organisational authority; system flexibility does not grant new powers.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-018

      Mechanism

      Separate elapsed time experienced by the case or recipient from active work effort and resource occupancy. Locate waiting, transfer and rework contributions before attributing delay to an actor or deciding which activity to accelerate.

      Authority

      Analysts interpret time evidence with performers; owners can change allocation or handoff arrangements within their authority.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-052

      Mechanism

      Expose relevant case data and permissible operations so an accountable actor can select the next justified action without inventing a full predetermined sequence.

      Authority

      Discretion is exercised within the actor’s actual authority; broad data access is not automatically justified.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-035

      Mechanism

      Represent the admitted event uncertainties and compute or approximate lower and upper conformance costs across supported realisations. Report what holds for all, some or none of those realisations without assigning unsupported probabilities.

      Authority

      Analyst explains bound semantics; the consumer decides whether the interval is informative enough to act on. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    BWP-K043

    Name

    Observed work and sample-generation scope

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-016

    • EBPM:EBPM-018

    • EWM:EWM-031

    • EWM:EWM-053

    • EPM:EPM-041

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared concern

    Known unlogged work, observed inclusion windows and enacted case choices jointly describe a sampled population. These facts do not identify an unseen future distribution or independent sampling.

    Distinction

    The roles are partial and non-equivalent; all listed mechanisms need not be used together.

    Trigger

    Actual scope-matched use of the named native outputs at the declared receiving question.

    Shared mechanism

    No common implementation or irreducible new property is inferred.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Mechanism

      Select support according to what can be known in advance: goals and information needs, mandatory constraints, planned tasks or a stable flow. Allow structured sub-processes inside knowledge work and avoid making flexibility equivalent to the absence of guidance.

      Authority

      Case workers plan within professional and organisational authority; system flexibility does not grant new powers.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-018

      Mechanism

      Separate elapsed time experienced by the case or recipient from active work effort and resource occupancy. Locate waiting, transfer and rework contributions before attributing delay to an actor or deciding which activity to accelerate.

      Authority

      Analysts interpret time evidence with performers; owners can change allocation or handoff arrangements within their authority.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-031

      Mechanism

      Include participants in defining and revising workflow support, and provide a way to handle legitimate work outside the prescription without pretending it never happened.

      Authority

      Discretion has boundaries; recognising situated work does not authorise every deviation.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-053

      Mechanism

      Separate the available plan from selected work, declare who may add/activate items, and define completion without equating every terminal item state with success.

      Authority

      Planning tables express permitted roles in a model; they do not establish external authority.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-041

      Mechanism

      State the unseen-behaviour target and sample-generation assumptions; use held-out, simulation-ground-truth or resampling evidence only for the claim it supports. Compare simple baselines and examine sensitivity to representativeness and sample size.

      Authority

      Analyst communicates population assumptions; domain consumer decides whether external validity is adequate for the planned use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Feasible action support, actual adoption, measured outcomes and bounded prior comparisons enter different parts of the prospective evidence obligation. None replaces missing comparison, interference, cost or independent-setting evidence.

    Distinction

    The roles are partial and non-equivalent; all listed mechanisms need not be used together.

    Trigger

    Actual scope-matched use of the named native outputs at the declared receiving question.

    Shared mechanism

    No common implementation or irreducible new property is inferred.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-016

      Mechanism

      Select support according to what can be known in advance: goals and information needs, mandatory constraints, planned tasks or a stable flow. Allow structured sub-processes inside knowledge work and avoid making flexibility equivalent to the absence of guidance.

      Case workers plan within professional and organisational authority; system flexibility does not grant new powers.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

      EWM:EWM-063

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

    BWP-K047

    Name

    Reference applicability and justified comparison

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-018

    • EBPM:EBPM-005

    • EBPM:EBPM-045

    • EWM:EWM-024

    • EWM:EWM-073

    • EPM:EPM-031

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared concern

    Actual time, local scope and semantic-environment meanings can qualify the same reference comparison. Reference origin and approving authority remain separately established; an uncertain context retains alternatives.

    Distinction

    Partial roles are non-equivalent; every listed mechanism need not be used together.

    Trigger

    Actual output, shared question/scope and receiving consumption under each native guard.

    Shared mechanism

    No common implementation or irreducible new operating property is inferred.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-018

      Mechanism

      Separate elapsed time experienced by the case or recipient from active work effort and resource occupancy. Locate waiting, transfer and rework contributions before attributing delay to an actor or deciding which activity to accelerate.

      Authority

      Analysts interpret time evidence with performers; owners can change allocation or handoff arrangements within their authority.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Mechanism

      Represent process families, decomposition and interfaces at the abstraction needed for coordination. Preserve cross-cutting dependencies when decomposing and adapt reference architectures to actual work rather than treating a borrowed map as an empirical description.

      Authority

      Enterprise/process coordinators maintain the map with local expertise; the architecture does not override functional or contractual authority.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-045

      Mechanism

      Reassess models, assumptions and measures when demand, case mix, resources, interfaces or actual practices change. Distinguish benign variation from a changed mechanism and avoid updating the model merely to normalise a harmful deviation.

      Authority

      Analysts identify changed evidence; owners and affected actors decide whether models, operations or objectives need revision.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-024

      Mechanism

      Choose binding/snapshot, conflict-detection or synchronisation rules sufficient for decisions that depend on mutable data; record when freshness cannot be established.

      Authority

      An engine cannot declare an external database current merely because its own copy is durable.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-073

      Mechanism

      Bind and disclose the environment needed to interpret a decision or continuation, and evaluate declared compatibility before combining outputs from changed environments.

      Authority

      A compatibility declaration is not proof of correctness and cannot authorise its own acceptance.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-031

      Mechanism

      Record whether the reference is descriptive, intended, contractual, technical or otherwise externally authorised; identify its version, scope and approving actor. Limit conformance conclusions to the actual reference semantics and route normative judgements to the actor entitled to make them.

      Authority

      Analyst computes correspondence; externally entitled actors interpret or amend obligations. No legal ruling or institutional power is inferred from mining.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared concern

    Purpose and actual dependency meaning can regroup unchanged records. Known shared work must not cross the claimed held-out unit, but lack of a known link does not establish independence.

    Distinction

    Partial roles are non-equivalent; every listed mechanism need not be used together.

    Trigger

    Actual output, shared question/scope and receiving consumption under each native guard.

    Shared mechanism

    No common implementation or irreducible new operating property is inferred.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Mechanism

      Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.

      Authority

      Responsible managers can commit resources; beneficiaries and affected workers contribute outcome evidence. Analysts cannot decide whose interests prevail merely by drawing the boundary.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Mechanism

      Represent process families, decomposition and interfaces at the abstraction needed for coordination. Preserve cross-cutting dependencies when decomposing and adapt reference architectures to actual work rather than treating a borrowed map as an empirical description.

      Authority

      Enterprise/process coordinators maintain the map with local expertise; the architecture does not override functional or contractual authority.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-033

      Mechanism

      Select centralised, decentralised or federated governance according to process interdependence, organisational context and available capabilities. Specify the decisions each arrangement enables rather than treating a BPM office as a universal requirement.

      Authority

      A BPM office may advise, enable or govern only within its mandate; process and functional managers retain explicitly allocated decisions.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-023

      Mechanism

      Use available case data or interacting business-object states to determine permissible work when a single activity route would hide essential relationships.

      Authority

      Object existence does not imply authority to modify its state.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

      Authority

      Analyst communicates population assumptions; domain consumer decides whether external validity is adequate for the planned use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • EPM

    • EWM

    A model actually used to construct an experiment supplies bounded support, quantifiers and joint unit. It supplies no sampling probability or field correspondence, and a normative constraint cannot delete a real observed violation.

    No common implementation or irreducible new operating property is inferred.

    • Key

      Mechanism

      Where the chosen formalism supports it, check that the combined constraints admit appropriate executions and that a changed instance specification remains compatible with its recorded history. Separate formal satisfiability and dead-activity checks from the truth, completeness and legitimacy of the encoded constraints.

      Authority

      Analysts check encoded behaviour; accountable domain actors decide which constraints should apply and whether a departure is authorised.

      Disposition

      DOMAIN_SPECIFIC

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-015

      Mechanism

      Check the exact WF-net definition: every reachable marking has some path to the final marking, final completion leaves no residual tokens, and every transition can occur in some execution.

      Authority

      A soundness verdict neither authorises tasks nor supplies resources, deadlines or successful external action.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-016

      Mechanism

      Select the initial population and quantifiers explicitly; add fairness, resource, time or ranking assumptions only when the required guarantee actually needs them.

      Authority

      Fairness assumptions concern execution policy/environment; a proof cannot compel a human to perform work.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-029

      Mechanism

      Check assignment satisfiability under the stated constraint language; recheck when users, roles or prior assignments change.

      A satisfying assignment is permission-consistent in the model, not proof of current availability or real-world authority.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-040

      Mechanism

      Analyse the shared protocol and local behaviours together under explicit message ordering, delivery and partner assumptions; check global deadlocks and incompatible expectations.

      Authority

      Compatibility does not make an unwilling or unavailable participant cooperate.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-051

      Mechanism

      Express necessary temporal/data constraints, analyse their consistency and progress implications, and explain which obligations remain pending before completion.

      Authority

      An allowed trace is not automatically authorised or wise; external powers remain separately supplied.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-074

      Mechanism

      Treat proposed optimisation as an unvalidated change requiring an external objective, semantic constraints, authority, evaluation and continuity checks; no general guarantee is supplied.

      Authority

      The optimiser cannot confer on itself the authority or criteria for accepting its own change.

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

      Mechanism

      State the unseen-behaviour target and sample-generation assumptions; use held-out, simulation-ground-truth or resampling evidence only for the claim it supports. Compare simple baselines and examine sensitivity to representativeness and sample size.

      Authority

      Analyst communicates population assumptions; domain consumer decides whether external validity is adequate for the planned use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-070

      Mechanism

      Select a proportionate adequate portfolio from feasible considered alternatives that covers the actual purpose, evidence, authority and feedback needs. Compare shared functions, dependencies and total burden; omit or retire machinery whose function is adequately supplied or no longer needed. A global minimum is not established.

      Authority

      The accountable consumer and affected actors judge adequacy; method specialists do not mandate tools merely because they are standard practice.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-004

      Mechanism

      Select the least costly representation and enactment mechanism adequate to the actual coordination risk and its consumer; revisit it when risk or demand changes.

      Authority

      Technical elegance or a licence purchase does not authorise redesign of other people’s responsibilities.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-063

      Mechanism

      Evaluate the actual setting, comparison, implementation attrition and distribution of costs before claiming improvement attributable to workflow support.

      Authority

      A measured efficiency gain does not authorise shifting unacceptable burdens to others.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep broad deployed benefit unresolved. Retain the narrower formal, simulation and retrospective findings and specify the prospective, multi-setting intervention evidence needed for stronger transfer.

      Authority

      Researcher and operational evaluator must establish realised effects; a developer’s simulation is not a deployment verdict. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

  • Id

    BWP-K051

    Name

    One dependency account across different questions

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-005

    • EPM:EPM-031

    • EPM:EPM-041

    • EPM:EPM-068

    Composition class

    ONE_TO_MANY

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    Shared concern

    The same reconciled relationship can qualify reference scope, held-out grouping and an interference question. Reuse is one input with different roles, not independent corroboration.

    Distinction

    Partial roles are non-equivalent; every listed mechanism need not be used together.

    Trigger

    Actual output, shared question/scope and receiving consumption under each native guard.

    Shared mechanism

    No common implementation or irreducible new operating property is inferred.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-005

      Mechanism

      Represent process families, decomposition and interfaces at the abstraction needed for coordination. Preserve cross-cutting dependencies when decomposing and adapt reference architectures to actual work rather than treating a borrowed map as an empirical description.

      Authority

      Enterprise/process coordinators maintain the map with local expertise; the architecture does not override functional or contractual authority.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-031

      Mechanism

      Record whether the reference is descriptive, intended, contractual, technical or otherwise externally authorised; identify its version, scope and approving actor. Limit conformance conclusions to the actual reference semantics and route normative judgements to the actor entitled to make them.

      Authority

      Analyst computes correspondence; externally entitled actors interpret or amend obligations. No legal ruling or institutional power is inferred from mining.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-041

      Mechanism

      State the unseen-behaviour target and sample-generation assumptions; use held-out, simulation-ground-truth or resampling evidence only for the claim it supports. Compare simple baselines and examine sensitivity to representativeness and sample size.

      Authority

      Analyst communicates population assumptions; domain consumer decides whether external validity is adequate for the planned use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-068

      Mechanism

      Keep broad deployed benefit unresolved. Retain the narrower formal, simulation and retrospective findings and specify the prospective, multi-setting intervention evidence needed for stronger transfer.

      Authority

      Researcher and operational evaluator must establish realised effects; a developer’s simulation is not a deployment verdict. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Disposition

      UNRESOLVED

  • Id

    BWP-K052

    Name

    Actual question and case-view premises

    Members

    • EBPM:EBPM-001

    • EBPM:EBPM-002

    • EBPM:EBPM-008

    • EBPM:EBPM-011

    • EBPM:EBPM-012

    • EBPM:EBPM-013

    • EBPM:EBPM-014

    • EBPM:EBPM-017

    • EBPM:EBPM-022

    • EBPM:EBPM-023

    • EBPM:EBPM-032

    • EBPM:EBPM-035

    • EBPM:EBPM-039

    • EBPM:EBPM-045

    • EBPM:EBPM-050

    • EBPM:EBPM-052

    • EBPM:EBPM-069

    • EBPM:EBPM-071

    • EPM:EPM-012

    • EWM:EWM-031

    • EBPM:EBPM-037

    • EWM:EWM-061

    Composition class

    MANY_TO_ONE

    Lineages

    • EBPM

    • EPM

    • EWM

    Shared concern

    Actual question and case-view premises supplied by alternative native sources, with independent binding/closure obligations.

    Distinction

    Alternative actual producer roles are not all required. A question, binding and completion have distinct functions; no automatic global sequence or reciprocal return.

    Trigger

    A named output is actually produced, communicated and consumed in a scope-matched receiving inquiry.

    Shared mechanism

    No common implementation, universal case key or new irreducible operating property.

    Distinct mechanisms
    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-001

      Mechanism

      Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.

      Authority

      Responsible managers can commit resources; beneficiaries and affected workers contribute outcome evidence. Analysts cannot decide whose interests prevail merely by drawing the boundary.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-002

      Mechanism

      Trace consequential work, waiting and risk beyond the unit receiving the improvement credit. Compare the whole affected path and require an explicit account of costs displaced onto partners, customers or unlogged workers.

      Authority

      A local owner may change its own work but cannot bind a partner unilaterally. Cross-boundary obligations require agreement with the actors bearing them.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-008

      Mechanism

      Sample materially different case types, failure paths and informal coordination. State which variants are covered and which remain uncertain; do not infer that rare or unlogged work is irrelevant simply because it is absent from a convenient sample.

      Authority

      Process investigators select cases with performers and recipients; owners accept the resulting uncertainty or commission further inquiry.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-011

      Mechanism

      Check notation well-formedness separately from fidelity to the intended domain and understandability for the intended user. Use the corresponding test for each claim; one kind of validity cannot stand in for the others.

      Authority

      Tool validators assess encoded rules; domain experts assess meaning; users demonstrate comprehension. None alone certifies the other dimensions.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-012

      Mechanism

      Reduce unnecessary representational complexity while preserving decision-relevant behaviour and relationships. Test the simplified form with its users; use modularisation or multiple coordinated views when a single small diagram would conceal essential interactions.

      Authority

      Modellers propose changes; users and domain experts check that useful meaning has not been lost.

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_BUREAUCRATISED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-013

      Mechanism

      Use terms that distinguish what action or decision occurs and what object is affected, in the intended users’ language. Resolve ambiguous domain terms before standardising a label grammar; test important labels through concrete cases.

      Authority

      Domain participants determine meaning; model maintainers ensure consistent use without overriding legitimate local terminology.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-014

      Mechanism

      Declare whether a model communicates, analyses or drives execution, and identify the additional implementation semantics and organisational arrangements needed to move between those uses. Keep engine events and real completion separate until their correspondence is demonstrated.

      Authority

      Implementers control deployed semantics within their authority; process owners and recipients establish real obligations and completion criteria.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-017

      Mechanism

      Use measures that represent the intended received outcome and material costs, with case mix and affected groups visible. Keep time, effort, quality, flexibility, resilience and fairness distinct where they can move in opposing directions; select justified constraints and priorities rather than pretending all are maximised.

      Authority

      Accountable decision makers choose priorities with affected-party input; analysts expose measurement limitations rather than choosing values by convenience.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-022

      Mechanism

      Distinguish description, prediction and causal intervention claims. State the proposed mechanism, plausible confounding and comparison; use stronger designs or bounded trials when an observational association could recommend the wrong intervention.

      Authority

      Analysts can identify evidence limits; authorised owners decide on precaution, experimentation or non-intervention.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-023

      Mechanism

      Form a specific change hypothesis and compare it with plausible organisational, informational and technical alternatives, including doing nothing. Define what would count as improvement, what may not worsen and how the choice will be evaluated after enactment.

      Authority

      Owners/sponsors authorise changes within their remit; performers and recipients contribute feasibility and harm evidence.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-032

      Mechanism

      Translate strategic commitments into explicit process outcomes, selection priorities and constraints. Examine conflicts between the sponsor’s strategy, affected-party interests and actual operational capacity rather than assuming alignment is inherently beneficial.

      Authority

      Strategy sponsors decide commitments; owners and performers test feasibility; affected parties inform consequences.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-035

      Mechanism

      Involve those performing and receiving work in discovery, redesign and evaluation; provide skills and incentives that permit the intended behaviour. Treat participation as consequential influence and learning, not attendance or consultation without effect.

      Authority

      Sponsors resource participation; performers contribute operational knowledge; consultation does not erase formal accountability.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-039

      Mechanism

      Interpret indicators in light of the behaviour they reward, omitted work and differences in case difficulty. Use multiple relevant observations and inquiry into gaming rather than assuming the measured quantity remains a neutral description once tied to appraisal.

      Authority

      Appraisal decision-makers are accountable for the use of measures; analysts must expose limitations rather than authorising sanctions.

      Disposition

      USEFUL_BUT_EASILY_GAMED

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-045

      Mechanism

      Reassess models, assumptions and measures when demand, case mix, resources, interfaces or actual practices change. Distinguish benign variation from a changed mechanism and avoid updating the model merely to normalise a harmful deviation.

      Authority

      Analysts identify changed evidence; owners and affected actors decide whether models, operations or objectives need revision.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-050

      Mechanism

      Include material environmental and societal consequences in process purpose, boundaries and redesign comparisons. Identify who or what bears these effects and distinguish measured outcomes from reporting capability, commitments or maturity ratings.

      Authority

      Sponsors and owners decide within legitimate constraints; affected parties and domain experts contribute consequences that internal metrics may omit.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-052

      Mechanism

      Use generated process artefacts as drafts that require independent checking of syntax, domain meaning, omitted work and purpose. Separate benchmark task success from truthful reconstruction of an organisation and from authority to execute the generated design.

      Authority

      The model has no independent business authority; authorised people remain responsible for accepting representations and interventions.

      Disposition

      ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVE

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-069

      Mechanism

      Accept an improvement claim only over its declared consequence boundary and protected outcomes. A local gain remains qualified when material receiving-side burdens are unknown; do not aggregate away a harmed group or silently change the boundary to rescue the claim.

      Authority

      The party claiming benefit cannot unilaterally accept another party’s material burden as harmless.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-071

      Mechanism

      Allow feedback to change a representation, the real work, the measure or the intervention hypothesis, but distinguish these acts. Review their consistency and continuity: updating a diagram does not change work, and changed work may require a revised account without implying improvement.

      Authority

      Modellers may revise descriptions within their remit; changing operational commitments or evaluation criteria requires the responsible authority.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EPM:EPM-012

      Mechanism

      Select a case notion according to the question and unit of responsibility; test relevant alternative correlations. When one case cannot retain required object interactions, keep a relational/object-centric representation instead of forcing a convenient identifier.

      Authority

      Analyst and domain consumer choose the unit; the database’s primary key is not an automatic answer to the business question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

      Disposition

      STRONGLY_RETAINED

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-031

      Mechanism

      Include participants in defining and revising workflow support, and provide a way to handle legitimate work outside the prescription without pretending it never happened.

      Authority

      Discretion has boundaries; recognising situated work does not authorise every deviation.

      Disposition

      RETAINED_IN_EVOLVED_FORM

    • Key

      EBPM:EBPM-037

      Mechanism

      Investigate a workaround’s cause, protected purpose, risks and affected parties before either suppressing it or institutionalising it. Distinguish useful repair, constraint evasion and temporary accommodation, then decide whether to change the system, the work or neither.

      Authority

      Performers can explain the workaround; authorised owners and relevant control holders decide its acceptance or replacement.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

    • Key

      EWM:EWM-061

      Mechanism

      Inspect the used abstraction’s execution, data, extension and exit boundaries before relying on visual simplicity or claimed portability.

      Authority

      An accessible editor does not authorise the user to automate every connected action.

      Disposition

      CONTEXT_DEPENDENT

Bwp e properties

None recorded.

Concurrency

Several inquiry, actual-work, recording and review relations may operate at once. Edges impose only their local preconditions, not a global BPM→workflow→mining schedule.

Interrupts

Exceptions may pause, cancel, branch, continue or trigger bounded repair according to declared scope; inability to stop remains visible.

Non use

Representation, engine, mining, logging and intervention are all conditional. Observation-only, manual work, non-change and retirement are valid configurations.

Semantic status

Nodes are distinct bearers and roles in an analytical model, not implementation components, native owners or deployment requirements.

Boundaries
Outside trifecta comparison

False

Target crosswalk

False

Target adoption or mutation

False

General autonomous optimiser established

False

Historical research cutoff

2026-09-06

R4 composition limit

Event support, sampling, bounded formal/implementation evidence, actual adoption and causal outcomes are distinct operands. Global coherence still requires compatible units, time, population and joint constraints; no global serial plan is added.

R5 composition limit

Authority/applicability, unit definition/observation, used synthetic support/field truth, and selected design/adoption/benefit remain distinct. Common unit, time, version and purpose must match; no global serial plan or mandatory full configuration follows.

R6 composition limit

Question-relative analytical cases, event identity, independent object bindings, completion meanings and experimental allocation remain separate. Shared events need not have one case; simple adequate identifiers and non-use remain legitimate.

R7 s003 composition limit

Content production and scope-matched use matter; the route, disposition or cost label is not the full source function. Question choice, rejection of a candidate correlation, positive binding, completion, authority and field benefit remain separate. No inferred reverse or required global lifecycle.

    /properties/11

    Actual operand

    A communicated account of continuing recipient work across reset work cards and shared coordination, distinguishing local closure from completion for the recipient.

    Changed receiving premise

    Makes recipient request a relevant analysis unit and rejects treating each engine card as a separately completed recipient request. The unit can be meaningful while the exact event-to-request relation remains unknown.

    Native reason

    The native mechanism includes participant involvement in revision and communication of reasons for exceptions, practical constraints and consequences. Its observable route is not the whole informational output of its actual operation.

    Evidence role

    PARTICIPANT_COORDINATION_ACCOUNT

    Guard

    The particular native account or inspection result is produced, communicated, examined for credibility and relevance, and actually consumed in the same question, work population and interpretation period. It changes a named case question, meaning or candidate correlation. A channel, disposition, cost, tool brand or possible future co-use is insufficient. Materiality does not require completion of the independent binding, receipt, authority or field-validity premises.

    Remaining premises

    Independent event occurrence and object identity, the needed event/object relation, residual correlation ambiguity, case creation and closure, receipt and time meaning, the legitimacy of the consumer question, permissions for consequential action, source credibility beyond the stipulations, and field benefit remain separate burdens. A rejected candidate correlation need not be replaced by a fully established one.

    Absence control

    No new contribution follows from absent production, absent communication, unused content, a different population or period, a bare label, or a payload that changes no case-choice premise. An already adequate identifier, direct conversation, scoped codebook or small relation table can suffice. A pure event-row count may not use a case notion at all. No automatic reverse or mandatory feedback architecture follows.

    Failure witness

    A feedback route containing no episode account, or an account delivered only to an unrelated inquiry, changes no P012 premise.

    Keep a route by which observations outside the current model—complaints, practitioner accounts, recipient experience and unlogged work—can challenge both the representation and the success measure. Do not let the model define all admissible evidence about its own adequacy.

    Observable postcondition

    A material discrepancy can lead to changed inquiry or explicit adjudication rather than exclusion as out of scope by definition.

    Communication or interaction requirement

    Bring external or omitted observations to the people controlling the model, measures and process.

    Dependencies or preconditions

    A channel for discrepant evidence, willingness to review it and access to actors outside the modelling team.

    Non trigger or cheap path

    Occasional independent case walkthroughs and accessible complaint routes may suffice; exhaustive surveillance is not required.

    Actor and authority boundary

    Evidence contributors may challenge a model; revision remains an authorised decision rather than automatic acceptance of every complaint.

    Judgment

    RETAIN_SUPPORTED_CURRENT_INPUT

    Scientific reason

    Actual omitted observations can challenge the case boundary; mere existence of a route is insufficient.

    Guard

    A concrete participant account, tested case distinction, omitted variant or recorded disagreement is actually delivered to the receiving inquiry about that same work.

    Remaining premises

    Testimony is fallible. Consensus is not truth; an unrelated workshop or untested opinion supplies no discriminating fact.

    Reverse assessment

    Existing current directions and independently guarded returns retained exactly; no new reverse is inferred.

    Reentry

    Reopen this bounded decision if a concrete native output or returned diagnosis changes a named receiver premise under an actual shared scope. This is not a theorem excluding all future applications.

Selected source SHA-256 039952df68113615f0a8e06d44fcdf0ffc4c112f355e27412db12fcd82257f90. Private custody/context locators, if any, are redacted; scientific record structure and argument remain.

Revision

BWP-S-2026-11-12-r7_recovered_s003

Questions
Q1

Actual coordination and diagnosed workaround accounts can supply a recipient-purpose boundary. Neither description automatically wins over the other; the account is examined and consumed at a named scope before it changes case interpretation.

Q3

A supplied request meaning and an established mapping can coexist with missing receipt. Local card closure is not evidence of delivered completion, and a case-duration result remains unknown for the undisclosed receipt.

Q5

W031 participant coordination and B037 diagnosed workaround reasons are distinct actual sources of case meaning. A useful account neither endorses a bypass nor suppresses formal accountability; its content must be assessed rather than replaced by a disposition label.

Q6

Five work cards, three recipient requests and ten event occurrences are different populations in the new construction. Two memberships of a shared event do not create another occurrence. Inspected deployment-local keys can be rejected with a partial identity contradiction while the complete replacement remains unknown; even equal counts can conceal different memberships.

Q8

Case counts can refine a consumed denominator under the retained independent return guard. The numerator, evaluation design, exposure and causal benefit remain separate; nothing here converts account agreement into a treatment effect.

Q11

The inspected definition and applicable population/time boundary must match the data used. Version labels alone cannot establish meaning. W073/P012 is already represented by BWP-R05642/05643; its existing compatibility concern is preserved without another duplicate arrow.

Q14

Card staffing and recipient completion may require simultaneous linked views. Either local view can be adequate for its own question while their unqualified joint-unit claim fails. A small relation table can preserve both without a universal canonical case.

Configurations
1

Direct discussion, a short trusted definition and an existing sufficient identifier can establish the needed question and meaning without a workflow engine or mining platform.

2

A narrative of cross-card work or a tested local codebook may identify a lost case distinction. A clean visual diagram or syntax badge alone does not provide it.

4

Observation-only mining may use a credible account to choose a recipient question while binding or receipt remains unknown. Report that uncertainty and retain competing interpretations when appropriate.

5

A narrow interface carries the particular coordination or inspected semantic content and its scope. A separately produced count return requires actual source use; forward case-choice input does not require it.

6

The complete composition retains independent obligations for question, identity, mapping, receipt, authority and benefit. Additional native functions do not jointly discharge them by membership alone.

7

Participant reasons and diagnosed bypass causes are informative content, not merely an exception route or approval field. Apply them to actual case distinctions and preserve disagreement or protected accountability.

8

Keep shared events as one occurrence with multiple request memberships when the question needs them. A six-row card/request relation suffices in the constructed case; richer object tooling is optional.

9

Use the actual applicable execution/data definition for each time or deployment scope. A qualified invocation identifier can still differ from the question-dependent recipient case.

12

When the current view already meets the recipient question, keep it. Removing redundant account channels, using direct adequate evidence, or declining an irrelevant case analysis can preserve the protected function.

Tensions
1

A workaround diagnosis can qualify the analytical case without authorising the workaround. Retain the prescribed accountability role while investigating its mismatch with actual recipient work.

2

A stable exported label may conceal deployment-local identity. Inspect the definition and changed scope; do not assume cross-version equality or rewrite historical event occurrences.

3

Participant discretion can reveal cross-card coordination and also conceal transferred risk. Credible content informs case choice; formal authority to alter work remains separate.

4

A small relation or codebook can preserve the necessary distinction. Additional tools add no benefit when a direct adequate view already exists.

5

Equal numbers of groups do not establish equal membership or meaning. Shared participation and repeated cards require explicit relations only where they change the consumer question.

6

A bypass account supplies a diagnostic premise, not automatic legitimacy. Conformance against an authorised reference and recipient-case interpretation remain distinct uses.

9

Three identified recipient requests can still include one unknown receipt. No inferred completion follows from engine termination, a story or a correct cardinality.

12

An actual inspected execution/data abstraction can reject a raw-key interpretation. A portability label or pin is not a substitute for that semantic result; W073 remains a separate retained concern.

17

Different legitimate unit questions can require compatible linked views rather than one merged case. Local counts and local credibility do not guarantee a coherent global claim.

Novelty reassessments
1

The new inputs refine the existing distinction among purpose, actual work and observed events. They do not create a new truth predicate for the whole process.

5

B037 already owns cause, purpose and risk inquiry into workarounds, while W031 retains situated coordination. Their case-choice contributions instantiate inherited operations and do not create a new disposition authority.

6

P012 already owns question-relative case and correlation choices. Equal-count/different-membership and partial rejection are discriminators for this inherited criterion; direct mappings and relation tables can replace elaborate machinery.

11

W061 inspected definition content and W073 environment validity remain distinct inherited concerns. A new composite name would add no compatibility theorem or identity evidence.

14

The simultaneous staffing/request views have different units. Their linked relation is useful without proving that all three genealogical lineages are necessary for every joint claim.

17

A material account or partial semantic contradiction changes a receiving premise while other premises remain unknown. It is a guarded relation among inherited functions rather than an irreducible new property.
